izzyondroid:com.simpol.permissionssummar.name: Permissions Summary
izzyondroid:com.simpol.permissionssummar.summary: List which apps have access to sensitive permissions on your device
izzyondroid:com.simpol.permissionssummar.description:
Permission Summary is a lightweight, open source Android app that helps you quickly check which apps have access to sensitive permissions on your device — in just a few seconds.
 The app only lists user-installed apps and only those with dangerous permissions. These are permissions Android classifies as potentially privacy-invasive and require explicit runtime approval.
 Permissions Checked: 
 Camera — Access to your device's camera
 Microphone — Record audio
 Location — Fine & coarse location (GPS, Wi-Fi, etc.)
 Storage — Access to files, media, photos, or music
 Contacts — Read, write, or access contact data and accounts
 Calendar — Read or write calendar events
 Phone / Call Log — Read phone state, call logs, answer calls, etc.
 SMS — Send or receive SMS, MMS, and WAP push messages
 Body Sensors — Access data from heart rate, step counter, etc.
 Non-dangerous permissions like INTERNET , POST_NOTIFICATIONS , and BLUETOOTH are intentionally excluded to reduce noise.
 Features: 
 🔐 Grouped by Permission — Instantly see which apps request access to camera, mic, contacts, etc.
 🧼 User Apps Only — Filters out system apps and background clutter.
 🚫 Focus on Privacy — Shows only dangerous permissions and skips non-sensitive ones.
 📱 Modern UI — Built entirely with Jetpack Compose and Material 3.
 ⚡ Fast & Lightweight — Optimized for quick, offline use. No trackers, no nonsense.
 Privacy: Everything runs locally on-device and offline. No personal data is collected or shared.

fdroid:app.buddy.assistant.name: Buddy
fdroid:app.buddy.assistant.summary: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity or Grok in a chat bubble on your phone
fdroid:app.buddy.assistant.description:
Buddy lets AI coding agents use your Android phone: Claude Code with your Claude plan, Codex with your ChatGPT plan, Antigravity with your Google account, Grok, or OpenCode's free models with no account at all.
Type or say what you want in the floating chat bubble. Buddy reads the screen, taps and types to get it done, and asks you before anything is sent, posted, bought or deleted. Passwords and payment details are handed to you.
How it works: the agent runs in a small Alpine Linux inside the app (via proot), and Buddy gives it phone tools through its accessibility service and a local MCP server on 127.0.0.1. No root, no adb, no PC, no API keys.
Also:
• acts on your notifications with rules you write
• guides you step by step ("show me how…")
• builds apps on the phone (Linux tools)
• a background browser for web pages
• live voice and scheduled tasks
• its phone tools work from your own Claude Code or Codex sessions in Termux
• 18 languages
What Buddy downloads: Alpine Linux (from alpinelinux.org, checked by SHA-256) when you set it up, and each agent's official CLI when you pick it. Chromium for the background browser only if you turn it on.
Buddy is an independent project, not made by or affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or xAI.

fdroid:com.anant.fitbuddy.name: FitBuddy
fdroid:com.anant.fitbuddy.summary: AI calorie & workout tracker with region-aware diets — log by photo or text
fdroid:com.anant.fitbuddy.description:
FitBuddy is a free, open-source health tracker for Android, with region packs that personalise diets and daily routines.
Snap a photo or type what you ate — an LLM estimates calories and macros instantly. Review ingredients, tweak weights with live macro recalculation, and save. Bookmark favourite meals as presets for one-tap logging next time.
Features:
• Region packs — personalise AI prompts, staples, portion language, and log examples to your region
• Smart logging — photo or text; AI parses food and exercise automatically
• Meal review — edit dish name, adjust ingredient weights with live macro recalc, and pick the log date (default today)
• Editable workouts — structured sessions with a 1,500+ exercise catalog (demo GIFs via CDN), favourites, body-part/equipment filters, recent & frequent picks, AI session names, and upgrade for simple logs
• Presets — searchable saved foods and meals; recently used on top; one-tap log
• Barcode scan — look up packaged foods; save or log them, and contribute missing products through Open Food Facts
• Dashboard — daily calorie ring, combined food/exercise log, macro breakdown
• Body goals — track weight, body-fat percentage, BMR, and muscle mass; current weight follows the newest reading; manually save calorie and macro targets, or calculate fresh adult targets with transparent Mifflin–St Jeor/TDEE estimates, quality-gated weight/body-fat/muscle trends, bounded AI-assisted personalization, activity guidance, and cautious weight milestones; AI can choose only between exact plans generated safely on-device
• Analytics — weekly or rolling 30-day calorie intake vs target, target-weight body charts, and a compact GitHub-style six-month calorie-burn heatmap
• Encrypted backups — AES-256-GCM; gzip; optional cloud with append-only chunks
• Loading animations — choose Analyzing / Insights wait animations in Settings
• Auto failover — rotates API keys and models on rate limits; stays on your preferred platform
• Offline fallback — works without an AI key via built-in simulator
• Developer support — Razorpay UPI/cards for India and GitHub Sponsors internationally; optional reminder every few days (turns off when your Support ID is on the public supporter list); thank-you cards for named supporters
• Material You — dynamic color theming on Android 12+
• Crash reports — optional anonymous Sentry reports (off by default; opt in via Settings)
• Diagnostic log — optional AI connection log you can export from Settings for support (no meals, photos, or keys)
AI providers (configured at runtime in Settings):
• OpenRouter — free vision models, automatic model dropdown
• Google Gemini — AI Studio key, OpenAI-compatible endpoint
• Ollama — local or cloud
• OpenAI-compatible — OpenAI itself or LM Studio, vLLM, LocalAI, Together, Groq, etc. (URL prefilled for OpenAI)
Without a configured provider, the app works offline using the built-in simulator. Photos require a configured AI provider.
Privacy:
• No ads, no tracking by default; no Android Auto Backup (local JSON + optional MongoDB only)
• Crash reports (Sentry) are off by default on F-Droid builds; opt in under Settings
• Cloud backup (MongoDB Atlas) is off by default; opt in under Settings → Backup; optional password
• AI providers are contacted only when you choose to enable them
• Razorpay, payment apps, and GitHub Sponsors open only when you choose them; the UPI QR is stored locally
• Privacy policy & deletion requests: https://anantdark.github.io/FitBuddy/privacy.html (fitbuddy31@proton.me)
Updates on this F-Droid build are delivered by F-Droid. The GitHub update checker is disabled in this flavor.
Note: The F-Droid APK uses F-Droid's signing key and cannot replace a GitHub or Play Store install in place.
Source: https://github.com/anantdark/FitBuddy
License: GPL-3.0-only

fdroid:com.norsehorse.scrubpony.name: ScrubPony
fdroid:com.norsehorse.scrubpony.summary: Strip GPS and metadata from JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC photos, on your device.
fdroid:com.norsehorse.scrubpony.description:
ScrubPony removes the hidden metadata from your photos while leaving the picture itself untouched.
Phones write a lot into every photo you take: GPS coordinates, the exact date and time, the camera and phone model, and small embedded thumbnails. ScrubPony strips those out and writes a fresh, clean copy. The image data is copied through byte for byte, so the photo looks exactly the same.
It works on JPEG, PNG, WebP and HEIC, including the HEICs most phone cameras save by default. Pick one photo or a whole batch.
Everything happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded, no network is used, and the app asks for no permissions. Your original files are never changed. Every scrub produces a new copy that you can save to your gallery, save to any folder, or share straight to another app. You can also share photos into ScrubPony from any other app's share sheet.
The metadata handling is the same C core as the desktop ScrubPony, compiled into the app. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0.

fdroid:com.sleepsecret.sleep_secret.name: Sleep Secret
fdroid:com.sleepsecret.sleep_secret.summary: Record the night, classify sounds on-device, get a morning report.
fdroid:com.sleepsecret.sleep_secret.description:
Record the night, classify the sounds in it on your phone, and get a report in the morning: when there was sound, what it was, and how long it lasted.
Audio stays on the device by default. There is no account and no server — install it and it works. The only exception is if you configure your own WebDAV storage in the export screen; after that, each night's results are uploaded to a drive under your own name.
Recognition runs on the phone. The model is CED-tiny (5.5M parameters, pretrained on AudioSet), converted to ONNX and run on-device. It does not need a network connection.
What it does
- Night-long sound timeline: when there was sound, what it was, how long it lasted
- Snore index: snoring time as a percentage of analysed time, for comparing one night to another
- Category breakdown and hourly distribution
- Event details: time, category and confidence for each event. Snoring clips can be played back inline, with a waveform and a draggable seek bar
The nine categories it reports: snoring / breathing / cough and throat clearing / sneeze / voice and sleep talking / body movement and bed noise / environmental noise / device noise / silence.
What it does not do
- It is not a medical device and cannot be used to diagnose sleep apnoea or any other condition
- It does not do sleep staging (light / deep / REM). That needs movement or heart rate; audio alone cannot do it
- It does not keep the raw audio of the whole night (8 hours is roughly 920 MB). What is kept is the timing and category of each event, plus any snoring clips you choose to retain
Android only for phones; there is also a Windows build intended for testing. There is no iOS version.
Free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later. Source code: https://github.com/14790897/sleep-secret

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.no.thanks.name: No Thanks!
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.no.thanks.summary: No Thanks! is a popular card game
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.no.thanks.description:
No Thanks! is a card game created by Thorsten Gimmler, ideal for groups of three to seven players. Originally known as Geschenkt!, it was first published by Amigo Spiele in 2004 and later translated into English by Z-Man Games.
Card Range: The game features playing cards numbered from 3 to 35. Before the game begins, nine cards are randomly selected and removed from the deck, which is then thoroughly shuffled.
Chips Distribution: The number of chips each player receives at the start of the game depends on the player count. With 3 to 5 players, each player begins with 11 chips. For 6 players, each starts with 9 chips, and in games with 7 players, each player receives 7 chips. Players also have the option to conceal their chips from others if they wish.
Game Initiation: The first player initiates the game by revealing the top card from the shuffled deck. They have a choice: they can either take the card, accumulating points according to its value, or opt to pass on it by paying a chip, which is then placed on the card. The player must declare "No thanks!" when passing. Subsequently, play continues in a clockwise direction, with each player making the same decision when their turn arrives.
Collecting Cards and Chips: The gameplay continues until a player decides to take the card along with all the chips accumulated on it, if any. The player who accepts the card then flips over the next card and repeats the process, deciding whether to take it or pass it. This pattern persists until all the cards in the deck have been taken.
Scoring: In the final scoring phase of the game, players calculate their points based on the values of the cards they have collected. Notably, cards in a consecutive run are treated as a single card with the lowest value. For example, a run of cards with numbers 30, 29, 28, and 27 would be considered a 27-point set. Each chip held by a player incurs a negative point, resulting in a strategic consideration to minimize the number of chips you accumulate.
Victory: The player or players with the lowest overall point total win the game. Mastering the art of minimizing card values and judicious chip management are key strategies for success in No Thanks!

fdroid:io.github.bropines.tailscaled.name: TailSocks
fdroid:io.github.bropines.tailscaled.summary: Unofficial Tailscale client: local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, optional VPN, root mode
fdroid:io.github.bropines.tailscaled.description:
TailSocks is an unofficial client for Tailscale networks (tailnets). It runs the Tailscale daemon in userspace-networking mode and gives your apps the tailnet through local SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies, so it does not take Android's VPN slot and runs next to another VPN, firewall or ad blocker. When you want system-wide routing, a VPN (TUN) mode is one switch away.
It works with Tailscale's own coordination server and with a self-hosted Headscale server.
 Networking 
• Local SOCKS5 proxy (optional username and password) and HTTP proxy, optionally reachable from your local network
• VPN (TUN) mode: full or split tunnel, per-app exclusions, accepted subnet routes; the daemon runs the tunnel itself, with hev-socks5-tunnel as a compatibility engine
• Exit nodes; MagicDNS and split DNS through a local DNS server, with a DNS-over-HTTPS fallback
• Root mode (experimental): a kernel tailscale0 interface with policy routing that steps aside when another VPN app holds the VPN slot
• Restricted networks: send coordination traffic through your own SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, or through the built-in ByeDPI against SNI-based DPI
• Optional auto-reconnect, a watchdog for a killed service, and start after reboot
 Services and files 
• Taildrop: send and receive files, including from the share sheet
• Taildrive: share folders and open the shares of other devices. The daemon reads a shared folder itself, so sharing one asks for All files access; nothing else does
• Serve and Funnel, Tailscale Services (svc:)
• TailCat: forward ports or run a SOCKS5 proxy through a tailcat server, with no VPN and no Tailscale account; the phone can serve its own ports too
 Management 
• Several accounts, each with its own state, keys and settings
• A console for the Tailscale Admin API (devices, DNS, users, auth keys, ACLs), protected by a biometric lock
• Encrypted backups and per-account export
• Automation: token-protected broadcast intents for Tasker or MacroDroid, and Android AppFunctions on Android 16+
• Home-screen widgets, a Quick Settings tile, network diagnostics (netcheck, DERP latency)
• Material 3 with dynamic colour and AMOLED black; English and Russian
 Network access 
The app talks to the coordination server you choose (Tailscale's by default), to DERP relays and to your peers. Names outside the tailnet are resolved through 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1, with Cloudflare's DNS-over-HTTPS (https://1.1.1.1/dns-query) as the fallback; all of them can be changed in Settings. TailCat, when you switch it on, fetches its relay map from tailcat.dev and connects through Tailscale's public DERP relays. The Tailscale Admin API is contacted only after you add an API token. Upload of debug logs to Tailscale is compiled out. Checking GitHub for a newer release on launch is a setting you can turn off; builds distributed through a store have it off.
 Requirements 
Android 7.0 or newer and an account on Tailscale or on a Headscale server. Root is optional.
TailSocks is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tailscale Inc. Tailscale, Taildrop and Taildrive are trademarks of Tailscale Inc.
Source code, documentation and issue tracker: https://github.com/bropines/tailsocks

fdroid:org.blitzortung.android.app.description:
Simple to use map based application, visualizing real time full area lightning data provided by the blitzortung.org lightning location network project. The current thunderstorm situation at your fingertips.
 Features: 
* realtime display of lightning data
* display of historical lightning data of the last 24 hours
* for regions Europe, North & South America, Asia, Africa and Australia/New Zealand
* lightning strike time color coded
* reduced data volume and fast response
* current lightning strike time and lightning count
* optional user location marker
* alert function shows distance/direction of storms
* background service for alerts
* support for notifications, sound and vibration alarm
* single stroke display for blitzortung.org participants
Please visit https://www.blitzortung.org for more information regarding the community based lightning location project.
The raster display ensures a fast performance of the application even if there is a very high thunderstorm activity. Blitzortung.org participants can visualize all stroke locations individually.
If you would like to contribute to a translation of the software in your language, please do not hesitate to contact the author of the software.
 User privacy
This app can use device location in order to show the users location on the map and for generating warning view and alerts for lightning activity nearby.
The lightning warning feature **can also be used without device location permissions** as the location can also be set manually (via preferences but also via long pressing the desired position on the map). You will still be able to use the warning feature without allowing location permissions.
In order to have a more efficient data transfer with high resolution lightning data the app only fetches the last 10 minutes of activity in an area of 5° x 5° rounded to five degrees.
Although this data is derived from the devices location or the map area currently visible it can not be used to track users.
Here is why:
 Granularity : A 5x5 degree area is extremely large.
 Latitude : 5 degrees covers approximately 555 km (345 miles).
 Longitude : At the equator, 5 degrees is also ~555 km. At 50° latitude (e.g., Central Europe/Canada), it is still ~355 km wide.
 This resolution is sufficient to identify a broad region (e.g., "Central Europe" or "US West Coast") but is completely insufficient to pinpoint a city, let alone a specific person or address.
 Anonymization : The calculation `(coordinate / scale).toInt()` effectively quantizes the location. All users within that massive 5x5 degree square report the exact same grid index (e.g., x=2, y=10). It is impossible to distinguish between two users within that same ~300,000 km² area based solely on these coordinates. On top of that, there is no data provided which would allow to link subsequent requests coming from the same app.
 Conclusion : The coordinates generated by `LocalData.update()` are too coarse for individual tracking. They serve only to download lightning data for the correct general region of the world.

fdroid:sushi.hardcore.droidfs.name: DroidFS
fdroid:sushi.hardcore.droidfs.description:
DroidFS is an alternative way to use encrypted overlay file-systems on Android that uses its own internal file explorer instead of mounting volumes. This allows you to store files in encrypted vaults that other apps can't decrypt.
Currently, DroidFS supports the following encrypted containers:
- gocryptfs (https://github.com/rfjakob/gocryptfs): encrypts file contents and file names but doesn't hide directory structure or file sizes.
- CryFS (https://github.com/cryfs/cryfs): slower, but encrypts everything and obfuscates file sizes.
 Features: 
- Compatible with original encrypted volume implementations
- Internal support for video, audio, images, text and PDF files
- Built-in camera to take on-the-fly encrypted photos and videos
- Ability to expose volumes to other applications
- Unlocking volumes using fingerprint authentication
- Volume auto-locking when the app goes in background
 Permissions: 
 Read & write access to shared storage: required to access volumes located on shared storage.
 Biometric/Fingerprint hardware: needed to encrypt/decrypt password hashes using a fingerprint protected key.
 Camera: required to take encrypted photos or videos directly from the app.
 Record audio: required if you want sound on videos recorded with DroidFS.
 Notifications: used to report file operations progress and notify about volumes kept open
All of these permissions can be denied if you don't want to use the corresponding feature.
DroidFS is free, open-source, and you can find the project's repository:
- on GitHub: https://github.com/hardcore-sushi/DroidFS
- on Tangled: https://tangled.org/cipherd.arkensys.dedyn.io/DroidFS
 Warning ! 
Security is neither absolute nor definitive. DroidFS does not come with any warranty and should not be considered as an absolute safe way to store files.

apple-macos:6790099597.name: Old Photo Restorer: AI Repair
apple-macos:6790099597.description:
Old Photo Restorer brings damaged family photographs back to life, right on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Scan a faded portrait from 1952, drop it into the app, click Auto Restore. Scratches disappear, faces come back into focus, black and white turns into believable color. What took a professional retoucher an afternoon now takes about a minute.
WHAT IT FIXES
• Scratches and cracks. The app finds them on its own and heals the damage without touching the rest of the picture. 
• Stains, tears, and worn corners. Damaged areas are rebuilt to match the surrounding paper, grain, and texture. 
• Blurry, faded faces. A dedicated face model recovers sharp, natural features. Each face is restored individually, up to 16 per photo, and you keep the person you remember: the app does not invent new faces. 
• Missing color. Colorization understands skin, sky, fabric, and foliage. It also works on sepia and yellowed prints, not only on pure black and white. 
• Low resolution. Upscale results 2x or 4x for printing and framing. A small 800px scan becomes a crisp, printable 3200px image.
HOW AUTO RESTORE WORKS
One click runs the full pipeline in the right order: damage repair first, then noise and grain cleanup, then faces, then color, and upscaling last. Each step is a separate model trained for that one job, which is why the result looks restored rather than filtered. Prefer manual control? Toggle any step off and run only what the photo needs.
YOUR PHOTOS NEVER LEAVE YOUR IPHONE, IPAD, OR MAC
Most restoration apps upload your pictures to a server and put you in a queue. This one does not. Every model runs locally on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac, so a photo of your grandmother is processed on your computer and nowhere else. No account, no upload, no waiting. It works on a plane.
BUILT FOR REAL ARCHIVES
• Work through a single treasured portrait or a whole shoebox of scans. 
• Compare before and after with a split slider that shows the same area on both sides, down to the pixel. 
• Turn each fix on or off per photo: scratch removal, stain repair, face enhancement, colorization, upscaling. 
• History keeps every restoration with its settings, so you can return later and export again. 
• Opens JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, and WebP. Exports PNG, JPEG, or TIFF at full resolution, ready for print shops.
MADE FOR APPLE SILICON
The restoration models are tuned for the Neural Engine and GPU in M-series Macs. A typical 2000px scan is cleaned up in seconds; a full pass with faces and color usually finishes in under a minute.
WHO IT IS FOR
People digitizing family albums before the prints fade further. 
Genealogists attaching portraits to a family tree. 
Anyone who inherited a box of photographs and wants to see the faces in them clearly, maybe for the first time.
FREE AND PRO
Restoring and exporting a cleaned-up photo is free, so you can judge the quality on your own scans before paying anything. Pro unlocks 4x print resolution and the full toolkit, with a monthly plan, a yearly plan with a free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. No credits and no per-photo fees.

apple-macos:530573877.name: Sync Folders
apple-macos:530573877.description:
• Synchronization and backup of local folders iOS, network folders Mac and PC, iCloud, external USB drives, memory cards, any other external media storage connected via Files.app
• Bidirectional sync, one-way sync, mirror backup (In-App Purchases, two sync modes for free).
• Powerful preview mode. Ability to change file operations before syncing.
• Synchronization any number of pair folders at the same time (In-App Purchases, one pair folders for free).
• With each re-backup, the app finds and copies only new files and new file versions, thereby reducing backup time and extending the life of your storage devices.
• List of excluded subfolders, files, file extensions, filter for folders and files.
Sync Folders is an easy-to-use app for beginners, has the ability to fine-tune synchronization settings for the most exacting professionals.
Do you have terabytes (TB) of data to sync? No problem! Sync Folders has been optimized to work with extremely large number of files.
Do you have questions? Please watch our helpful video tutorial on our website. 
FOR BEGINNERS
- Select 2 folders to synchronize.
- Select the synchronization mode, or use the default mode. You do not need to worry about other settings, they are set to the recommended.
- Click the "Sync current task" button and your folders will be synchronized!
FOR PROFESSIONALS
- 9 sync modes (In-App Purchases, two sync modes for free).
- 6 file comparison modes allow to synchronize files on the storage devices with different file systems.
- Synchronization of files with all attributes (timestamps, tags).
- Synchronization of subfolder attributes (timestamps, tags).
- Ability to select what package types synchronize as files, and which as folders.
- You can transform the app to the convenient file manager using powerful filters for files and folders.
- Synchronization over the network.
- Protection for unauthorized disconnect storage devices (folders) during synchronization.
- Keeping the last/all versions of files to be deleted. Using this mode, you can always restore deleted files, even if folders have synchronized several times.
- Ability to log events. You can filter events by type, task, status. Ability to export the event log to an external file.

flathub:org.getmonero.Monero.name: Monero GUI
flathub:org.getmonero.Monero.summary: Monero: the secure, private, untraceable cryptocurrency
flathub:org.getmonero.Monero.description:
Monero is a private, secure, untraceable, decentralised digital currency. You
 are your bank, you control your funds, and nobody can trace your transfers
 unless you allow them to do so.
 Privacy: Monero uses a cryptographically sound system to allow you to send
 and receive funds without your transactions being easily revealed on the
 blockchain (the ledger of transactions that everyone has). This ensures that
 your purchases, receipts, and all transfers remain absolutely private by
 default.
 Security: Using the power of a distributed peer-to-peer consensus network,
 every transaction on the network is cryptographically secured. Individual
 wallets have a 25 word mnemonic seed that is only displayed once, and can be
 written down to backup the wallet. Wallet files are encrypted with a passphrase
 to ensure they are useless if stolen.
 Untraceability: By taking advantage of ring signatures, a special property of
 a certain type of cryptography, Monero is able to ensure that transactions are
 not only untraceable, but have an optional measure of ambiguity that ensures
 that transactions cannot easily be tied back to an individual user or computer.

gnome-extensions:talk2pc-focused-window@.name: Talk2PC Bridge: Voice Input, Presenter Remote & Phone Files
gnome-extensions:talk2pc-focused-window@.summary:
Your laptop microphone sounds bad, the system input method covers too few
languages, and typing is slow. Talk2PC routes input through your phone instead:
dictate, handwrite, or enter special characters on the phone, and the text is
written straight into the focused window. Phone microphones are usually better
and phone keyboards cover more languages and characters, so voice input,
handwriting, and write-as-you-translate work the way you are used to.
The phone also works as a wireless mouse and keyboard — tilt or swipe to move
the pointer while standing or walking. Send files to the computer, and keep the
clipboard in sync in both directions.
For teachers: photograph student work with the phone, then zoom, annotate and
explain it on the projector while controlling the slides. The presentation
pointer and spotlight overlay are drawn directly by this extension.
This extension is the GNOME Shell bridge for Talk2PC, not a standalone
application — installing it alone produces no visible interface. After you
install and run the Talk2PC desktop app from talk2pc.lycheenow.com, the
interface and all features are provided by the desktop and phone apps. The
extension itself only exposes interfaces on the session bus for focused-window
identity, pointer position, virtual keyboard and pointer injection, and area
screenshots. It opens no network ports and collects no telemetry.
Talk2PC does not implement the KDE Connect protocol, so it cannot be paired with
KDE Connect or GSConnect. It takes a different route: the desktop app talks to
this extension directly over the session bus.

firefox-addons:697677.name: Popup Blocker Ultimate
firefox-addons:697677.summary: Best Pop-up Blocker for Firefox. (Best in Rating, Performance, This addon does NOT collect user's data same as Poper Blocker)If your Firefox version is not 57+ please install version 8.1 from Official website.
firefox-addons:697677.description:
Popup Blocker Ultimate makes it easy to block pop-ups. 
 Support Desktop and Android 
 IMPORTANT: If your Firefox version is not 57+ please install 8.1 version from Official website 
As you know, the default Firefox pop-up blocker cannot block all pop-ups, especially the ones which are triggered upon clicking. These tricky pop-ups can be annoying and waste precious time, effort and bandwidth.
Popup Blocker Ultimate is designed to identify and block these pop-ups.
 Web Extension version: 
 Allow all: Through this method, Popup Blocker Ultimate will allow all popups to execute.
 Block all: Through this method, Popup Blocker Ultimate will block all popups to execute. Be careful 
 Block all but whitelist: Through this method, Popup Blocker Ultimate will block all popups but whitelist.
 Allow all but blacklist: Through this method, Popup Blocker Ultimate will allow all popups but blacklist.
Furthermore, you can white list specific websites if you wish so.
 You can use '*' character in whitelisting and blacklisting domains (e.g., *.google.com). 
 Legacy version: 
This add-on has two methods to prevent popups from showing up:
 Strict: Through this method, Popup Blocker Ultimate will change the browser’s settings so that the browser can identify and block popups by itself.
 Analyze: Using a Analyze approach, Popup Blocker Ultimate will first analyze a website’s codes and then block the identified popup sections.
While using Analyze method, you might encounter some irregular behavior in web pages which can be solved by white listing said web page.
Furthermore, you can white list or blacklist specific websites if you wish so.

firefox-addons:1014839.name: Trocker
firefox-addons:1014839.summary: This extension is an email Tracker Blocker, hence the name: Trocker!
firefox-addons:1014839.description:
Tracking your emails to know if the receiver has opened them or not is awesome, so is being immune to it! Trocker gives you the latter! It blocks attempts by email trackers and won't let them track what you do with the emails you receive.
You will be amazed to see how many of the emails you receive have trackers in them!
If you have any issues with Trocker, email us at trockerapp@gmail.com or report the issue on GitHub ( https://github.com/trockerapp/trocker/issues ). Thanks for reporting issues. Given that Trocker needs to react to any breaking changes in webmails, we may not know about new issues unless you report them. Also, please consider giving us a chance to fix the issues before leaving a bad rating/review.
And follow us on twitter: https://twitter.com/trockerapp 
More information:
You can trust Trocker! Trocker runs locally on your machine and does not send or receive any information from the Internet. It needs permission to all tabs in order to be able to detect and prevent any tracking images or tracked links from being loaded from any of the tabs. But it makes absolutely no outbound Internet access and we neither gather nor use any data about you or your browsing behavior.
Trocker is also open source with the source code available at https://github.com/trockerapp/trocker and we encourage everyone to check it out from there or from Chrome Dev tools to confirm that there are no suspicious activities being done.
Trocker keeps you safe in all webmails, including Gmail™, Yahoo! and Outlook.com . It has additional capabilities in Gmail, Inbox and Outlook.com . In these 3 webmails, it has a heuristic tracker detection that detects and blocks almost any email tracking attempt, even from not well-known trackers!
Trocker is very efficient as it only gets activated when a tracker is detected.
Technical details:
Some email trackers track emails by injecting an invisible small image in the mail that is hosted in a specific address in their server. They know when the email is opened by looking at the download requests of the injected images on their servers. 
Trocker (as a lovely Tracker Blocker) stops this by simply blocking those image links from being loaded. It finds those injected images by looking at the url and matching the url pattern with the tracking servers that host injected images.
If you yourself are a user of these tracking services (you track emails you send others), your service wouldn't be affected and will work fine. Trocker would only defend you from OTHERS tracking you.
Moreover, some links are click tracked meaning that if you click on them, your clicks are logged and tracked. Trocker tries to bypass those links and redirect you directly to the original target without you being tracked. If not possible, Trocker will inform you that the link you've clicked on is tracked.
No one will be able to know when and if you open their emails, or click on their links if you enable Trocker. In Gmail, Inbox and Outlook.com , Trocker has a heuristic tracker detection that will detect and block almost any tracker, even if it is unknown. This works based on the fact that very tiny images are almost always trackers. After all, if they want you to see the image, they will make it bigger than 1x1 pixel!

firefox-addons:2974192.name: Facebook Video Downloader - GetFBVideo
firefox-addons:2974192.summary: Adds a Download button under Facebook posts. One click opens GetFBVideo with the video ready to save as HD or SD MP4, or as MP3 audio. Matches light and dark mode and stays light on your computer.
firefox-addons:2974192.description:
Save Facebook videos straight from your feed, without copying links.
GetFBVideo adds a Download button to the action bar under each post, right next to Share. Click it and GetFBVideo opens in a new tab with that video already loading, so all that's left is choosing a format and saving it.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Scroll your feed as usual.
2. Click the Download button under a post.
3. Choose HD or SD (MP4), or MP3 for just the audio, and save.
FEATURES
• A Download button on posts in your feed, on Pages, in search results and on video pages
• Works in the Reels viewer too
• MP4 video in HD (when available) or SD, or MP3 audio only
• Looks like the buttons around it and follows light and dark mode
• Available in 19 languages, and opens GetFBVideo in your language
• Toolbar button: opens GetFBVideo, and loads the current video when you're on a video page
• No account or sign-up needed
LIGHT ON YOUR COMPUTER
• Only wakes up when new posts load, and pauses itself in background tabs
• No polling, no tracking, no ads in the add-on
• Asks for just two things: access to facebook.com to show the button, and activeTab for the toolbar button
PRIVACY
GetFBVideo collects no data. It doesn't store, share or sell anything about you or your browsing. The only thing it ever passes on is the link of the post you clicked Download on, which it opens on getfbvideo.pro at the moment you click.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Only public videos can be downloaded.
• Please download only videos you own or have permission to save, and respect the rights of the people who made them.
• Questions or feedback: https://getfbvideo.pro/contact 
GetFBVideo is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Meta Platforms, Inc. Facebook is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

bluejetty:00123739:ios.summary:
Become a legend of the Wild West in "Bloody West: Infamous Legends"

bluejetty:00123739:ios.description:
Become a legend of the Wild West in "Bloody West: Infamous Legends"
Dust, sand, spurs that sparkle in the sun. Twelve men are standing opposite each other in the scorching midday sun. It is dead silent ... Until the first shot is fired and a murderous duel begins outside the saloon.
At the end, six men lie dead in the New Mexico dust. You and your deputies successfully protected the town from the bandits.
You are the founder of a town in the Wild West. Become a wealthy cattle baron, drive the Wild Bunch Gang from your land and expand your own sphere of control – with a Colt in your hand. Use tactics and strategy to reach your goal and assert yourself against the other players.
The story:
After the end of the civil war, I wandered aimlessly from place to place. Completely without perspective and marked by the experience of war, I hired myself out as a deputy, Cowboy, and Pinkerton agent. By chance, I came across the ruins of this abandoned one-horse town in the middle of nowhere in New Mexico. My old friend John Galveston knew the place from before and helped me restore the saloon. Now I finally have a home - a place where I make the rules. This town belongs to me. I am the law and I will put everyone six feet under who threatens me and my town.
The task:
You are the ruler of this town. There is not one dollar which is made that you don’t see a profit from. Make sure your Sheriff and his deputies are able to protect your town and interests. Recruit gunslingers who make sure that there is no doubt who is calling the shots in the territory of New Mexico. Dig for gold, trade with cattle, and expand your sphere of influence without letting anyone stop you.
Affiliate yourself with like-minded people and establish a gang that is known across the borders of the county.
Wild Bill Hickok, Billy the Kid, Jesse James, Wyatt Earp – the legends of the Wild West – will all stand in your shadow as you relentlessly pursue your goals.
The game:
"Bloody West: Infamous legends" is a strategy and management game that requires strategic thinking, tactics, and skill from the player. The following features are included in the game and provide nearly endless fun:
• Be a gunslinger and establish your own gang.
• Strike against your opponents in fierce duels on dusty roads.
• Get on your horse and conquer the Wild West.
• You are the ruler of your town. Earn money with the stores and build up a trading network.
• Drive the bandits out of the area and become the largest cattle baron of the Wild West.
• Play the game by your own rules and try out different tactics to win.

bluejetty:00030365:ios.description:
Meet Creativit, a powerful digital moodboard that is designed to help you plan out and launch your next big creative project much faster. With Creativit, you can store all of your ideas and inspiration for all of your creative projects in one convenient place that you can sync across multiple Apple devices connected to your iCloud account.
Creativit lets you add an unlimited number of items that can be organized into different folders and tags that you can add and customize yourself. With Creativit, you can add the items of different types, such as text, links, images or any other files you wish. You can also add an unlimited number of workspaces to organize and manage all of your larger projects even more efficiently.
Creativit is built with privacy and security in mind because we truly believe that you shouldn’t even have to worry about what data the app collects because Creativit just doesn’t collect any personal data linked to you at all. All of your data is being stored locally on your device and securely synced via iCloud. We have also designed Creativit to be as intuitive and easy to use as possible, and it will definitely feel right at home on any of your Apple devices, all thanks to its fully native design.
Creativit offers an extensive variety of features that you can use completely for free forever, but if you feel that the free functionality is not enough for your needs, you can always upgrade to Creativit Premium for even better experience. With Creativit Premium, you get an access to an unlimited number of workspaces, folders and tags that you can add and customize.
KEY FEATURES:
- One workspace for your creative projects
- Up to two folders to help you organize all of your ideas and inspiration
- Unlimited number of items with your ideas and inspiration that you can add
- iCloud sync
- 5 different content types (Text, link, image, file, task)
- Ability to sort your items using a pre-defined or a custom sort order
- Ability to reorder your items however you want
- Ability to filter your items using various filter options
- Ability to duplicate your items
- Ability to archive the unnecessary items that you don't want to delete yet
- Ability to customize the toolbar for your items lists or grids (iPadOS only)
- Gorgeous dark mode
- Fully native design
- Support for focus filters to help you minimize the distractions and focus on what actually matters to you at any given time
- Support for app shortcuts on iOS 18 and iPadOS 18
- Home Screen quick actions
- Beautiful Lock and Home Screens widgets
- Available on iOS, iPadOS and macOS
PREMIUM FEATURES:
- Unlimited workspaces that will definitely help you organize and manage all of your larger projects
- Unlimited number of folders that you can add
- Access to tags that you can use to organize all of your ideas and inspiration for your creative projects however you wish
- Bulk editing to help you edit all of your items more efficiently
- 10 different app icons for you to pick the one that fits your Home Screen the most
- 15 different tint colors that you can choose from to make the app feel more unique to you
- Custom appearance (System, light and dark)
If you have any questions or concerns regarding our app, we are always here to help you! Just reach out to us at info@designtech.so.

bluejetty:00128698:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00128698:ios.description:
Stay ahead with exclusive Asian business, economic, and political news.
Nikkei Asia delivers in-depth analysis and breaking news on the rapidly growing Asian economy, politics, and markets. Backed by more than 145 years of trusted journalism, we provide exclusive reports on Japanese and world news from The Nikkei's (Nihon Keizai Shimbun) extensive Asia-based network, in collaboration with the Financial Times and top regional business media.
In addition to exclusive reporting, Nikkei Asia offers English translations of key articles from The Nikkei, making it the ideal choice for readers in search of English-language news on Asia.
Key features:
・Text-to-speech -- Listen to articles in AI-generated audio.
・Multilingual translation -- Automatically translate articles into seven languages (Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Hindi, Malay and Tagalog).
・Stay updated on important stories -- follow your interests to stay updated with the latest news.
・Receive news alerts -- never miss a story with breaking news notifications.
・Save articles for later -- save stories to read at your convenience.
・Personalize your home screen -- arrange your preferred sections for quick and easy access.
・Enjoy comfortable reading -- improve your experience with dark mode and adjustable text size.
Who is Nikkei Asia for?
・Readers of The Nikkei.
・Those interested in The Nikkei’s business and economic insights.
・Anyone seeking a trusted English-language Asian news app.
・Readers who want to access articles from The Nikkei in English.
・People tracking trends and English news on the Asian economy and Japan today.
・Those looking for reliable political and economic news from Asia.
・Readers wanting the latest updates from The Nikkei on Japanese and world news in English.
・Professionals seeking a deeper understanding of Asia’s economy.
・Entrepreneurs and executives expanding their business in Asia’s key markets.
・Those interested in The Nikkei’s expert analysis and local perspectives on Asia’s politics and economy.
・Readers who want to engage and share insights on Asian economic and political issues.
Subscription & pricing:
The Nikkei Asia app is free to download, with in-app purchase options for full access.
A Nikkei Asia subscription unlocks all articles across both the app and website (asia.nikkei.com).
Current web subscribers can log in with their existing credentials to access their full subscription benefits on the app.
Payment and renewal:
・Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon purchase.
・Subscription will automatically renew.
・Auto-renewal can be disabled up to 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
Feature articles:
・Trading Asia -- analysis of the latest shifts and trends in Asian markets (Mondays).
・ASEAN Money -- insights into how Southeast Asia’s growing wealth is being created, used and managed (Tuesdays).
・Tech Asia -- from our award-winning team of reporters, “Tech Asia” highlights the industry's biggest stories, from global supply chains to the future of chip production (Wednesdays).
・China up close -- this feature consists of reporting on President Xi Jinping's aims and happenings in his administration (Thursdays).
・Policy Asia -- this feature provides deep analysis and on-the-ground reporting on Asia's politics, geopolitics, security and climate issues (Fridays).
・Big in Asia -- this is a visuals-rich feature highlighting the latest in consumer trends and what's hot in business, as well as information on Asia's leaders and influencers (weekends).
Feedback:
Please contact us at https://help.asia.nikkei.com/ if you have any feedback or questions about our mobile application.
Please see our terms of use, privacy and cookie policies for the Nikkei Asia app.
Terms of Use: https://info.asia.nikkei.com/terms-of-use-ios
Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy: https://info.asia.nikkei.com/privacy

From the Civilization Charter, strict rules lay down in the Fifth Continent.
Due to the rapid increase of monsters,
people's life fields became overwhelmingly narrowed.
Ones that can use ninjutsu, known as ninjas that were working secretly in the underworld,

the ninjas are now sent off to each land.
To prepare for the upcoming battles with monsters in the far away land not yet known,
the ninjas were focusing on with their training.

-This game is for online play only. WiFi connection will be required when you are using iPod touch, iPad, or iPad mini.

bluejetty:00187314:ios.description:
With the Purium app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Story
------
The world is in chaos under the rule of the Dragon King. You will embark on a quest to rid the lands of this evil monster. If you like the game, please show your support by providing a positive rating/feedback.
Thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00177517:ios.description:

PLEASE NOTE - this app is not compatible with an iPhone 5. It's designed for use on iPhone 5S and all iPhone 6,7,8,X variations.
Just carry your phone in your pocket or bag and it will count how many steps you have covered, how far you have walked, and the calories you have burned. It's always on, with no battery loss, counting how many steps you cover each day.

SET DAILY STEP COUNT AND CALORIE COUNT GOALS
Stay motivated and set daily goals for your step count and daily calories burned.
STEP, CALORIE & DISTANCE HISTORY
Unlock your full step and calorie history by connecting to the Health App. See how many goals you have met, over each day, week, month, or year, as well as a summary of all the calories burned and distance covered.
COMPATIBLE WITH WEARABLES 
Step Counter & Calorie Counter, by Map My Tracks, is compatible with any wearable device or app that shares data with the Health App.
BATTERY LIFE
Step Counter & Calorie Counter works in the background without affecting your phone's battery. It uses the phone's internal step-counting feature available in the iPhone 5s, iPhone 6/6 Plus, iPhone 7/7 Plus, iPhone 8/8 Plus, iPhone X.

bluejetty:00182895:ios.description:
Commander! The Roman Republic is on the march and many powerful nations oppose the expansion of our empire. War is imminent.
Rome needs the might of all talented warriors! Great generals like Caesar, Pompey, Antony, Octavian and Spartacus will fight with you. Let us witness the birth of a great conqueror!
【Campaign Mode】
Become the glorious commander of the legions in hundreds of historical battles and locations of Roman history. Witness Rome develop into a great empire spanning Africa, Europe and Asia.
** Take on the role of a general in the Punic Wars, the Spartacus Uprising, the Conquest of Gaul, Caesar's Civil War, Antony's Civil War, the Conquest of the East, the Conquest of Germania and witness the rise of Rome.
** Build cities, recruit soldiers, manufacture war equipment, build powerful fleets. Everything is under your control.
** Change sides and help Rome's surrounding nations and tribes stand up to the mighty Roman army. Stand against the expansion of this world empire and rewrite the history of the defeated!
** New technologies bring new visions. Researching technologies opens up new possibilities and accelerates your expansion.
【Conquest Mode】
From the Mediterranean to the British Isles, Rome, Egypt, Carthage, the Gallic tribes, the Germanic peoples and many others struggle for supremacy. Will Rome conquer the world or will the victor himself become the vanquished and an entirely new empire be established?
** Experience hundreds of years of history, from the Punic Wars during the Roman Republic, through the time of the Triumvirates to the era of the Roman Empire.
** Be friend or foe, declare wars or make alliances and support allies against powerful opponents. Choose the foreign policy that is in the best interest of your country. All roads lead to Rome!
** The tide of war is unstoppable. Expand cities, recruit legions, use strategies, research technologies and lead your empire to ultimate victory.
** Command the armies of countless countries and conquer the ancient world. Change their future and lead them to unimagined greatness.
【Expedition Mode】
Lead your legions on an expedition and use strategies and tactics skillfully. Play your commander skills to the full with a limited number of units and defeat powerful foreign enemies!
** New challenge mode that gives you a new kind of gaming experience.
** Each step of the expedition involves many difficulties and dangers. Keep adjusting your battle plans and achieve ultimate victory.
** Collect the best war trophies and get special conqueror uniforms as proof of your glory.
【The Senate】
Rome was not built in a day. Build the Arc de Triomphe, the Colosseum, the Pantheon and restore the glory of the past!
** Complete the tasks set by the Senate and win rich rewards.
** Train infantry, cavalry, archers and navy to improve their skills in battle.
** Equip your generals with battle flags and treasures to improve their talents and increase their skills.
【Characteristics】
*** Train unique commanders, freely customise talents and skills. Be flexible and control the battlefield.
*** By using the cloud archive, your progress can be stored online and synchronised when you switch devices. The security of your archives is guaranteed.
*** Conquest mode supports Game Center leaderboards. Conquer more territories in less time and with fewer generals.

bluejetty:00070887:ios.name: BVG Fahrinfo: Routes & Tickets
bluejetty:00070887:ios.summary:
BVG Fahrinfo is the official Berlin city transport map and ticket purchasing app, use it as your personal journey planner and buy tickets for all transport in and around the city.
The BVG Fahrinfo app has maps of all transport throughout t
bluejetty:00070887:ios.description:
BVG Fahrinfo is the official Berlin city transport map and ticket purchasing app, use it as your personal journey planner and buy tickets for all transport in and around the city.
The BVG Fahrinfo app has maps of all transport throughout the city including the bus, train, subway and tram.
How does it work?
Input your destination
Check the travel information and plan your trip
Buy a ticket
Download the ticket straight to your device
That’s it!
It really is that simple!
Are you late for a meeting in another part of the city and need to know the quickest route to work for all transport types? No problem.
Do you need to plan your connections and need access to all transport modes to plan your trip? That’s no problem either.
If you are a Berlin local traveling the bus and subway every day and looking for the quickest route or here for the weekend and looking for the quickest train or tram to the Spree, we’re here to help with the perfect route and ticket.
Buy your ticket and start your journey, we accept any of the following cashless payments:
• Direct debit (SEPA)
• Credit card (Visa, Mastercard & American Express)
• PayPal
• Apple Pay
You can check out all of the information you need to travel like a local in Berlin with BVG Fahrinfo, you can also buy a ticket for any bus, train, tram or subway trip in the app. You will be able to view multiple travel options to suit your needs and buy a ticket in the city.
Save your destinations:
Taking regular trips to your favourite places? Why not save them and get quicker results, every destination is saved so you can start your journey quicker and plan your route.
Need to get home on the subway from your favourite restaurant or looking to pick up something sweet from your favourite store? Your saved destinations are there for you in the app.
Travel planner:
BVG Fahrinfo has a map feature of all the different transport routes in the city and live travel information for all bus, train, tram and subway lines for Berlin and Brandenburg. Each map works in addition to the live travel information so that you can know which transport is best for you!
Ticket purchase:
Select the best travel route or check the Berlin travel maps to buy a ticket for any bus, train, tram or subway trip using the app just press on the travel option you want to take or your chosen route, then press on the ticket and you are good to go!
We offer a variety of different ticket types to fit with your life, whether you are here for a weekend or a berlin local:
• Monthly Ticket 10 a.m. (AB)
• Monthly Ticket Apprentice (AB)
• VBB-Flexticket (AB)
• Berlin Ticket S (AB)
• 4-trip-Ticket
• Daily pass
• Single ticket
• Short haul
• Connection ticket
• Tourist tickets
• Bicycle ticket
Multiple transport modes:
BVG Fahrinfo offers a combination of travel options for you to use throughout the city!
Use classic bus, train and tram travel with transport options like car sharing, bike sharing and kick scooters to enhance your journey. It’s so easy to use, whether you want to car share to the nearest to S-Bahn or pick up a bike and take it on the train to your next destination.
With BVG Fahrinfo you are not limited to public transport options only but have multiple options to choose from.
If you need a train, bus, bike, tram, car or a scooter we have you covered! Just open the map, get your current location and check out the travel options around you. BVG Fahrinfo has it all!
Information updates:
BVG Fahrinfo is the way to take city trips, we offer up to date travel information on all bus, train, tram and subway so that you can plan your route with the latest updates and avoid any delays by using the Live Information feature to get around Berlin or use the Commuter Alarm feature and receive a notification about changes to your journey.

bluejetty:00062303:ios.name: Idle Guns Factory Tycoon
bluejetty:00062303:ios.summary:
Do you know how AK-47 submachine guns are built? Do you know what parts and how the AK-47 is made? I think it would be interesting for you to build the submachine gun from scratch, and find out the shooting power of it?
With the Idle Guns
bluejetty:00062303:ios.description:
Do you know how AK-47 submachine guns are built? Do you know what parts and how the AK-47 is made? I think it would be interesting for you to build the submachine gun from scratch, and find out the shooting power of it?
With the Idle Guns Factory clicker game, you will have a unique chance to sneak into the arms warehouse and get the vibe to become a real gun builder of various guns classes!
You can build such iconic submachine guns as AK-47, M-134, M-249, RPG-7.
This clicker also allows you to get involved into the building process of the coolest and incredibly futuristic weapons that actually exist and have been recently used by the most powerful militaries in the world. When you build your gun, you can try it in the shooting range!
Advantages of the game:
1. A tremendous amount of content
You can build a lot of guns for each class and get quite an idle weapons army. When you build guns from parts you will get interesting facts and things about them.
2. Understandable and interesting gameplay
It is a super simple clicker game. The gameplay is intuitively understandable to each player.
3. Splendor of color effect and a charming soundtrack
The idle is accompanied by pleasant and impressive visual and sound effects. Enjoy a game to the full extent!
4. Play on whenever and wherever you like
The Idle Gun Clicker game can be launched offline and doesn't require an internet connection. You can play at any time, even on a flight!
5. Includes lots of different improvements and bonuses
An enormous amount of upgrades and boosters are awaiting you. Accelerate your progress with time travel, double speed, and wheel fortune.
6. Try out your weapon in a shooting range and earn more money
After building a gun, give it a try in a shooting range. Discover the weapon power and functionality, test what can be added or is opposite to your preferences. 
Even though the idle is not launched, you would get income from your weapons. Upgrade your weapons and get more offline income. Feel the progress and move effortlessly passing the levels in automatic mode.
Idle Gun Clicker is an easy to follow and nicely done clicker game about weapons with a shooting range feature. Download Idle Gun Factory right now and you will be able to not only enjoy the game but also to know much more about the best guns on earth!

bluejetty:00097980:ios.description:
Welcome to our new world of screw puzzles! Here, you will experience a combination of brain-teasing challenges and abundant fun. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or a new player, our game offers a refreshing experience with plenty of challenges to enjoy.
Game Features:
-Numerous Levels: The game features plenty of challenging levels, each carefully designed to test your logical thinking and strategy skills.
-Special Designs: Some levels feature special designs with intriguing shapes and structures that offer unexpected surprises and challenges to explore.
-Variety of Boosters: Four powerful boosters are at your disposal—Undo, Unscrew, Hammer, and Drill—to help you tackle tricky puzzles with ease.
-Entertaining Characters: Meet the adorable wood screw characters, each boasting an individual look, bringing fun and variety to the game.
-Rich Themes: Choose from a variety of wood screw themes, wooden panel themes, and background themes to create a personalized gaming experience.
How to Play: 
Click and twist the nuts to fit them perfectly onto the bolts, removing overlapping complex wooden bars, and enjoy the realistic operation experience. Use boosters to handle different challenges, flexibly apply strategies, and hone your skills to overcome numerous obstacles. Each level requires careful reasoning and logical thinking, as one wrong move could affect the entire process.
Wood Screw: Nuts & Bolts is not only entertaining but also a great way to exercise your brain. You can solve complex wooden puzzles in a relaxed atmosphere, which helps improve your thinking and problem-solving skills. Plus, the variety of themes lets you showcase your special style in the game.
Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a wood screw puzzle expert? Download our game now and embark on an exciting puzzle journey filled with challenges for your mind and skills!

bluejetty:00120287:ios.summary:
Play fun and relaxing games with our amazing dinosaurs! Designed for kids aged 2-5
Set off on a new and exciting journey with your friend, Raccoon! Explore the Dinosaur World, play educational games, make friends with each of the dinosaurs
bluejetty:00120287:ios.description:
Play fun and relaxing games with our amazing dinosaurs! Designed for kids aged 2-5
Set off on a new and exciting journey with your friend, Raccoon! Explore the Dinosaur World, play educational games, make friends with each of the dinosaurs, and learn interesting facts about them. They all want to be a part of your unique Dinosaur Park!
App features: 
• Play with 8 friendly dinosaurs
• Learn interesting facts about these amazing creatures
• Delight your dino friends with surprise gifts
• Feed the dinosaurs their favorite treats
• Engage in fun educational games
• Enjoy the colorful graphics and animations
• Use easy and kid-friendly controls
• Play offline with no ads
Dinosaurs come in a variety of sizes and shapes—some no bigger than a chicken, others taller than houses and longer than buses. We have chosen a few of the most amazing dinosaurs to introduce your kids to the prehistoric world!
This app is perfect for preschoolers who love playing games and want to know more about their favorite creatures—dinosaurs! Learning and remembering facts becomes fun when it is coupled with the fascinating games that toddlers can play here.
Friendly dinosaurs are waiting for kids to play with them: 
• Get prepared for a camping trip with Brachiosaurus
• Take care of little dinosaurs with Oviraptor
• Build sand castles with Iguanodon
• Help freezing Stegosaurus warm up
• Find hidden things with Compsognathus
• Gather Velociraptor’s friends for his birthday party
• Find a pearl in the deep sea with Plesiosaurus
• Make tasty smoothies with Pachycephalosaurus
Enjoy bright, colorful graphics, pleasant music and sounds, and learn a lot!
Your toddler can improve their memory, attention, and hand mobility with these fun games. The app also provides tips during gameplay to allow children to learn about the different dinosaurs all by themselves!

bluejetty:00093369:ios.description:
What is the Mileage Choice Program?
About Virginia's Mileage Choice Program
The Mileage Choice Program is a voluntary government-run program offering drivers of eligible vehicles an alternative way to pay highway use fees. Pay per mile driven instead of a flat annual fee at registration renewal. Drive less, pay less.
The device measures your driving distance, and the app provides a private, personal interface to view your trips, mileage, and driving scores.
Your Privacy is Protected:
Your driving scores and trip locations are completely private. They are not shared with third parties, not shared with government agencies, and do not impact your mileage payment. This data is for your eyes only.
Use the app as a personal safety tool to understand your driving patterns, or simply use it to submit your annual odometer reading—the choice is yours.
Features Available in the App:
Dynamic Dashboard - View weekly scores and recent trips
Odometer Reading - Capture and submit odometer photos to validate mileage. No payment occurs within the app.
Trip List - See distance, duration, and your private driving score for every trip
Trip Scores - Dive into each trip to see where you drove safely or unsafely on the map and which behaviors were detected
Find My Car - Never forget where you parked

bluejetty:00175124:ios.description:
Embark on a seamless Baby-Led Weaning Journey with our app:
* Discover Baby-Led Weaning: Navigate the world of solids with confidence. Our app is your comprehensive guide, presenting the latest research findings, nutritional insights and tips for safe, joyful weaning.
* 1000+ Foods & Recipes: Indulge your little one's palate with a diverse range of 1000+ baby-led weaning foods and recipes. From delectable first bites to delightful meals, explore a menu that fuels their healthy growth.
* Food Diary & Favorites: Seamlessly log your baby's meals with our intuitive food diary feature. Document every exciting taste adventure while also saving those cherished favorites for easy access.
* Allergies Monitored: Monitor allergies with ease. Our app lets you track allergen introductions and reactions, ensuring your baby's health is our top priority.
* Smart Search Filters: Tailor your experience with search filters that help you find the perfect recipes for your baby's age, dietary preferences, and nutritional needs.
* Age-Appropriate Food Details: Get precise insights into age-appropriate food choices. We provide detailed information to help you select the best options for your growing baby.
* Regular Updates: Keep things fresh and exciting with our updates. Discover new recipes and valuable insights to keep your baby's journey dynamic.
Join thousands of parents who have chosen our app for a confident, informed, and enjoyable baby-led weaning experience. 
Download now and embark on a delicious adventure of discovery and growth with your little one!
INFO ABOUT THE APP & SUBSCRIPTIONS
Weekly, monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions
The weekly subscription gives you unlimited access to content, the whole food database & knowledge. Subscription duration is either one week, month or year and it is auto-renewable which means that once purchased it will be auto-renewed every chosen time period until you cancel it 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. If you decide to subscribe you will pay the price set for your country, as shown in the app for a subscription duration of your chosen time period. The subscription automatically renews if it is not canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for the next subscription period up to 24 hours prior to the current subscription expiring.
You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal by going to your iTunes & AppStore Account Settings.
Terms of Service
http://www.mydrama.de/blwApp_terms
Privacy Policy
http://www.mydrama.de/blwApp_privacy

bluejetty:00015818:ios.name: Trala: Learn Violin
bluejetty:00015818:ios.summary: We are thrilled to announce that Trala apps have been acquired by Learnfield GmbH, the world-renowned company behind the popular piano-learning app, Skoove. This marks an exciting new chapter for Trala, bringing expanded opportunities for d
bluejetty:00015818:ios.description:
We are thrilled to announce that Trala apps have been acquired by Learnfield GmbH, the world-renowned company behind the popular piano-learning app, Skoove. This marks an exciting new chapter for Trala, bringing expanded opportunities for development, enhanced features, and dedicated support for our violin learners.
Trala helps you learn violin at any age, from anywhere.
Here’s how it works:
GROUNDBREAKING TECHNOLOGY AND INSTANT FEEDBACK
When you’re not in a lesson, Trala uses signal processing, cutting edge technology that analyzes the sound of your violin and gives you instant feedback on pitch and rhythm every time you practice. When you play the wrong notes, we’ll help you get back on track. 
CURRICULUM BUILT BY CONCERTMASTERS AND ROCKSTARS
Learn violin by playing the music you love - whether that’s Bach, Britney (Spears), Bluegrass, or (Bela) Bartok. Stay motivated between lessons with the world’s largest library of violin videos and exercises featuring folks like Joshua Bell, Katie Jacoby (The Who), and Kiana June Weber.
BUILT-IN VIOLIN TUNER
Trala’s in-app violin tuner provides high-precision tuning while teaching you the skills to tune by ear. 
EXPANSIVE SHEET MUSIC LIBRARY
Trala’s interactive sheet music library will teach you 500+ beloved songs, from Happy Birthday to Bach partitas. 
TRALA’S MISSION
Trala’s mission is to make world-class music education available to every single person on Earth. We’re here to give you the lessons, feedback, and support you need to become a violinist. Over 400,000 students from 193+ countries have downloaded Trala to learn violin.
MEET OUR CURRICULUM EXPERTS
Some of the most exciting violinists teach at Trala, including:
• Joshua Bell, Grammy award winning violinist
• Katie Jacoby, electric violinist for The Who
• Kiana June Weber, the world’s preeminent Celtic fiddler
• Dr. Nuné Melik, classical violinist, musicologist, and humanitarian
• Grace Youn, renowned Suzuki-certified expert in the fundamentals
• Rasa Mahmoudian, concertmaster of the Iran‐Austria Symphony Orchestra
----------------------------
Read about our terms and privacy policy here:
http://trala.com/terms
http://trala.com/privacy-policy
Questions? Email support@trala.com to chat with a real violinist.
Trala uses the open-source library Verovio (www.verovio.org).

bluejetty:00185655:ios.name: Dawn Of Zombies: Survival Day
bluejetty:00185655:ios.summary: Experience the aftermath of a nuclear apocalypse in the king of online survival games, Dawn of Zombies: Survival. This online multiplayer game unfolds in the Last Territories, which have mysteriously survived the Conflagration. In this surv
bluejetty:00185655:ios.description:
Experience the aftermath of a nuclear apocalypse in the king of online survival games, Dawn of Zombies: Survival. This online multiplayer game unfolds in the Last Territories, which have mysteriously survived the Conflagration. In this survival adventure, you'll be battling hunger, cultists, zombies, diseases, radiation, nuclear aberrations, and bandits from across the wasteland. Will you, a born survivor, succeed against the challenges of the post-apocalyptic world? Establish your state of survival and show the apocalypse who's boss.
Jump into our survival game:
— Acquaint yourself with the rules of survival and master survival craft both above ground and below.
— Excel in life after the apocalypse: sate your hunger, quench your thirst, and recover from radiation and diseases.
— Delve into a captivating action adventure survival story, with dozens of characters and hundreds of immersive quests.
— Experience the realistic graphics that truly bring this survival simulator game to life.
— 50+ artifacts from aberrated areas to help you get through the long dark of night.
— Wilderness, forests, military zones, and scientific bases, full of zombies, bandits, and fearsome beasts.
— Trade and communicate with various factions in the post-apocalypse, from stalkers wandering the Territories to Institute scientists.
— 40+ allies to help you in your fight against the unstoppable zombie hordes, including your faithful companion, River the dog, who was otherwise left to survive by himself. Build relationships with these characters to get unique rewards.
— Learn more than 100 Combat, Resource, or Survival skills. This ain't one of your typical zombie games!
— Craft to survive with 150+ blueprints for weapons, armor, vehicles, and shelter buildings for your base.
— 100+ types of weapons, including elemental weapons that deal fire, cold, acid, or electric damage. Shooting zombies is super fun now!
— Stealth mode: sneak up to zombies, hide in bushes, and silently dispatch your enemies. Use your smarts to survive the day, before heading back for more.
— Multiplayer: kill zombies and survive with your friends in online co-op mode.
— Dozens of different decorations and NPC assistants for your shelters and bases.
— Repair weapons and armor to withstand the zombie apocalypse.
— Travel using vehicles, from a humble bike to a souped-up off-roader. It will be days before they catch up to you!
— Special events: protect other survivors from bandits and attack cultist camps. Zombie survival games aren't just all "braaains!"
— Varied challenges: search airdrops, study aberrations, and find caches full of swag.
— Boss raids in radioactive bunkers and dungeons.
— Golden Status granting free gear, additional inventory functionality, gold, and skill point bonuses.
Coming soon:
— More of the features you want in online multiplayer games, such as…
— Large settlements where you can talk to other players.
— Clan bases, to develop and explore aberrated areas with your friends in an online survival mode.
— MMO boss raids and clan zombie hunts.
— Co-op PvE quests.
Story:
Humanity has fallen; the dead have risen. Dark games are afoot. You are a survivor, a stalker, wandering the Wastelands. Your task is to explore these lands, where man is more to be feared than beast, and a can of meat or a pair of worn-out boots is reason enough for murder. Your friend Sherp, an expert on nuclear aberrations, has gone missing in the Last Territories. It's down to you to find out what happened to him and uncover the true cause of the apocalypse. If you're lucky enough to survive in the days after, that is...
And remember: however long and dark the night, the light of dawn will always come.

bluejetty:00024487:ios.description:
Battle ready your troops! It’s time to conquer the enemy’s land! 
Fight for your right to defend your nation as the commander in chief. Your only goal is to capture the enemy’s flag by building your soldiers and stations.
Amass as many units of tags as you can. The more you collect, the more you can build and the stronger you become. Unlock special upgrades and equipment. Attack and defeat the enemies by using your tanks, bazookas or even fly your planes. Don’t forget to wait for the big drop! A small support from our allies can go a long way.
Play this highly addicting game that will ultimately test your strategy skills. Are you ready? There can only be one victor! 
Game Features:
Build your stations
Collect as many tags as possible and sell them to unlock each battle station. 
Rally your troops
More stations mean more troops. Gather them all as your first line of defense. Then, attack!
Raise your ranks
No good deed comes with no reward. As you progress, see yourself graduate to the top of the field: Sergeant, Lieutenant, Captain? You name it!
Capture the Enemy’s Flag
End the day with victory in your hands!

bluejetty:00114328:ios.name: Fashion Stylist - Makeover
bluejetty:00114328:ios.summary:
Step into a world of creativity and self-expression. In this makeover game, you become a makeup artist and fashion stylist, designing unique looks and exploring your own style through beauty tools and dress-up features.
Key Features:
- Mak
bluejetty:00114328:ios.description:
Step into a world of creativity and self-expression. In this makeover game, you become a makeup artist and fashion stylist, designing unique looks and exploring your own style through beauty tools and dress-up features.
Key Features:
- Makeup styling and character customization;
- Fashion, hair, and accessories selection;
- Studio mode for creative shots;
- Background music for inspiration;
- Progress tracking system.
Create Your Perfect Look
Select a character and apply makeup with a full set of virtual tools. Explore themed maquillage sets and beauty editor features — from foundation and blush to highlighter and custom brows. Change eye color, adjust lashes, add eyeliner, and finish with the perfect lipstick. From soft pink tones to bold combinations, mix textures and effects to bring your makeover looks to life.
Customize Your Style
Complete your look by choosing accessories, hairstyles, and fashion pieces that match the style. Mix and match elements to create themed outfits, shaping the mood and personality of your creation, just like in popular fashion games.
Capture Stunning Scenes
Switch to Photo Mode to showcase your work. Adjust poses, pick backgrounds, and apply filters to highlight the details of your design. Capture your avatar’s glow up, save the results, or share your creations to remember your favorite moments. 
Set the Mood With Music
Turn on the built-in audio player to enjoy relaxing background tracks while you create. Choose the sound atmosphere that inspires you and makes your creative flow even more enjoyable.
Track Your Progress
Follow your growth with a real-time rating system. See how your creativity evolves as you complete more looks and explore new style variations, just like in the most engaging teen games focused on fashion and creativity.
Dive into a colorful and inspiring environment where every look becomes a new story. Use different tools to explore various combinations, experiment with visual details, and save your finished results. Start creating today and build a personal collection of unique fashion dress-up and makeover looks in this makeup game experience.
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get exclusive bonuses:
1) Additional characters.
2) Extra style themes.
3) Expanded pose options in Photo Mode.
4) Extended background selections in Photo Mode.
5) "Audio Player" feature.
6) "Save Snapshot" feature.
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html
And Terms of use https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html
