bluejetty:00086712:ios.summary: Palavras Cruzadas Diretas é um grande clássico do entretenimento — um jogo de palavras atemporal que conquista milhões de jogadores em todo o mundo. O aplicativo oferece mais de 7.400 palavras cruzadas gratuitas, cuidadosamente elaboradas e
bluejetty:00086712:ios.description:
Palavras Cruzadas Diretas é um grande clássico do entretenimento — um jogo de palavras atemporal que conquista milhões de jogadores em todo o mundo. O aplicativo oferece mais de 7.400 palavras cruzadas gratuitas, cuidadosamente elaboradas e jogáveis sem conexão com a Internet. Todos os meses, novas grades são adicionadas para renovar o prazer de jogar.
Mergulhe no fascinante universo dos jogos de palavras e torne-se um verdadeiro mestre das palavras cruzadas! Seja iniciante ou experiente, mais de 50.000 definições cuidadosamente preparadas esperam por você — para horas de diversão inteligente e relaxante. Se gosta de caça-palavras, enigmas, sudoku, quebra-cabeças lógicos e outros desafios de palavras, experimente este passatempo envolvente — mas cuidado, é impossível parar de jogar!
Treine o cérebro e enriqueça o vocabulário
Resolver palavras cruzadas é uma forma divertida e eficaz de melhorar o vocabulário, a ortografia, o raciocínio lógico e a memória. O jogo é o companheiro ideal para estimular a mente, fortalecer a concentração e manter o cérebro em forma. Aprenda novas palavras todos os dias e teste o pensamento lateral em um formato leve e acessível.
Características
• Mais de 50.000 definições em categorias variadas
- Mais de 7.400 palavras cruzadas para descobrir.
- Novas grades adicionadas regularmente para diversão sem fim.
• 100% gratuito
- Sem custos ocultos — todas as palavras cruzadas estão disponíveis para todos os jogadores.
- Dicas gratuitas e ilimitadas para ajudar no progresso.
- As respostas são verificadas instantaneamente.
• Excelente legibilidade
- Fonte grande para máximo conforto visual.
- Zoom ajustável, ideal para telas pequenas.
• Modo claro / escuro
- O modo escuro reduz o cansaço visual e é ideal em condições de baixa luminosidade.
• Sem conexão com a Internet
- É possível jogar onde e quando quiser.
• Interface fluida e intuitiva

bluejetty:00062183:ios.summary: محفظ الوحيين يتيح لك إمكانية حفظ القرآن الكريم بالقراءات بالرسم العثماني والسنة النبوية والمتون بطريقة سهلة. كل ما عليك هو اختيار وقراءة النص وسماعه من القارئ ثم تسجيله بصوتك في حين يختفي النص. بعد الانتهاء من التسجيل يقوم التطبيق بعرض النص
bluejetty:00062183:ios.description:
محفظ الوحيين يتيح لك إمكانية حفظ القرآن الكريم بالقراءات بالرسم العثماني والسنة النبوية والمتون بطريقة سهلة. كل ما عليك هو اختيار وقراءة النص وسماعه من القارئ ثم تسجيله بصوتك في حين يختفي النص. بعد الانتهاء من التسجيل يقوم التطبيق بعرض النص مرة أخرى وتشغيل صوتك لكي تطابقه بالصواب. يمكنك متابعة نسبة الحفظ في كل سورة أو كتاب حديث وسماع التسجيل في أي وقت.
كما يمكن استخدام محفظ الوحيين في قاعات التدريس وذلك بعرضه على الشاشات الخارجية بكامل مساحتها وظهور الآيات بملء الشاشة عند تلاوتها.
يدعم التطبيق القرآن الكريم بـ ٢٠ رواية و ١٥ قارئًا بالإضافة إلى مصحف التجويد الملون وكتب صحيح البخاري ومسلم وكتب المتون كتحفة الأطفال والشاطبية والجزرية والبيقونية وغيرهم. 
مزايا التطبيق:
- قراءة القرآن بالرسم العثماني كما هو موجود في مصحف المدينة طبعة الملك فهد (الإصدار الأول والثاني)
- حفظ القرآن الكريم بالروايات عن طريق السماع والتسجيل والمطابقة
- الختمة ومتابعة الختمات (المعين)
- حصريا وللمرة الأولى تظليل آيات القرآن مع التلاوة على مستوى الكلمة في جميع سور القرآن وجميع قراء حفص عن عاصم
- إمكانية الضغط على أي كلمة وسماع تلاوتها بشكل منفصل
- إمكانية العرض على كامل مساحة الشاشات الخارجية باستخدام تقنية AirPlay للعرض اللاسلكي أو عن طريق التوصيل السلكي باستخدام AV Adapter
- إمكانية الرسم والتظليل على صفحات القرآن الكريم بغرض التعليم
- البحث الفوري في القرآن الكريم وكتب الحديث والمتون
- استماع التلاوة للعديد من القراء ولترجمات القرآن بعدة لغات
- تشغيل متواصل لصفحات كاملة وسور وأرباع وأجزاء والقرآن كاملا
- استمتع بالتشغيل في الخلفية
- إمكانية تعيين الآيات أو الأحاديث والمتون المراد حفظها وتكرارها
- إمكانية التحكم في سرعة القراءة للمراجعة السريعة
- سجل المتابعة لمعرفة نسبة الحفظ بحسب السور أو الأجزاء
- قراءة التفسير الموضوعي للقرآن الكريم
- قراءة أيسر التفاسير للشيخ أبي بكر الجزائري
- قراءة تفسير وترحمة معاني القرآن بعدة لغات
- التفسير الصوتي من الميسر في التفسير والمختصر في التفسير
- إمكانية متابعة حفظ الأحاديث على مستوى الفصول والأبواب والكتب والمصنفات
- إمكانية تحميل السور الكاملة وأبواب كتب الحديث دفعة واحدة
- إمكانية وضع الفواصل الذكية بألوان مختلفة وأسماء مميزة وتحريكها على الصفحات أو الآيات، حيث يمكنك تحديد كمية الورد واستقبال تنبيهات للتذكير بالقراءة.
- إمكانية كتابة الملاحظات النصية على الآيات
- إمكانية نسخ ومشاركة الآيات والأحاديث والمتون عبر شبكات التواصل الاجتماعي
Elmohafez app allows you to memorize the noble Qur’an according to the different qira’aat while using the Uthmani script. It also helps you memorize the Prophetic Sunnah and the mutoon (brief Islamic texts) in an easy way. All you have to do is choose the text, read it and listen to the recitation, and then record your voice as the text disappears. After the recording, the application shows the text along with your recorded voice for you to compare it and know how correct it is. You have the ability to follow your progress of memorization of the Qur’an or the books of hadeeth, and you can listen to your recording at any time.
Currently, the app supports the recitation of the Qur’an according to 20 different rewayaat (narrations) and 15 different reciters as well as the coloured Quran. It has Bukhari, Muslim and different mutoon such as “Tuhfat Al-Atfal”, “Al-Jazareyya”, “Ash-Shatebeyya” and other books.
Features
-Read the Qur’an according to the Uthmani script which is used in the mushaf that is printed at King Fahd Printing Complex.
-Listen to the recitation of many reciters.
-Control the speed of the recitation. This helps those who want to revise quickly.
-Choose any verse/hadeeth you want to memorize and repeat it several times.
- Draw and highlight on Quran pages for the purpose of teaching.
- Follow your progress of memorization of a chapter or part of the Qur’an.
- Read the topical interpretation of the Qur’an (tafseer mawdoo’ey).
-Help your children memorize the Qur’an.
-Supports displaying its content on an external display device (AirPlay/Cable).

محفظ الوحيين يتيح لك إمكانية حفظ القرآن الكريم بالقراءات بالرسم العثماني والسنة النبوية والمتون بطريقة سهلة. كل ما عليك هو اختيار وقراءة النص وسماعه من القارئ ثم تسجيله بصوتك في حين يختفي النص. بعد الانتهاء من التسجيل يقوم التطبيق بعرض النص مرة أخرى وتشغيل صوتك لكي تطابقه بالصواب. يمكنك متابعة نسبة الحفظ في كل سورة أو كتاب حديث وسماع التسجيل في أي وقت.
كما يمكن استخدام محفظ الوحيين في قاعات التدريس وذلك بعرضه على الشاشات الخارجية بكامل مساحتها وظهور الآيات بملء الشاشة عند تلاوتها.

يدعم التطبيق القرآن الكريم بـ ٢٠ رواية و ١٥ قارئًا بالإضافة إلى مصحف التجويد الملون وكتب صحيح البخاري ومسلم وكتب المتون كتحفة الأطفال والشاطبية والجزرية والبيقونية وغيرهم. 

مزايا التطبيق:
- قراءة القرآن بالرسم العثماني كما هو موجود في مصحف المدينة طبعة الملك فهد (الإصدار الأول والثاني)
- حفظ القرآن الكريم بالروايات عن طريق السماع والتسجيل والمطابقة
- الختمة ومتابعة الختمات (المعين)
- حصريا وللمرة الأولى تظليل آيات القرآن مع التلاوة على مستوى الكلمة في جميع سور القرآن وجميع قراء حفص عن عاصم
- إمكانية الضغط على أي كلمة وسماع تلاوتها بشكل منفصل
- إمكانية العرض على كامل مساحة الشاشات الخارجية باستخدام تقنية AirPlay للعرض اللاسلكي أو عن طريق التوصيل السلكي باستخدام AV Adapter
- إمكانية الرسم والتظليل على صفحات القرآن الكريم بغرض التعليم
- البحث الفوري في القرآن الكريم وكتب الحديث والمتون
- استماع التلاوة للعديد من القراء ولترجمات القرآن بعدة لغات
- تشغيل متواصل لصفحات كاملة وسور وأرباع وأجزاء والقرآن كاملا
- استمتع بالتشغيل في الخلفية
- إمكانية تعيين الآيات أو الأحاديث والمتون المراد حفظها وتكرارها
- إمكانية التحكم في سرعة القراءة للمراجعة السريعة
- سجل المتابعة لمعرفة نسبة الحفظ بحسب السور أو الأجزاء
- قراءة التفسير الموضوعي للقرآن الكريم
- قراءة أيسر التفاسير للشيخ أبي بكر الجزائري
- قراءة تفسير وترحمة معاني القرآن بعدة لغات
- التفسير الصوتي من الميسر في التفسير والمختصر في التفسير
- إمكانية متابعة حفظ الأحاديث على مستوى الفصول والأبواب والكتب والمصنفات
- إمكانية تحميل السور الكاملة وأبواب كتب الحديث دفعة واحدة
- إمكانية وضع الفواصل الذكية بألوان مختلفة وأسماء مميزة وتحريكها على الصفحات أو الآيات، حيث يمكنك تحديد كمية الورد واستقبال تنبيهات للتذكير بالقراءة.
- إمكانية كتابة الملاحظات النصية على الآيات
- إمكانية نسخ ومشاركة الآيات والأحاديث والمتون عبر شبكات التواصل الاجتماعي



Elmohafez app allows you to memorize the noble Qur’an according to the different qira’aat while using the Uthmani script. It also helps you memorize the Prophetic Sunnah and the mutoon (brief Islamic texts) in an easy way. All you have to do is choose the text, read it and listen to the recitation, and then record your voice as the text disappears. After the recording, the application shows the text along with your recorded voice for you to compare it and know how correct it is. You have the ability to follow your progress of memorization of the Qur’an or the books of hadeeth, and you can listen to your recording at any time.
Currently, the app supports the recitation of the Qur’an according to 20 different rewayaat (narrations) and 15 different reciters as well as the coloured Quran. It has Bukhari, Muslim and different mutoon such as “Tuhfat Al-Atfal”, “Al-Jazareyya”, “Ash-Shatebeyya” and other books.

Features
-Read the Qur’an according to the Uthmani script which is used in the mushaf that is printed at King Fahd Printing Complex.
-Listen to the recitation of many reciters.
-Control the speed of the recitation. This helps those who want to revise quickly.
-Choose any verse/hadeeth you want to memorize and repeat it several times.
- Draw and highlight on Quran pages for the purpose of teaching.
- Follow your progress of memorization of a chapter or part of the Qur’an.
- Read the topical interpretation of the Qur’an (tafseer mawdoo’ey).
-Help your children memorize the Qur’an.
-Supports displaying its content on an external display device (AirPlay/Cable).

bluejetty:00100331:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00100331:ios.description:
OnceWorld is a simple and casual 2D solo-play RPG.
Relive the charm of classic MMOs from the good old days — now reimagined for mobile with easy controls and deep progression!
Level up, reincarnate, raise pets, awaken equipment, collect materials, and battle in the arena — all in one nostalgic adventure.
It’s an RPG that brings the essence of those mid-2000s MMORPGs to your smartphone, blending nostalgia with modern convenience.
▼ Stat Distribution
Distribute points into seven basic stats to develop your character.
Points are earned as your hero levels up.
To reset your distribution, you’ll need a special item.
Stat meanings:
VIT – Increases HP
SPD – Attack speed & number of strikes
ATK – Physical attack power
INT – Magic attack power & SP capacity
DEF – Mainly physical defense power
M.DEF – Mainly magical defense power
LUK – Evasion & Physical Critical
▼ Weapons & Armor
Equip one weapon and five armor pieces.
Wearing all five pieces of a matching set grants a set bonus.
Use the heart icon at the top-left to toggle your favorite gear display.
▼ Equipment Enhancement
Use materials obtained during your adventures to enhance your gear.
Each enhancement attempt has a success rate — failure consumes the materials, but the item itself will never break.
Some special items can increase success rates.
▼ Accessories
Accessories grant special effects when equipped.
Defeating enemies while an accessory is equipped will level it up, enhancing its effects over time.
▼ Magic
Spend SP to cast powerful spells.
Magic attacks cannot be evaded and there are no critical hits.
Certain rare materials may further amplify spell power.
▼ Monsters & Pets
By carrying a special material, you’ll gain the ability to capture monsters.
Captured monsters become pets that grow stronger as they fight alongside you.
Some monsters learn skills as they level up.
These skills can activate even without being summoned, as long as the monster is accompanying you.
Pet switching can only be done at the Pet Keeper in your hometown.
Feeding specific materials will raise a pet’s stats.
▼ Monster Encyclopedia
Once defeated, monsters are added to the encyclopedia where their stats can be viewed.
Captured monsters will display a “Caught” mark.
▼ Materials
Materials are divided into three categories:
Normal Materials
　Used for equipment enhancement and trading.
Effect Materials
　Provide passive bonuses simply by owning them.
　Have a smaller carrying limit.
Key Items
　Only one can be held.
　Cannot be dropped or sold.
▼ Items
Items that grant various benefits during adventures.
You can assign them to shortcut slots for quick use in the field.
Swap registered items using the arrow icon beside the item list.
▼ Reincarnation
When your hero reaches the level cap, you can reincarnate.
Reincarnation resets your level but increases your level cap and available stat points, allowing for further growth.
▼ Abyss Corridor
A ranked mode that can be played a limited number of times per day.
Clear each floor by defeating all monsters as fast as possible — faster times rank higher.
Treasure chests appear as rewards on each floor.
Only Save Slot 1 is eligible for ranking participation.
▼ Arena
Watch monster battles.
Watch monster battles held several times a day.
Choose the strongest team from three teams and watch the battle.
Earn Arena Coins if your favorite team wins.
Try exchanging them for valuable materials at the Arena Shop.
▼ About the Kin-Slayer Rite ▼
The Kin-Slayer Rite
is a ceremony in which the target pet’s kin-bond, level,
and accumulated experience are all returned to zero
in exchange for enhancing its base stats.
A monster that undergoes this rite will gain experience
at a slower rate thereafter.

bluejetty:00043520:ios.description:
Discover Taqwa Time: your ultimate prayer companion
Stay effortlessly connected to your faith with Taqwa Time, the all-in-one prayer app designed for Muslims around the world. Simple, reliable, and intuitive, it brings together all the essential tools to support your spiritual practice every day. 
Main features:
- Accurate prayer times: Set your city automatically or manually to get precise daily prayer times, including a full monthly calendar view.
- Customizable widgets: Display prayer times or inspiring duas directly on your home screen.
- Qibla compass: Find the direction of Mecca with precision, even offline.
- Athan alerts: Get notified for each prayer.
- Morning and evening Azkar: Recite essential daily supplications at the right time.
- Selected Surahs: Access useful surahs for daily life, including Surah al-Mulk.
- Tasbih counter: Perform your dhikr with a clean and simple digital tasbih.
- Various duas: A collection of duas for different moments in life.
- Rabbana duas from the Quran: Easily access all invocations beginning with "Rabbana".
- The 99 Names of Allah: Ideal for reflection, memorization, and spiritual connection.
- Practical Omra guide: Step-by-step reminders and essential information for pilgrims.
- Add a city or use “My Location”: Get real-time, location-based prayer times wherever you are.
- Multilingual support: Available in English, French, Arabic, German, Turkish, Malay, Portuguese, Spanish, Indonesian, and Russian.
Support the developer:
Taqwa Time is a free app with no intrusive ads. If you find it useful, you can support the project by making a donation via Apple Pay directly from the app.

bluejetty:00180680:ios.summary:

• Check Border Wait Times: Use the app to check estimated wait times and open lane status 24
bluejetty:00180680:ios.description:
CBP Link is a mobile application that grants you access to a variety of services provided by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), including:
• Check Border Wait Times: Use the app to check estimated wait times and open lane status 24/7 at land ports of entry.
• Apply for a Provisional I-94: The I-94 Entry feature allows travelers to apply for a provisional I-94 prior to arriving at a land border crossing. Travelers who apply for their I-94 ahead of time will experience faster processing times to expedite entry. Travelers can also quickly access their current I-94 submission to view critical information such as, how long they can remain in the U.S., and use it for proof of visitor status once in the United States.
• Request an Inspection of Agriculture or Biological Products: If you are a traveler arriving at an airport of entry, you can request an inspection of biological materials, cleaning and disinfection of shoes worn on a farm or near livestock, or food items (e.g. fresh fruits and vegetables, meats), live animals (pets, service animals, emotional support animals), or hunting trophies.
• Submit a Travelers Manifest for Bus Operators: Create and submit an advance traveler manifest in compliance with the advance passenger information systems requirements.
Through a series of guided questions, the app directs you to the appropriate services based on your needs. The CBP Link mobile application is FREE to use and available to everyone who has access to a mobile device.

Become a legendary puzzle champion as you swipe, match, battle and blast your way through lands, in a quest to save Berk from the nefarious Dragonroot Company.  Join Hiccup and Toothless as you discover, breed and collect legendary dragons in the newest HTTYD puzzle RPG game on mobile!

BREED & NURTURE

bluejetty:00127767:ios.description:
上線即獲得獲得100萬以上真實下載, 【獨家特色 : 海量而龐大的三國戰役地圖，戰爭迷霧中自由探索, 三國英雄DOTA技能帶兵上陣熱血搏殺, 多英雄對決競技場, 副本試煉巨型BOSS】 真戰棋！真策略！可單機，可競技的深度戰棋融合RPG《策馬三國誌》讓您絞盡腦汁，廢寢忘食！
三國 + 英雄無敵的完美結合!
三國遊戲的全新演繹! 有深度!有策略! 
可單機可聯網的沈浸式三國策略遊戲!
全真實的五星玩家評價！
==傳承英雄無敵精髓，自由探索龐大地圖==
==單機劇情聯網競技，三國英雄無雙技能==
＊＊＊＊＊最新動態＊＊＊＊＊
劇情戰役的六個大章節全面開放：
第一篇 黃巾 : 從桃園結義到黃巾之亂的等6場戰役
第二篇 亂世 : 從勃海守衛戰到袁術的毀滅之路等10場戰役
第三篇 官渡 : 從白馬之圍到官渡之戰的6場戰役以及東吳崛起的4場戰役
第四篇章 赤 壁: 從江夏平叛到臥龍出山再到赤壁之戰, 華容道等12場三國最高潮的戰役
第五篇章 鼎立: 三氣周瑜, 單刀赴會, 定軍山, 逐鹿中原三分天下, 融匯更多新意玩法!!!
前三個篇章的戰役地圖已支持"精英模式"開啟, 更多挑戰，更多獎勵!更多高級橙色裝備可以通過積攢密寶碎片來免費獲取！
第四篇章《赤壁》12張劇情戰役已全部放出 : 江夏平叛, 臥龍出山, 火燒博望，長阪坡, 借東風, 火燒赤壁, 等眾多歷史經典戰役以及全新的水上船戰得以熱血重現！同時徐庶，諸葛亮，黃月英，甘寧, 龐統，孫權等經典三國英雄也同期閃亮登場! 
全新第六章節《夷陵》震撼來襲，包含（10張劇情地圖，5個新英雄，1個秘寶）新劇情地圖：大戰張魯，威震逍遙津，立嗣之爭，巧取漢中，水淹七軍，奇襲荊州，曹丕稱帝，夷陵之戰，火燒連營，安居平五路
新英雄：曹丕，甄姬，陸遜，大喬，司馬懿
文曲秘寶：掉落英傑冠，木牛流馬，烏雲踏雪，和氏璧
【娛樂地圖】
大型故事地圖包: 《曹操傳》上下篇已完整放出, 顛覆式的創新玩法歡迎挑戰！ 最新故事包《虎牢關》《山海傳說》《戰荊州》《鬼道幻境》以及最新的
絕地求生玩法:《絕地海島》
隨機自由探索玩法:《熱血群英閣》也已放出！
娛樂關卡《沃瑪試煉場》，全新Roguelike模式，每次冒險都是獨一無二。
目前開放有26張大型娛樂地圖, 15個故事劇情地圖包, 更多地圖和遊戲內容持續火熱開放中……
PVP競技場每月一個賽季，月中一個賽點， 火熱進行中!
多人合作聯機副本，讓老司機帶著新手飛起來～
＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊
----------------------------------------
＊＊＊＊＊遊戲特色＊＊＊＊＊
【戰役地圖自由探索，強力AI也會策略】
劇情地圖融合波瀾壯闊的三國史上的熱血經典戰役, 擯棄無腦點擊自動尋路模式，您可以控製英雄自由探索地圖的每一個角落。地圖上的強力AI也會使用策略，將給每位玩家帶來不小的挑戰。
【六角格回合製戰場，瞬息萬變步步驚心】
擯棄站樁打鬥比拼數值模式，采用手動操控六角格回合製戰場的經典玩法。每場戰鬥都具有不可預測性，哪怕對陣雙方陣容完全一致，兵種走位、法術施放、出手時機也會使得戰鬥的結果天差地別。
【英雄上陣熱血搏殺，創新技能進階升級】
三國名將悉數登場， 結合自身的屬性和技能, 也會有"刺客"、"法師"、"坦克"、"輔助"的這樣特長分類……遊戲擁有數十位可以親自上陣廝殺的英雄，每位英雄在戰場上都有自己的獨特定位和獨有技能，一次時機合適的技能施放足以改變整場戰鬥的結果。英雄的技能都可以進階升級，只要滿足了技能進階所需的屬性條件，就可以在原有技能的基礎上進一步提升技能效果。
【三大勢力五十兵種，戰術卡片豐富玩法】
遊戲目前開放魏、蜀、吳三大勢力，每個勢力都擁有自己獨有的主城外觀及兵種科技。遊戲中共有50余種造型、技能各異的兵種，更有可以加強兵種能力甚至改變攻擊方式的戰術技能卡，搭配出千變萬化的玩法。
【多英雄對決競技場，在線對戰比拼智慧】
英雄與兵種的配合是遊戲戰鬥的亮點。在競技場中，玩家可以同時控製兩個英雄、四隊小兵上場作戰，大大豐富了戰術選擇。與高手在線對決，根據不同的對手，選擇不同的英雄、兵種、戰術搭配，每一場戰鬥都是智慧的比拼。
【副本試煉巨型BOSS，多人合作樂趣無窮】
在副本試煉中玩家可以與他人一起挑戰多人副本，選擇自己喜歡的英雄組合，配合隊友闖關擊殺BOSS，不同的副本打法也不一樣，需要隊友有默契的配合,才能獲得最終的勝利。
【不怕數據丟失的單機遊戲】
只要玩家平時玩遊戲的時候聯網， 我們就會同時做好後臺的數據同步以備不時之需, 並且提供了應對誤刪遊戲的自助數據恢復功能, 讓廣大玩家放心玩耍！如果玩家更換了新的iOS設備, 可以使用遊戲設置界面裏的[賬號管理]功能, 自助進行新老設備之間的遊戲數據遷移。
最新重磅更新：
突破：新增【裝備覺醒系統】
老玩家等了3年，策馬三國誌[軍團系統]終上線
新英雄，新裝備，各類冷門裝備增強等等
另外：
策馬三國誌的姊妹篇，同屬於策馬三國系列, 但玩法絕然不同的硬派塔防遊戲，可單機戰役可競技場對戰，還有多人合作，包含海量魔獸rpg地圖模式的《策馬守天關》, 現已火熱推出, 史無前例的寫實!激烈!策略與操作並重的全新塔防玩法, 數百張覆蓋單人以及多人合作的娛樂玩法圖！ 歡迎廣大玩家前往下載體驗！

三國名將悉數登場， 結合自身的屬性和技能,  也會有"刺客"、"法師"、"坦克"、"輔助"的這樣特長分類……遊戲擁有數十位可以親自上陣廝殺的英雄，每位英雄在戰場上都有自己的獨特定位和獨有技能，一次時機合適的技能施放足以改變整場戰鬥的結果。英雄的技能都可以進階升級，只要滿足了技能進階所需的屬性條件，就可以在原有技能的基礎上進一步提升技能效果。

【三大勢力五十兵種，戰術卡片豐富玩法】
遊戲目前開放魏、蜀、吳三大勢力，每個勢力都擁有自己獨有的主城外觀及兵種科技。遊戲中共有50余種造型、技能各異的兵種，更有可以加強兵種能力甚至改變攻擊方式的戰術技能卡，搭配出千變萬化的玩法。

【多英雄對決競技場，在線對戰比拼智慧】
英雄與兵種的配合是遊戲戰鬥的亮點。在競技場中，玩家可以同時控製兩個英雄、四隊小兵上場作戰，大大豐富了戰術選擇。與高手在線對決，根據不同的對手，選擇不同的英雄、兵種、戰術搭配，每一場戰鬥都是智慧的比拼。

【副本試煉巨型BOSS，多人合作樂趣無窮】
在副本試煉中玩家可以與他人一起挑戰多人副本，選擇自己喜歡的英雄組合，配合隊友闖關擊殺BOSS，不同的副本打法也不一樣，需要隊友有默契的配合,才能獲得最終的勝利。

【不怕數據丟失的單機遊戲】
只要玩家平時玩遊戲的時候聯網， 我們就會同時做好後臺的數據同步以備不時之需, 並且提供了應對誤刪遊戲的自助數據恢復功能, 讓廣大玩家放心玩耍！如果玩家更換了新的iOS設備, 可以使用遊戲設置界面裏的[賬號管理]功能,  自助進行新老設備之間的遊戲數據遷移。

最新重磅更新：
突破：新增【裝備覺醒系統】
老玩家等了3年，策馬三國誌[軍團系統]終上線
新英雄，新裝備，各類冷門裝備增強等等

另外：
策馬三國誌的姊妹篇，同屬於策馬三國系列, 但玩法絕然不同的硬派塔防遊戲，可單機戰役可競技場對戰，還有多人合作，包含海量魔獸rpg地圖模式的《策馬守天關》, 現已火熱推出, 史無前例的寫實!激烈!策略與操作並重的全新塔防玩法,  數百張覆蓋單人以及多人合作的娛樂玩法圖！ 歡迎廣大玩家前往下載體驗！

bluejetty:00126440:ios.description:
Realize a superior clean with the new revolutionized Oral-B mobile experience.
Studies show that the average person brushes for only 30-60 seconds, compared to the dentist- recommended 2 minutes. Also, up to 80% of people spend an insufficient amount of time brushing in at least one zone of their mouth. This includes 60% of people who either don’t brush their back molars at all or don’t spend enough time when they do[1]. 
At Oral-B we strive to improve those stats to help deliver a superior clean. The breakthrough technology of the Oral-B Bluetooth® enabled toothbrushes seamlessly connects to the Oral-B app to deliver brushing intelligence at the next level. The Oral-B app is your digital coach to help you brush correctly as recommended by Dental Professionals.
Brush for a Clean that Wows
3D Teeth Tracking and A.I. Brushing Recognition[2] guides you in real-time as you brush. This ensures you cover all areas of your mouth and surfaces of your teeth. 
Assess Your Brushing Habits
Pull up your brushing data summary after each guided brushing session and view your brush score to quickly see just how well you did. 
Get Personalized Coaching
Receive individual coaching tips and insights tailored to your unique brushing behavior to see how you can improve the next time you brush. 
Access Personalized Insights at a Glance
Browse through your personal brushing coverage to see which areas you need to pay more attention to. You can also view high-pressure dentition maps to learn where you need to apply less pressure and view trends based on your recorded brushing history – all easily filtered by week, month, and year. 
Track Your Gum Bleeding
The unique Gum Guard[3] technology helps improve your brushing while protecting your gums. It includes an interactive gum bleeding tracker to help you capture instances of gum bleeding for better oral health.
Revolutionize Your Oral Health
Statistics show that brushing with an Oral-B connected toothbrush paired with the app will transform your brushing behavior. 
• Over 90% of brushing sessions last longer than the dentist-recommended 2 minutes with almost no instances of overly applied pressure
• Over 82% of people who brushed with Oral-B SmartSeries experienced a noticeable improvement in their oral health[4]
You can now connect Oral-B App with Apple Health App. This helps you track and review your brushing habits on the Apple Health App. We’ll motivate you to improve your brushing routine!
**The Oral-B app connects to Oral-B iO, Genius and Smart Series electric toothbrushes with Bluetooth 4.0 compatible devices**
**Check app.oralb.com for app availability and compatibility details**
[1] Oral-B Motion Tracking Research.
[2] 3D tracking only available at iO M9 model, AI Brushing Recognition available at iO Series & Genius X.
[3] Gum Guard available for all iO Series, Genius 10000 and Genius X models.
[4] After 6-8 weeks of use. Based on a practice-based trial with 52 subjects

Da Vinci Eye is used by millions of creat
bluejetty:00062117:ios.description:
As seen on Shark Tank and featured in Apple's Apps We Love, Watercolor Artist Magazine, Handmade Seller Magazine, LifeHacker, MakeUseOf, Fast Company (Innovation Award winner), Apple News and more!
Da Vinci Eye is used by millions of creatives from painters to bakers to make incredible artwork. The app is not just for tracing, it offers a wide range of drawing tools, lessons, daily drawing prompts, and a supportive community to share your artwork!
IMPORTANT!: Please read how this app works below and the device requirements for AR Mode BEFORE purchasing.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Create incredible artwork from your own photos
• Make hyper-realistic drawings with our strobe feature
• Record time-lapse videos of your drawings
• Separate images into layers by color value, then view those areas on your canvas
• Easily learn the fundamentals of drawing
• Breakdown any image into step-by-step instructions
• Video tutorials
• Use filters to make drawing even easier
• Zoom in to capture micro details in your drawings
• Connect with our community to share your artwork
• Insanely fast customer support!
PERFECT FOR ANY ARTIST
• Bakers
• Cartoonists
• Tattoo Artists
• Illustrators
• Fiverr Designers
• Hobbyists
• Makeup artists
• Nail Technicians
• Animators
No matter what skill level you’re at — Da Vinci Eye is here for you!
OVERVIEW
How many times have you been drawing a portrait for hours only to realize that the nose or the eye is in the wrong place? You can use Da Vinci Eye to layout artwork before you begin or even check your work as you progress.
Having a hard time seeing where lights or darks go? Breakdown images into layers by color value. Then virtually project those layers on top of your image. You can see exactly where to place the darkest darks, mid-tones, and highlights.
CAN'T THINK OF WHAT TO DRAW?
Check out our inspiration section for user uploaded reference photos. If you have a great pic, you can even upload your own content for other artists to draw.
LEARNING HOW TO DRAW?
We have lessons using our unique patent-pending learning method. You can also turn ANY photo into a step by step shading drawing lesson.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
Based on a tool that has been used by artists for centuries, this app is a digital version of a Camera Lucida.
You suspend your iPhone or iPad above or in front of your canvas with a stand, tall glass, or other objects easily found around your house. 
When you look through your phone, you will see both the image and the canvas simultaneously. It's similar in functionality to an art projector or light box, but with the ability to do so much more.
You can draw on any surface, zoom in to draw micro details in your drawing, and you don't have to draw in the dark.
WILL THIS HELP ME LEARN HOW TO DRAW?
Using Da Vinci Eye, you will be training your eye to recognize proportions and draw with shading while training your hand to translate precise lines and strokes on paper. You’ll learn faster and more efficiently using our proven techniques compared to any other app.
AR MODE REQUIREMENTS
To use AR mode, you must have an A10x or A11 processor and above. We recommend using:
– iPhone 8 and newer (iPhone 7 and below will not work)
– iPad Mini 5th Generation and newer
– iPad Air 2019 and newer
– iPad Pro 3rd Gen (Any pro made after 2018) and newer
AR & CLASSIC MODE
AR mode anchors your image to an object in the real world. This lets you move your canvas or phone, and the drawing and projected image will stay aligned.
Classic mode is like a normal art projector, where if you move your phone or canvas, the drawing will no longer be aligned.
AR mode is especially useful for drawing or painting on an easel. However, in most cases, Classic mode will achieve the same result.
TAKE YOUR DRAWING TO THE NEXT LEVEL
Download Da Vinci Eye today! No one ever regretted sharpening their drawing skills.
Terms of Use Link: http://davincieyeapp.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00155207:ios.description:
Welcome to Ten Match Master, a brain-teasing game that turns numbers into lively fun! It's easy to pick up but offers increasing challenges that push your limits and provide relaxation and addiction.
How to play:
- Simply click on two same numbers or numbers that add up to 10 to match them. The numbers must be adjacent vertically, horizontally, diagonally or at the beginning and end of two rows, with allowances for spaces between them.
- Each level has unique goals like clearing the board, collecting gifts, or overcoming obstacles, with challenges growing tougher as you progress.
Game Features:
- Super simple gameplay - anyone who knows numbers can play! Suitable for all ages, so invite your family and friends to join in!
- Highly challenging levels with increasing difficulty and richer rewards to keep you completely engaged.
- Daily surprises with special challenges outside regular levels.
- Various tools and items to help you achieve higher scores.
- Enjoyable music and beautiful scenes for an immersive, vacation-like relaxation experience.
- Play offline anytime, anywhere, and enjoy the game!
How to become a Ten Match Master:
- While the gameplay is simple, completing all levels is not easy—only a few players can do it! Strategize each move and its potential consequences, wisely utilize tools to maximize your progress. Think carefully and challenge yourself!

bluejetty:00015876:ios.summary:

Have you ever looked up a word, only to forget its meaning later?

bluejetty:00015876:ios.description:
*** Featured on the iTunes Home Page, and in Reference and Education *** 
Have you ever looked up a word, only to forget its meaning later?
Word Vault stores all the words you want to remember and helps you to internalize them. Mundane, exotic, functional, highfalutin: amass a cache of words you love, then learn them all.
We learn fastest with frequent exposure to new words. Use Word Vault as your regular dictionary app, and it will remind you to come back and review the words you've looked up. Reviews are quick, fun, and help you to get words out of your phone and into your brain.
Features:
- Robust offline English dictionary, and online lookup for esoteric words
- Vocabulary review system with a configurable schedule
- Pronunciations
- Images and Illustrations
- Translations (See note* below!)
- Auto-complete and spell-check suggestions
- Thesaurus functionality 
- Customization of your word list with notes, sources, and favorites
- Example sentences
- URL support, so you can look up words from other apps:
 wordvault://define?text=yourtext
If you'd like to get in touch for any reason, you can follow @chaoticgoodies on Twitter, or email contact@chaoticgood.com.
Psst, Educators: You can purchase Word Vault for students, teachers and administrators at a discount through Apple’s Volume Licensing Program!
*Translation functionality can be activated with a one-time in-app-purchase. Please note that translations are provided for the words looked up and not for definitions. Translations are provided via Microsoft Translator, which does not have a 100% accuracy rate, especially for isolated words without context. An upcoming update will include the ability to test translations in your language of choice before paying for the in-app-purchase, to help you better gauge the value of the functionality before paying.

bluejetty:00156369:ios.description:
Cuts, Shave, Cocktails & Pomades - all of what you love about Blind Barber is now in the palm of your hand. As we have always said, the barbershop isn't just a place to get a haircut or a shave. It's the hub of community – where people get together to connect, exchange ideas, just hang and feel like themselves. This new app from Blind Barber is here to further that mission, providing you with exclusive access to new product drops, easier booking processes and contactless payment methods for all aspects of Blind Barber. It’s never been easier to Stay Handsome.
The Good Stuff
Overall:
Single Profile Across all facets & locations of Blind Barber - Barber Shop, Bars and Product Purchases
Brand-wide Loyalty Program! Earn points for everything you do within the app and apply them anywhere! Earn points for getting a haircut and then turnaround and use those points at the bar.
Exclusive Access to hours of educational content whether that be new cocktail recipes, playlists from world renown Djs or seasonal hair trends
Early Access to new product offerings and collaborations.
Barber Shop Features:
Effortless Appointment Booking
“Save My Cut” Feature - allows you to save your favorite haircuts with notes to provide to any barber in the future. No more showing photos of Ryan Gosling as your reference!
Quick check out with Apple Pay

bluejetty:00091257:ios.description:
Welcome to Everydate, the activity dating app where your first date can be the start of something special. The best way to break the ice and alleviate first-date jitters is by engaging in a fun and exciting activity together. Dive into a world of unique date ideas while connecting with like-minded individuals who share your interests and passions.
▶ Discover Unforgettable Dates
Everydate reinvents the dating experience by letting singles post and like date ideas. Free your creativity and come up with unique date ideas for more likes. Personalized first date idea suggestions are available so you can stand out with a better profile. See all the first date ideas in one screen for a quick and convenient way to find the perfect match. No more endless swiping! Tap the heart icon to show interest and let the adventure begin!
▶ Engage with Your Likes
Never miss connecting with those who appreciates your date ideas. The app shows all the likes your date ideas receive, including the profiles of those who liked them. Take control of your dating journey by revisiting liked ideas, while initiating conversations with those who caught your attention. 
▶ Connect & Chat
Break the ice with unlimited chats. Enjoy meaningful conversations, photos, and plan your first date with like-minded singles. Everydate fosters genuine connections, letting you socialize and understand potential partners more deeply.
▶ Express Yourself
Highlight your unique personality and interests. Your profile is a chance to make a memorable first impression and attract like-minded partners. Utilize the photo album, intro features, along with our engaging question prompts, to craft a profile that paves the way for meaningful connections.
▶ Community Dating Feed
Need a platform for dating advice, sharing experiences, or mingling with a friendly community? Our Dating Feed has you covered. Post dating articles, create polls, seek advice on dating or relationships, and even share photos for encouraging esteem comments. Share funny and interesting dating stories, express yourself with memes and selfies, and connect with like-minded individuals on the Feed to foster a sense of belonging within our community.
▶ Safety & Authenticity
Your safety and the authenticity of our community is our top priority. We aim to provide a secure and respectful environment for all users. Profiles on Everydate undergo a thorough verification process, using advanced mechanisms to verify their authenticity and promote a genuine and trustworthy dating experience.
▶ Inclusive & Welcoming
Celebrating diversity, we cater to individuals of all orientations—straight, gay, bisexual, and in-between. We foster an inclusive community where everyone can find genuine connections and meaningful relationships. Whether you're seeking friends, exploring open relationships, or looking for that special someone, Everydate welcomes you with open arms.
Download Everydate now, the dependable dating app that caters to diverse interests and preferences. Match, chat, and date your way to fulfilling relationships and unforgettable experiences. Join our inclusive community today, showcase your personality, and embark on an exciting dating adventure. The possibilities are endless. Get ready to meet incredible individuals and create meaningful connections on Everydate! 
----------------------
While our app offers an exceptional experience without any costs and generous free features, we know that some crave a little extra. We offer optional subscription packages. 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at time of purchase.
- Subscription auto-renews unless turned off before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings in the iTunes Store.
Terms of Service: https://everydate.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://everydate.app/privacy

bluejetty:00032897:ios.description:
Apocalyptic adventures available now! Epic heroes, S equipment and many rewards await in the 7-day server events! Join the game now to fight the zombie apocalypse and save the world!！
Immerse yourself in this delightful casual shooting mobile game in Zombie.io where you take on the role of an adorable potato protagonist. 
The game unfolds in a world where extraterrestrial potatoes accidentally find themselves on Earth, forging an alliance with humans to combat the sudden zombie threat and save the world.
In the game, you can assemble a team of heroes and lead them on a mission to eradicate zombies and experience non-stop shooting intense action, and exciting gameplay features：
▼Endless Zombie Shooting▼
Unleash your shooting skills and face relentless waves of zombies as you strive to survive the apocalypse. Take down hordes of the undead with precise aim and strategic tactics.
▼ Mowing down Experience▼
Mow down the battlefield with your squad, creating pathways and obstacles for the zombies. Utilize the environment to your advantage and stay one step ahead of the undead.
▼ Gear Development▼
 Equip your heroes with powerful weapons, armor, and accessories to enhance their abilities and increase your chances of survival. Customize your loadout and discover unique combinations for each hero.
▼Assemble your combat team▼
Rescue more heroes on your way to escape and recruit them into your squad! Each hero masters different special skills, upgrade them and use the correct combat strategy to defeat the ultimate zombie boss!
▼ Roguelite Gameplay▼
 Experience the excitement of rogue-lite mechanics, where each playthrough is unique. Discover new skills, chapters, and challenges as you progress through the game. Adapt, strategize, and overcome the odds!
▼ Fighting alongside Friends▼
Meet more friends and embark on new adventures together. You can also build your own guild with your friends, working together to challenge powerful bosses for great rewards.
_______________

bluejetty:00078689:ios.description:
The best tournament app for managing brackets, leagues and individual scoreboards for any sport or game. Track scores live, create schedules, and share results instantly.
Competition formats:
• Create clear, visual structures. You can choose from Single Elimination, Double Elimination, Group Stage, Round Robin, Swiss System and Scorecard options. 
• Customize group stages, qualifiers, and participant flow according to your needs.
• Accommodate up to 64 players/teams, complete with personalized graphics, names, and avatars.
• 100+ Presets to choose from for participants and backgrounds and team shirt creator.
• Multiple Seeding methods: Standard bracket (1st vs 16th), Pot system (like Champions League), or Sequential order. Drag & drop adjustments available
Shareable instances:
• Collaborate with other organizers and keep everyone updated by sharing.
• Cross-platform support to share or get invitation from.
• Real-time updates and collaborative editing ensure that everyone stays informed about scores, match results, and overall progress.
• Spectators can also view matches in a read-only mode.
Organization:
• Overview for sharing essential details in one place.
• Participant registration with two modes: Invite specific players/teams or allow open signups before event start and verification codes.
• Set dates, times, and locations for matches across all formats.
• Follow specific matches and automatically receive calendar invites to your default calendar app for any changes.
Simple Interface:
• Tourney features an intuitive, minimalist design for both beginners and seasoned organizers.
• AI-powered text scanning to import participants from images. Works with handwritten lists, photos, and also text or csv file reader.
• Update winners, scores and match details with just a tap. Store players/teams to create even more, save time and merge them together.
Get started now. Core features are free to use and no ads.
https://tourneymaker.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00064244:ios.description:
Make tiny decisions the fun way.
Not sure what to eat, where to go, who starts first, or which option to choose? Add your choices to Tiny Decisions, spin the wheel, generate a random number, or flip a coin. The answer appears in seconds, turning everyday indecision into something quick and playful.
Great for:
- Choosing dinner, drinks, or weekend plans
- Picking who goes first or who pays
- Party games, Truth or Dare, and group challenges
- Giveaways, random draws, teams, and classroom picks
- Making quick choices when every option feels possible
Key features:
- Custom Wheels: Create your own wheel and edit options anytime
- Weighted Options: Adjust the chance of each option being selected
- Hide Weights: Keep the wheel looking clean and equal
- No Repeats: Perfect for draws, lists, teams, and turn-taking
- Finger Picker: Let everyone touch the screen and randomly pick a player
- Random Number Generator: Generate numbers within your own range
- Coin Flip: Get heads or tails with one tap
- Templates & Themes: Start fast and personalize the look
- Widgets & Apple Watch: Make decisions faster from your Home Screen or wrist
- iCloud Sync: Keep your wheels synced across Apple devices
- Share Wheels: Send your wheels to friends, family, or your group
Whether you are making a tiny personal choice or adding a little suspense to a group moment, Tiny Decisions helps you decide faster and makes the process more fun.
Subscription Details
Unlock premium features with a subscription via Apple. Payment is charged to your App Store Account upon purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal charges apply within 24 hours of the period’s end based on your plan. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings.
Get in Touch
X: @tinydecisions
Email: tangsuanhq@gmail.com
Terms: https://tinydecisions.app/terms
Privacy: https://tinydecisions.app/privacy

Introducing Techfusion News & Reviews: Your Vital News Hub for Insights in an Ever-Evolving Technical World. 
The Techfusion News & Reviews app is your key to unveiling tech's widespread influence in culture, commerce, science, and design.
bluejetty:00024498:ios.description:
Introducing Techfusion News & Reviews: Your Vital News Hub for Insights in an Ever-Evolving Technical World. 
The Techfusion News & Reviews app is your key to unveiling tech's widespread influence in culture, commerce, science, and design.
It is the one-stop destination for all your tech news needs, bringing together the latest updates from a wide array of tech-related sources. 
Here's what you can expect from our app:
Comprehensive News Aggregation: We gather the freshest tech news articles from various reputable sources, consolidating them into one convenient app to ensure you never miss out on the latest happenings in the tech world.
Save for Later: Bookmark articles within the app for easy access, allowing you to catch up on your reading at your convenience.
Customized Topic Search: Find articles that matter to you by searching for specific topics or keywords, making it effortless to explore the subjects that pique your interest.
Top Stories at a Glance: Easily navigate through the top headlines displayed prominently on the main page for quick updates on the most important tech news.
Share with Ease: Share articles with friends through various methods, including text, apps, or file folders, so you can keep your tech-savvy network informed.
Stay Informed: Check the publication date on top news articles to ensure you're always up to date with the latest developments.
Personalized News Feed: Block news sources you're not interested in, and if you change your mind, you can always unblock them later, tailoring your feed to your preferences.
Instant Notifications: Set up notifications to receive alerts as soon as your favorite topics hit the app, ensuring you never miss breaking news on subjects like Apple iPhone updates and more.
Suggest News Sources: Have a preferred news source not in our app? Suggest it, and we'll consider adding it to enhance your news experience.
Newsletter Subscription: Join our newsletter to receive regular updates directly in your inbox, ensuring you're always in the know.
Techfusion News & Reviews Features:
Diverse News Sources: Access a wide range of tech news outlets, including Wired, Spectrum, Popular Science, CNet, Clavax, eWeek, SciTech Daily, TechDirt, Apple Insider, The Verve, Social Media Explorer, and more.
Varied Topics and Companies: Explore news about Meta, Apple, SpaceX, iPhone, iPad, Mobile, Pixel, software launches, Wi-Fi, Spotify, YouTube, Social Media, AI, the latest gaming apps, and much more.
Tailored Experience: Don’t like a specific news source? No problem! Customize your app by blocking sources you don't want to see, ensuring your news feed is exclusively filled with content you're interested in.
Techfusion News & Reviews is the app that fuels your curiosity and keeps you informed and on the cutting edge of technology. Download it now to embark on a journey of technology discovery like never before!
Need Help?
https://loyalfoundry.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: 
https://www.loyal.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00182560:ios.name: Sudoku Multiplayer Challenge
bluejetty:00182560:ios.summary:
What better way to test your solving skills than against another worthy opponent! If you ever thought that you were a high-skilled Sudoku player, we have just the thing for you.
Sudoku Multiplayer, a carefully designed multiplayer game that
bluejetty:00182560:ios.description:
What better way to test your solving skills than against another worthy opponent! If you ever thought that you were a high-skilled Sudoku player, we have just the thing for you.
Sudoku Multiplayer, a carefully designed multiplayer game that allows you to play against other players online, push your Sudoku skills to the limits and keep your mind sharp!
Features:
- Single player mode
- Play with your friends for more prizes
- Challenging advancement
- Unlock harder levels as you progress
- Different modes available
Sudoku Multiplayer also features a single player mode where you can practice and earn coins and experience points for higher and more difficult levels. As you progress, you will face more difficult opponents but you will also earn more coins and experience points.
During your game you can opt-in for different modes:
- Notes mode: lets you enter a number when you are not absolutely sure and avoid making a mistake. Useful for future tactics as well!
- Turbo mode: once you select a number and fill the field, you can keep entering the same number without the need to click on the desired number every time.
Come back every day to play the Daily Challenge. Here you can practice your skills and earn medals for your games.
Sudoku Multiplayer is great for beginners but also for the experienced. You can go through the tutorial if you are new to this amazing puzzle game, but you can also quickly skip to the more challenging and mind-blowing multiplayer games to play against real players around the world and become a master Sudoku player!
----------------
Sudoku Pass Monthly Conditions:
- Your subscription lasts 1 month.
- You will be charged $4.99 for 1 month.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
- Your account will be charged for a renewed subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of current subscription. You will be charged $4.99 for 1 month.
- You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your account settings after purchase.
- You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
- Any unused part or time-span of a free trial period will be forfeited, as soon as you purchase a subscription.
- You can view our Privacy Policy here: https://www.hive5.studio/privacy-policy/
- You can view our Terms of Use here: https://www.hive5.studio/terms-and-conditions/

The easiest way to record, upload, and share high-quality videos from your phone.
Record and add videos to your emails to connect with prospects and customers when you can’t be there in person. Create and send internal videos for better communication and collaboration as remote work becomes the new norm. Share marketing video content across channels to make your message stand out.
FREE TO USE - No Credit Card Required
• Capture and share video quickly and easily
• Record unlimited high definition (HD) videos up to 1 hour each, for free
• Upload polished videos you’ve already created on your phone or using other apps
• Shoot videos when you’re out of the office or just need a change of scenery
• Access your entire library of videos (videos you create using Vidyard’s browser extensions or web application are accessible on your phone, and vice versa)

1. Download the app and create a free Vidyard account
2. Record or upload your video
3. Share it with your prospects, customers, or coworkers—and know when someone watches
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS OF USERS WORLDWIDE
Whether you’re in sales, marketing, real estate, customer success, internal communications, finance, product, design, or any other role or industry, Vidyard makes it easy to record high quality videos so you can communicate in the most effective way possible. Vidyard is loved by companies like Microsoft, LinkedIn, Hubspot, Salesforce, and more.
Trim your videos, select an animated GIF thumbnail, record your web browser screen, and more with Vidyard’s web application or Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge extensions—for free.

bluejetty:00091354:ios.description:
Run! Goddess is a fast-paced mobile game that combines parkour and shooting elements. Recruit powerful goddesses, each with unique abilities and weapons, to battle zombies, upgrade your base, and strive for survival in the Last War!
After a zombie virus devastates humanity, some young girls experience a dual awakening, becoming "Awakened Ones" with extraordinary strength. The Joint Front launches the Dawn Goddess Project, forming the Valhalla Special Ops Unit, the Dawn Valkyries.
These brave girls fight through hordes of zombies to rescue survivors and uncover the truth behind the disaster. Their epic story unfolds in a world of despair and hope.
■ Swift Minds, Faster Moves!
Embark on an exhilarating survival challenge, deftly dodging and battling endless waves of zombies. It's not just about reflexes; strategic thinking is key, as each lane presents unique obstacles and enemies waiting for you!
■ Build Your Secret Base
Customize your stronghold and expand your army of goddesses—you are the beacon of hope in this shelter, guiding survivors toward a brighter future. In this Shooting game, every decision you make in building and development will shape the fate of your survivors.
■ Tap to Open, Surprises Await!
Uncover mysterious treasure chests during your adventure! Tap to open them and receive amazing rewards and rare items to power up your combat and survival abilities.
■ Assemble Your Dream Team
Recruit a roster of unique, captivating anime goddesses to form your unstoppable squad. Each goddess wields distinct skills; strategically combine them to effortlessly conquer zombies and claim victory!
■ Unite for a Greater Cause
In a world teeming with zombies, survival is a team effort. Join forces with allied players to fend off the zombie threat—believe that the survivors stand with you.

As you gather more clues you’ll build up a picture of what happened and come to your own conclusion – successfully solve the crime to unlock the next case! 
----------------------------------------------

◆ More exciting cases coming soon!
Fans of crime and mystery books, puzzles, and challenging riddles will love our murder mystery game. With story-driven game-play and lots of different theories to explore for each case, you’ll be piecing clues together and solving crimes like Sherlock Homes or Poirot! 
DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO SOLVE EVERY CASE? DOWNLOAD TODAY & FIND OUT!

bluejetty:00165311:ios.description:
Unleash your creativity with our cutting-edge design app, tailored to transform your ideas into stunning visual masterpieces effortlessly. Whether you're a professional designer or a beginner, our app offers an intuitive editing panel that makes creating posters, flyers, stories, and posts a breeze. With a plethora of customizable templates at your fingertips, you'll be able to craft eye-catching designs that capture attention and convey your message effectively.
Our app is packed with an extensive library of backgrounds, shapes, stickers, and fonts, providing you with all the tools you need to create unique and memorable designs. Choose from thousands of high-quality templates, each designed to be easily customizable to fit your specific needs. Whether you're promoting an event, advertising a product, or simply expressing your creativity, you'll find the perfect template to get started.
The user-friendly editing panel is the heart of our app, offering a seamless design experience that allows you to make quick adjustments and see your changes in real-time. Our app is designed to be accessible to everyone, regardless of your design experience, making it simple to bring your ideas to life.
In addition to posters and flyers, our app also excels at creating captivating stories and posts. With templates specifically designed for social media, you can ensure your content stands out in the crowded online landscape. Share your designs directly from the app to your social media accounts, or save them to your device for later use.
Discover the joy of effortless design with our all-in-one poster, flyer, and social media content creator. Whether you're creating content for personal use or professional purposes, our app provides you with everything you need to succeed. Download now and start creating beautiful, high-impact designs today!

bluejetty:00131740:ios.name: Medication Reminder & Pill Log
bluejetty:00131740:ios.summary: Medication Reminder & Pill Log brings your medications, vitals, symptoms, and health history together in one place. Stay on top of medication schedules with reliable reminders while tracking blood pressure, glucose, heart rate, symptoms, an
bluejetty:00131740:ios.description:
Medication Reminder & Pill Log brings your medications, vitals, symptoms, and health history together in one place. Stay on top of medication schedules with reliable reminders while tracking blood pressure, glucose, heart rate, symptoms, and more.
Featured by Apple in "Apps We Love Right Now," Medication Reminder & Pill Log is a complete health journal, medication tracker, and wellness companion from the team behind the award-winning Sprout health apps trusted by families since 2010. Log medications, record vital health metrics, and see meaningful trends over time. Your health information stays private and syncs securely through iCloud.
Stay on Top of Every Dose
• Personalized, reliable reminders help you keep track of medication schedules and completed doses.
Track Health Metrics with Ease
• Track blood pressure, glucose, heart rate, weight, symptoms, and more. Visual charts help you see trends and understand changes in your health data over time.
Caregiver & Family Sharing
• Securely share health data, schedules, and activity updates with caregivers or family members. Receive real-time updates when medications are taken and schedules are completed.
Doctor-Ready Reports
• Generate a detailed PDF summary from the medication and health information you enter in the app. Review your history and share helpful information with your healthcare provider.
Quick Logging with Siri & Widgets
• Save time with home screen widgets and voice commands. Log medications and check health stats in seconds.
Create Multiple Profiles
• Manage health profiles for the whole family. Keep medications, vitals, symptoms, and other health information organized for each person you care for.
Private by Design
• No account required. Your data stays on your device and syncs privately through iCloud. We never sell or share your information.
All-in-One Health Tracking
• Customizable medication reminders tailored to your schedule
• Comprehensive tracking for blood pressure, glucose, heart rate, weight, symptoms, and pain
• Insightful charts and summaries to see health trends over time
• Secure sharing with family and caregivers, including real-time activity updates
• Fast logging with Siri and home screen widgets
• Support for multiple health profiles in a single app
• Dark Mode for comfortable viewing at any time
Helpful for Tracking:
• Diabetes-related health data
• Blood pressure and hypertension-related health data
• Heart health information
• Chronic health conditions
• Pain and symptoms
• General health and wellness
Auto-Renewing Subscriptions, Payments and Cancellation
If you choose to purchase a Premium subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://sprout-apps.com/privacy-policy.html
Please note: This app does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your healthcare provider for any medical concerns.
About Sprout
Sprout creates intuitive tools for health, pregnancy, baby care, and fertility. Our apps support individuals and families through every stage of life and help keep important information organized and accessible.
Need help? Contact us at support@sprout-apps.com.

Страховые компании меняют базовую ставку в пределах тарифного коридора. Поэтому цены на ОСАГО при прочих равных отличаются у разных страховщиков. Мы поможем сравнить предложения 20 компаний и выбрать самое экономичное. Все цены как на сайтах страховых, без скрытых комиссий и надбавок.

• Надежно

bluejetty:00172047:ios.name: Mobility Coach
bluejetty:00172047:ios.summary:
The Only Clinically-Proven Mobility App to Relieve Pain, Increase Sports Performance, and Get You Moving Better In Every Area of Your Life.
The Mobility Coach App is the go-to program for over 100,000 recreational and professional athletes
bluejetty:00172047:ios.description:
The Only Clinically-Proven Mobility App to Relieve Pain, Increase Sports Performance, and Get You Moving Better In Every Area of Your Life.
The Mobility Coach App is the go-to program for over 100,000 recreational and professional athletes, coaches, personal trainers, and everyday movers. Designed by Dr. Kelly Starrett, renowned physical therapist and 3x New York Times Bestselling author, this is the only clinically proven program that:
→ Enhances mobility, flexibility & range of motion
→ Prepares you to tackle your favorite sport or workout with ease
→ Helps you address nagging pain
→ Serves up a fresh, new mobility video each day
→ Tests your mobility and provides personalized video prescriptions to improve your bodywide function
→ Gives you live access to Dr. Kelly Starrett each month via Q&A sessions
With a library of over 1,000 hours of expert-led mobility content, the Mobility Coach App delivers daily videos ranging from 5 to 30 minutes, as well as an entire library of on-demand videos to choose from based on your needs each day. Each session zeroes in on your biggest limitations to help you move better, recover faster, and get back to doing what you love.
↓↓ Check out what’s inside ↓↓
MOBILITY TEST: MEASURE YOUR BASELINE & PROGRESS
Begin your journey with our comprehensive Mobility Test, developed by Dr. Kelly Starrett himself. This guided self-assessment evaluates key areas—Trunk, Shoulders, Hips, and Ankles—giving you a Mobility Score that highlights areas to improve. Your results feed directly into the app’s recommendations, ensuring a mobility program that adapts to your unique needs.
PAIN RELIEF: BODY PART BY BODY PART
Experiencing discomfort? The Mobility Coach App's ‘Pain Map’ lets you pinpoint problem areas on an interactive body chart, offering targeted mobilizations to help alleviate pain and enhance recovery.
PRE & POST SPORT RECOMMENDATIONS: TRAIN LIKE A PRO
For athletes and active individuals, the app offers specialized ‘Sport-Specific’ videos designed for both pre- and post-activity. Whether you’re gearing up for a heavy lift, recovering from a long run, or prepping for your favorite sport, these guided mobilizations keep your body in peak condition.
DAILY MOBILITY: FRESH CONTENT EVERY DAY
Our ‘Daily Mobility’ section brings you a brand-new guided session each day, perfect for building a consistent mobility routine. Want to target specific areas or adjust the session length? Use the filter feature to find the right video for your needs.
CUSTOM MOBILITY PLAYLISTS
Your mobility journey is personal. Now, with ‘Custom Mobility Playlists’, you can handpick videos and design routines around your unique goals. Perfect for recovery days, pre-workout warm-ups, or specific body areas, this feature gives you the flexibility to build a playlist that fits your life. Want to share your routines with others? Make your playlists public and spread the love.
HABIT ALARM & DAILY CHECK-IN
Staying consistent is key, so we built tools to help you build the habit. Set a ‘Habit Alarm’ to remind you to mobilize at your preferred time each day. Then, use the Daily Check-In to track your progress, record how you feel, and keep a running log of your mobility journey.
LEADERBOARDS, STREAKS & BADGES
Celebrate your wins and stay accountable with ‘Leaderboards, Streaks, and Badges’. See how you stack up against other users, keep the streak alive, and unlock achievements as you go!
BONUS CONTENT
→ Mobility Challenges designed to improve ROM across key areas of the body
→ Live Q&A sessions with Dr. Kelly Starrett each month
→ Free First Aid Protocol (worth $99)
→ Free Foam Rolling Protocol (worth $99)
As a member of the Mobility Coach App, you have everything you need to improve your mobility, alleviate pain, and boost your athletic performance—all while tracking your progress and building a sustainable routine.
We follow Apple's standard EULA: 
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00018554:ios.description:
Tired of chaotic grocery trips and always asking, "What's for dinner?" Stop juggling messy paper lists and endless texts. AnyList is the #1 app for busy families, couples, and anyone who wants to shop smarter and simplify weekly meal planning.
Finally, a shopping list that’s always in sync, a recipe box that’s always in your pocket, and a meal plan that everyone can see. It's the organization you've been craving.
Trusted by millions. As seen in The New York Times, Good Housekeeping, The Kitchn, and featured by Apple as one of "10 Essential Apps".
“Helped me save so much time, money, and mental energy” —Patty Catalano, The Kitchn
“Sets the standard for grocery list apps” —AppStorm
“Simple and intuitive” —Lifehacker
----
SHOP TOGETHER, EFFORTLESSLY
Instantly share your grocery list with your partner or roommates. Watch items get checked off in real-time as they shop — no more buying the same thing twice!
• BUILD LISTS IN SECONDS: Our smart autocomplete suggests items as you type.
• NEVER MISS A THING: Add a list to your home screen with our widgets, or add items with your voice using Siri and Alexa.
• SHOP YOUR WAY: Lists automatically sort into categories (Produce, Dairy, Deli, etc.) that can be re-arranged to match your store's layout, saving you time and steps.
• THE PERFECT ITEM, EVERY TIME: Add notes for brand, quantity, or even a photo to make sure you get exactly what you want.
YOUR COMPLETE RECIPE & MEAL PLANNING HUB
Stop searching through cookbooks and browser tabs. Organize all your favorite recipes in one place and turn them into shopping lists with a single tap.
• IMPORT IN A SNAP: Save recipes directly from your favorite blogs and websites.
• PLAN YOUR WEEK: Assign recipes to days on the meal planning calendar. Know what you're making and when.
• INSTANT SHOPPING LISTS: Add all ingredients from a recipe to your grocery list in one go.
Download for FREE and transform your grocery shopping and meal planning today!
UNLOCK THE FULL POWER OF ANYLIST COMPLETE
Ready to take your organization to the next level? Upgrade to AnyList Complete for the ultimate home management experience:
• AnyList on Your Desktop & Watch: Access your lists and recipes on your Mac, PC, and Apple Watch.
• Meal Planning Calendar: The easiest way to plan your family's meals for the week and create a perfectly coordinated shopping list.
• Import Recipes from the Web: Save recipes directly from thousands of recipe blogs and websites.
• Add Photos to Items & Recipes: End confusion at the store by adding a photo of the exact item you need.
• Stick to Your Budget: Add item prices as you shop to see your running total.
• Advanced Store Features: Assign items to specific stores, create location-based reminders, and filter your list on the fly.
• And so much more: Recipe scaling, list themes, passcode lock, and folders.
Join millions who have made shopping and meal planning stress-free. Get AnyList now!
For a full list of available features, check out our website: anylist.com/features
Got questions? We'd love to hear from you: team@anylist.com

bluejetty:00128398:ios.name: MOVE! Coach
bluejetty:00128398:ios.summary: MOVE! Coach Mobile is a weight loss app for Veterans, service members, their families, and others who want to lose weight. This 16-week program guides users to successful weight loss or weight management through education, and use of tools,
bluejetty:00128398:ios.description:
MOVE! Coach Mobile is a weight loss app for Veterans, service members, their families, and others who want to lose weight. This 16-week program guides users to successful weight loss or weight management through education, and use of tools, in an easy and convenient way. Users can monitor, track, and receive feedback regarding their progress with weight, diet, and exercise goals.
Some Key Features:
Self-Management Modules – Educate users on a variety of weight-management success strategies using videos, worksheets, games, and other tools. Modules are made available weekly based on your progression through the 16-week program.
Tracker – Assists users to track weight daily, set weight loss and SMART goals, and see progress reports and summaries
Tools – Provides users with calculation tools and tools to manage stress
Support – Helps users identify supports and resources for successful weight loss
This app can be used by itself, but additional benefit may be achieved if used in combination with treatment with your healthcare provider and by tracking health & fitness activity with third-party HealthKit compatible apps. If you’re just starting out, MOVE! Coach can access your existing HealthKit height and weight data, and synchronize your progress recording weight entries with Apple’s Health app.
MOVE! Coach Mobile was created by the National Center for Health Promotion and Disease Prevention (NCP), under VHA’s Office of Patient Care Services.

Get ready to experience the thrill of world-class cycling!
Road Cycling: World Tour Bike Race puts you in the saddle of powerful racing bikes as you compete across stunning global locations. Race through cities, mountains, countryside roads, and exotic landscapes in a dynamic cycling experience designed for mobile.
Race & Win:
Compete against skilled riders and push your limits to cross the finish line first. Each victory brings you closer to becoming the ultimate cycling champion.
Earn & Upgrade:
After every race, collect rewards and invest in your progress. Improve your speed, handling, and earnings to stay ahead of the competition.
Unlock New Bikes & Riders:
Choose from a wide variety of bikes, each with unique stats and styles. Unlock new characters and personalize them with accessories to showcase your unique racing identity.
Diverse Locations & Levels:
From winding mountain passes to bustling city streets, every track offers new challenges and excitement. Master your control, adapt to the environment, and outsmart your rivals.
Why You’ll Love It:
- Fast-paced, action-packed cycling races
- Realistic road biking feel with smooth controls
- Upgradable stats: speed, handling, and income
- Unlockable bikes, riders, and accessories
- Multiple levels with increasing challenges
- Stunning locations and immersive gameplay
Are you ready to take your place on the world stage of road cycling? Prove your skills, build your dream cycling team, and race your way to glory in Road Cycling: World Tour Bike Race!

bluejetty:00155651:ios.name: Drift Action
bluejetty:00155651:ios.summary:
On this mysterious island, there are abundant treasures hidden. When you, as an explorer, are captivated by the scenery on the island, it is not safe. You need to constantly worry about monsters' surveillance while harvesting wealth.
Facing
bluejetty:00155651:ios.description:
On this mysterious island, there are abundant treasures hidden. When you, as an explorer, are captivated by the scenery on the island, it is not safe. You need to constantly worry about monsters' surveillance while harvesting wealth.
Facing the attacks of monsters, you are not fighting alone! Constantly recruiting partners from various professions, utilizing your command skills, and using your wisdom to resolve every wave of attacks, you will also receive rich rewards as a result.
Features
-The thrilling Roguelike gameplay fills every adventure with unknowns and surprises! Do we prioritize boosting the character's strength or fortifying the soldier's defense? Making the best choice with limited resources is one of the key considerations.
-Every time you land on an island, you will encounter multiple mysterious maps and various strange monsters. This will broaden your horizons, continually enhance your combat abilities, unlock additional maps, and reveal increasingly astonishing monster attack methods.
-You can freely recruit your favorite career partners and engage in battles alongside characters featuring diverse combat styles. In various situations, different roles will excel, so you need to devise a sensible personnel plan to facilitate your battles.
-As your character's level continues to rise, it will trigger character awakening. Upon awakening, not only will the character's combat power be significantly enhanced, but new skill talents and appearances will also be unlocked. Your character will then unleash unprecedented power, transforming into a true powerhouse.
-Beyond the standard gameplay, 'Drift Action' boasts numerous enjoyable options. These include using magic to decimate hordes of zombies and claim treasure chests, manipulating blocks to rescue the king trapped in a dungeon, and many other unique gameplay modes awaiting your discovery.
What are you waiting for? Join the adventure force of "Drift Action" now and write your legendary chapter on this fantastical continent with players worldwide!

Sortly is an easy, mobile inventory management solution trusted by over 20,000 businesses. 
With Sortly, you can track, organize, and manage your inventory—from any device, in any location. It’s so simple and intuitive that you can start tracking inventory in minutes. 
Sortly comes equipped with smart features like barcoding & QR coding, low stock alerts, customizable folders, data-rich reporting, customizable access, and more. Manage inventory from your smartphone in real-time—whether you’re on the job, in the warehouse, or on the go. Track inventory, supplies, parts, tools, equipment, and anything else that matters to your business. 
Whether you’re just getting started with inventory management or you’re an expert looking for a better solution, Sortly can transform how you manage inventory—so you can focus on building your business. Join the over 20,000 businesses that trust us as their inventory management solution and download Sortly today.
KEY FEATURES OUR CUSTOMERS LOVE:
- Any device, any location 
- Mobile barcode & QR code scanning
- Barcode & QR code label generation
- Custom folders
- Custom fields & tags
- Low stock alerts 
- Date-based alerts
- Item photos
- Pick lists
- Inventory reporting
- Customizable user access
- Offline access
- Automatic syncing across all devices, all users
- Easy inventory import
- Excellent customer support
===============================================================
NOTES ABOUT SORTLY SUBSCRIPTIONS
Sortly is available to download for free, however some features are restricted. To unlock, you must purchase either a monthly or annual subscription. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period as per the price shown above.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Sortly Terms of Service: https://www.sortly.com/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://www.sortly.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00084996:ios.name: Diarium Journal: Private Diary
bluejetty:00084996:ios.summary:
Keep a private diary and daily journal for memories, photos, mood, travel, gratitude, and everyday notes—with no ads or subscriptions.
Diarium helps you capture what happened today and build a personal timeline you can return to for years.
bluejetty:00084996:ios.description:
Keep a private diary and daily journal for memories, photos, mood, travel, gratitude, and everyday notes—with no ads or subscriptions.
Diarium helps you capture what happened today and build a personal timeline you can return to for years. Write a quick reflection or a detailed entry, enrich it with the moments that matter, and protect everything with a password, PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID.
Make each entry your own
• Keep a personal diary, gratitude journal, bullet journal, photo diary, or travel journal
• Add photos, drawings, audio recordings, files, tags, people, ratings, and locations
• Track your mood with star ratings and tracker tags
• Revisit memories through calendar, timeline, and travel map views
• Organize thoughts with lists and text formatting
• Set daily reminders to support your writing routine
Bring the details of your day together. Diarium can add useful context from your camera roll, calendar events, weather, completed tasks, Apple Health and other fitness activity, social activity, and entertainment activity.
Moving from another journal? Import from Apple Journal and supported diary apps including Day One, Diaro, Journey, Daylio, Diarly, Daybook, and Evernote. You can also back up your diary database and export entries as Word, HTML, JSON, or plain text.
Continue your journal across supported phone, tablet, laptop, and desktop versions. Optional sync uses your own iCloud, OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, or WebDAV storage, so you do not need a separate Diarium account.
Diarium is made for the story of everyday life: reflections, family memories, trips, photos, gratitude, feelings, and small moments worth remembering. It remains personal, flexible, and secure whether you write daily or only when inspiration strikes.
Diarium is free to use, with optional Diarium Pro for advanced features such as sync, unlimited attachments per entry, Word export for printing, connected feeds, custom fonts, widgets, and weather in entries. You can evaluate Pro features for 7 days after installing.
Diarium Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It is linked to your Apple ID and unlocks Pro for iOS and iPadOS; a separate Pro purchase may be required on other platforms.

bluejetty:00172495:ios.description:
RNE Audio es una plataforma gratuita de audio bajo demanda con todos los directos y programas de RNE así como sus contenidos originales. Entra, regístrate y sigue tus programas y podcast favoritos, elabora tu propia playlist, descarga los mejores contenidos o retoma la escucha de un audio.
En la portada de RNE Audio puedes encontrar un rápido acceso a la emisión en directo de todas las emisoras de RNE (Radio Nacional, Radio Clásica, Radio 3, Ràdio 4, Radio 5 y Radio Exterior) con las caras de los presentadores que están en antena en ese momento en cada cadena. ¡Solo tienes que pinchar encima para empezar a escucharla! Además, también puedes disfrutar de los streamings exclusivos de RNE Audio, como conciertos, retransmisiones deportivas o programas especiales.
Queremos que tú seas el que decidas qué quieres escuchar y cuándo, y para que no te pierdas nada, en RNE Audio están organizados los contenidos en colecciones como “Tendencias de la semana”, “Te recomendamos”, “Música para todos”, “Documentales”, “Si te gustan los libros”, “True crime”, “Actualidad”, “Ciencia y tecnología”, “Historia”, “Arte y espectáculos”, “Viajes sonoros”, “Deportes”, “Educación y divulgación”, “Nostalgia”, “Igualdad” y “Servicio público”. Si buscas un programa o podcast en particular, podrás hacerlo rápidamente a través del buscador.
Si eres un amante de los podcast, no te pierdas los contenidos RNE Audio. Además de sus producciones originales, entre las que destacan sus series documentales y sus ficciones sonoras, podrás encontrar también los podcast musicales de Radio 3 Extra y los culturales de RNE Audio.
Si prefieres disfrutar de los contenidos de RNE, en la “Parrilla” podrás consultar toda la programación diaria y pinchar en cada uno de los programas para acceder a sus últimos audios, y en “Territoriales” podrás escuchar la emisión en directo de cada una de las emisoras territoriales de RNE así como los programas informativos regionales y provinciales.
