bluejetty:00068760:ios.description:
MTG Trades gives you the tools you need for trading Magic cards, right at your fingertips. It includes card prices by expansion or card name, lets you evaluate trades and view your trade history, store a watchlist of wanted cards, and allows you to track cards you have loaned or borrowed.
Features: 
• View price information for every physical Magic card by individual printings.
• Supports non-foil and foil pricing for all cards, including many promo cards, tokens and emblems.
• Download database and automatic prices updates from within the app, for offline use (requires Premium).
• Save cards to various Want Lists so you always know what you're looking for during trades and how much they're worth (requires premium for multiple lists) 
• Want Lists show total value and can be sorted alphabetically, by price or by rarity.
• Enter cards or cash in a new Trade to quickly evaluate the equity of the trade. 
• Store a history of your past trades along with current and at-the-time price information (requires premium for multiple trades)
• Track cards you have lent out or borrowed from other people. 
• Prices are aggregated from a range of online stores courtesy of TCGplayer.com.
• Complete iCloud syncing. 
• Supports Dynamic Type for altering text size.
• Universal app for iPhone, iPad and Mac (as iPad app).
• Supports iPad multitasking.
This app has been carefully designed to be simple and fast to use. 
If you have any suggestions for improvements, please suggest them from within the app.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
This app is not produced or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

AlerWX delivers real-time weather intelligence directly from the National Weather Service (NWS), giving you instant access to Weather Forecast Office (WFO) products, severe weather alerts, radar data, forecasts, and more—all in one powerful platform.
Designed for emergency responders, storm spotters, weather enthusiasts, and anyone who depends on timely weather information, AlerWX helps you stay informed before, during, and after severe weather events.
Features:
• Live NWS Weather Forecast Office Feeds
Follow your preferred National Weather Service Weather Forecast Offices and receive real-time access to forecasts, discussions, advisories, warnings, and other issued products.
• 10-Day Local Forecasts
Stay ahead of changing conditions with detailed local forecasts and current weather information for your area.
• SPC & WPC Outlooks
View the latest outlooks and guidance from the Storm Prediction Center (SPC) and Weather Prediction Center (WPC) directly within the app.
• Interactive Weather Radar
Track storms with a built-in interactive radar featuring advanced products including Super-Resolution Reflectivity, Super-Resolution Velocity, and Additional radar products and layers!
• NOAA Weather Radio Streams
Listen to community-operated NOAA Weather Radio streams provided through multiple resources!
• Push Notifications
Receive instant updates from your selected Weather Forecast Offices and stay informed as new products and alerts are issued.
• Critical Emergency Alerts
Customize alert types in app to be pushed as Critical Alerts to your device! Users can also choose to receive Tornado Emergencies, Flash Flood Emergencies, and Tsunami Warnings nationwide, regardless of selected WFOs.
• Widgets (iOS 18+)
Stay informed at a glance with Current Conditions widgets available for iOS 18 and later.
• Spotter Network Integration
Connect with Spotter Network directly within AlerWX for enhanced situational awareness during active weather events.
Whether you’re monitoring severe weather, tracking storms, or staying informed on daily forecasts, AlerWX provides the tools and information you need to stay prepared.
Download AlerWX today and stay ahead of the storm.

bluejetty:00174004:ios.description:
Idle business simulator and tycoon game with a post-apocalyptic and zombie survival theme. The world has ended, and you're running a post-apocalyptic trading post!
Your management skills will make the difference between survival and extinction. Build your outpost, trade with survivors, and expand your empire in this thrilling mega-simple 2D game with a gritty, immersive atmosphere.
When the night comes, fight off silly zombies!
Start with a small scrapyard outpost and grow your trading empire!
Begin with just a basic outpost in the desert, then upgrade and expand as you earn resources and profits. As you progress, discover new locations, from abandoned gas stations to underground vaults, and build the most prosperous post-apocalyptic trading network in the world!
There will be a ton of post-apocalyptic locations.
Venture from arid deserts to lush forests, encountering bandit camps, winter hideouts, and high-tech trading hubs. With each new level, unlock stunning new locations and challenges for your trading post.
Idle Outpost is perfect for players who love:
— Post-apocalyptic and survival-themed games
— Business simulation and tycoon games
— Building and managing virtual empires
— Engaging single-player experiences

— Free-to-play games that offer hours of entertainment
Embark on a journey of survival, commerce, and growth in Idle Outpost, the ultimate post-apocalyptic trading post simulator. Can you build the most prosperous trading empire in the new world? Download now and find out!

bluejetty:00095353:ios.description:
Shelog - A Hand-Drawn Health Diary for Everyday Wellness
Shelog is an AI-powered calorie tracker and health diary designed to make your wellness journey feel more personal, visual, and encouraging.
At its core, Shelog helps you track calories, log meals, and understand your nutrition. But it is more than a calorie counter. Shelog brings food, mood, exercise, water, daily encouragement, and personalized wellness ideas together in one warm diary-style experience.
AI Calorie Tracking
Log meals with less effort. Take a photo, search foods, or describe what you ate, and Shelog helps you record calories and nutrition details more easily. You can track calories, carbs, protein, fat, food history, and daily progress with clear summaries and charts. Shelog also lets you search foods from a nutrition database powered by FatSecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com).
A Hand-Drawn Health Diary
Shelog is built around a soft, hand-drawn diary style. Your health journey does not need to feel like a spreadsheet. Meals, moods, water, exercise, and body progress can all become part of a visual diary that feels expressive, personal, and easy to return to.
Track More Than Calories
Your wellness story is bigger than food alone. Shelog helps you record different parts of your daily life, including:
- Food and calorie intake
- Mood logs
- Exercise records
- Water intake
- Weight progress
Films: Decorate Your Daily Moments
Make your diary feel like yours. With Shelog's Films system, you can decorate food, exercise, and mood photos with different instant-photo-inspired styles. Turn everyday logs into a beautiful collection of personal moments.
Daily Vibe
Start the day with a little encouragement. Daily Vibe gives you an uplifting card to bring more energy, warmth, and motivation into your routine. It is a small daily reminder that your journey deserves care, not pressure.
Routine+
Routine+ is your personalized wellness card system inside Shelog. It can recommend meals for the day, answer health and nutrition questions, and help you build your own wellness cards and challenges.
Routine+ can also create My Fitness Plan: beginner-friendly plans for real everyday life, including bodyweight workouts at home, home equipment training, or gym workouts. The goal is simple: help ordinary users actually get moving, with plans that feel easy to start and useful for making your health journey more efficient.
Built for a Kinder Health Journey
Shelog is designed with women in mind, but made for anyone who wants a gentler way to track health. Whether you are managing calories, improving hydration, moving more, or simply trying to understand your habits, Shelog helps you keep going with clarity and care.
Shelog can help you:
- Track calories and macros
- Keep a visual food diary
- Record mood, exercise, and water intake
- Decorate photos with Films
- Receive Daily Vibe encouragement
- Get meal ideas and My Fitness Plan from Routine+
- Create personalized health cards and challenges
Download Shelog today and make your wellness journey easier to see, easier to record, and easier to love.
Disclaimer: We do not provide medical advice. All recommendations are general suggestions only. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any new calorie, nutrition, hydration, or exercise plan.
INFORMATION ON USING THE APP AND REGARDING SUBSCRIPTION
The Shelog app is free to download and use. To unlock the full range of features, you can choose from various subscription plans. Prices are shown in the app by country. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current term expires. You can disable auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.
Shelog Terms of Service: https://www.shelog.ai/terms
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.shelog.ai/privacy
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us at support@shelog.ai.

As the UK’s number 1 flatshare site, we’ve helped over 13,000,000 people to find their perfect room or roommate. With our apps, you can do it all while on-the-go.

UNRIVALLED CHOICE

bluejetty:00068674:ios.description:
Simple Diary is a simple, easy-to-use free diary app where you can save photos along with your entries.
Use it for daily journaling, baby milestones, travel memories, a record of your pet's growth, or a secret diary just for you.
Clean, simple screens help you keep going, even if diaries never stuck before.
No account registration. Download it and start writing.
Your diary stays on your device, and the app works offline.
[Features]
■ Add Photos to Entries (Up to 10 per Entry)
Like a blog, insert images between paragraphs. Attach photos from your camera roll.
■ Secure Passcode Lock
Protect your diary with a passcode. Supports Face ID and Touch ID for quick, secure access.
■ 22 Font Styles
Change the look of your diary with 22 font styles, from cute to classic serif. (Some fonts are premium.)
■ Theme Colors and App Icons
Choose from 19 theme colors, from cute to cool. You can also change the app icon. (Requires the latest iOS version.)
■ Data Export
Export your diary as PDF, HTML, RTFD, or TXT files (premium service). Open them on a computer to reread your diary on a bigger screen, or print entries on paper.
■ Turn an Entry into an Image or PDF
Save an entry as one image or a PDF to post to social media, send to family, or print.
■ Data Backup
Back up your data to iCloud or your computer. RTFD export (premium service) lets you move your entries to your notes app or cloud storage.
■ iCloud Backup
Back up your diary to iCloud and restore it on another device (premium service). It is a manual backup, not automatic sync: back up on your iPhone, then restore on your iPad.
■ Calendar and List Views
Look back at your diary on a calendar or as a list. Tap a date to reread that day.
■ Tag Search
Use the built-in search to find entries quickly. Write a tag such as "#travel" in the text, and searching for it brings up just those entries.
■ Font Settings
Adjust text size, contrast, and line spacing. Great if you prefer larger text.
■ Reminders
Set a reminder time and get a push notification, so you don't forget to write.
■ Multiple Entries Per Day
Write one entry per day, or add several for memos, work records, or passing thoughts. Change an entry's date and time to write about past days. There is no limit on entry length.
[Pricing]
The core diary features are all free: entries, photos, passcode lock, search, and reminders. The free version shows ads.
The premium service removes all ads and unlocks iCloud backup, data export, all theme colors, and all font styles.
Premium is available as a monthly plan, a yearly plan, or a one-time purchase, all with the same features, and covers both your iPhone and iPad under the same Apple Account.
[Your Data]
Your diary is stored on your device and is not synced to the cloud automatically. To protect your data, use the premium iCloud backup or Apple's iPhone backup.
There is no feature to publish your diary or share it with other users. To show someone an entry, turn it into an image and send it.
A backup moves your data to a new iPhone. Data transfer to or from other operating systems is not supported.
[Perfect For]
■ Students
A secret diary for your day, your feelings, and your crushes. Writing out what you can't post online helps you feel lighter.
■ Parents
Record your pregnancy and your baby's growth as a photo diary. Write several entries a day, and share special pages with family as images.
■ Anyone Who Wants to Keep a Record
Travel journals, reading and movie notes, food diaries, dream journals, daily work logs, or your pet's growth. Simple Diary fits whatever you want to remember, one day at a time.
[Help, Feedback]
For help, go to "Help / FAQ" in the app settings. Still have questions? Tap "Feedback" on the settings screen to contact us for faster support.

https://komorebi-studio.com/tos_en.html
Privacy Policy:
https://komorebi-studio.com/policyredirect.html

bluejetty:00168617:ios.description:
Running out of storage? Magic Cleaner helps you quickly clear photo clutter, organize your digital content, and make more room for what matters.
From duplicate photos and forgotten screenshots to large videos and messy contacts, Magic Cleaner makes everyday cleanup faster, simpler, and easier to manage.
CLEAN UP YOUR GALLERY
Free Up Space in Just a Few Taps
Quickly find duplicate photos, similar images, screenshots, large videos, and other content you may no longer need.
Review cleanup suggestions, remove unwanted items, and reclaim valuable storage without endlessly scrolling through your gallery.
Swipe Away Photo Clutter
Turn photo cleanup into a fast and simple experience.
Swipe left to remove a photo and swipe right to keep it. Review your gallery one image at a time and make quick decisions with natural, easy-to-use gestures.
ORGANIZE MORE THAN PHOTOS
Clean Up Videos
Find large and unnecessary videos that may be taking up valuable storage space. Review them easily and decide what stays and what goes.
Keep Contacts Organized
Identify duplicate or incomplete contacts and keep your address book easier to manage.
Clear Old Calendar Events
Review outdated calendar items and remove events you no longer need.
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR STORAGE
Fast Cleaning from Your Home Screen
Use convenient widgets to access cleaning tools and check your storage at a glance.
Fast Clean Widget — Jump directly into cleanup.
Storage Widget — See how much storage space is currently in use.
Stay informed and start cleaning whenever your device begins to feel crowded.
PROTECT PRIVATE CONTENT
Private Space
Keep selected photos and videos in a dedicated private space for added protection and peace of mind.
GET HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Easy Cleaning Guides
Not sure where to begin?
Follow simple cleaning guides that help you review photos, videos, contacts, and other digital content step by step.
REFRESH YOUR PHOTOS
Smart Photo Tools
Enhance and adjust selected photos with easy-to-use editing tools. Make quick improvements and give your favorite images a refreshed look with minimal effort.
MAKE SPACE FOR MORE
Spend less time managing clutter and more time enjoying your device.
Download Magic Cleaner today and enjoy a cleaner gallery, more organized content, and extra space for new photos, videos, apps, and memories.
Subscription Plans
Weekly, monthly, and yearly subscription options may be available.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account after purchase confirmation.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00097590:ios.description:
Block Puzzle Jam
Get ready to slide, sort, and solve in Block Puzzle Jam, a fun and addictive block puzzle game that will test your logic and strategy! Move colorful blocks, unblock tricky paths, and escape challenging puzzles as you progress through levels designed to keep you thinking.
Endless Puzzles, Unlimited Fun
Each level brings new puzzle challenges, requiring you to think strategically and find the best way to sort and slide blocks. Whether you're matching colors, escaping tricky mazes, or rushing to solve puzzles, every move counts!
Exciting Features:
- Unique Block Puzzle Gameplay: Slide blocks, match colors with their respective gates, and slide the blocks to unblock paths and solve exciting challenges.
- Hundreds of Levels: Keep your mind sharp with an ever-growing collection of puzzle levels, from simple to super tricky!
- Challenging Obstacles: Navigate through mazes, gates, and barriers that make each puzzle more exciting.
- Strategic & Fun: Plan your moves wisely and flow through obstacles to clear every stage.
- Beautiful Graphics & Smooth Controls: Enjoy a colorful, visually stunning puzzle experience with easy-to-use swipe controls.
- Unlock & Earn Rewards: Complete levels to unlock new puzzles and earn exciting rewards.
- How to Play:
- Slide & match the blocks with their coloured gates to clear the puzzle.
- Unblock the path by solving tricky challenges of the blocks maze
- Sort blocks, unlock mazes, and strategize to win!
- Why You'll Love Block Puzzle Jam
Easy to learn, challenging to master!
Perfect for puzzle lovers looking for a mix of fun and strategy.
Great for brain training—improve your thinking skills while having fun!

bluejetty:00159742:ios.description:
WHERE HISPANICS AND LATINOS CONNECT
Whether you say Hola, Olá, or Hello, every meaningful relationship starts with that first moment. DiHola is the Latino dating app where you meet, chat, and connect with Hispanic and Latino singles who share your values and cultura.
We believe the best connections happen when you can be authentically you, Spanglish and all. That's why DiHola combines intelligent matching with conversation tools that make it easy to connect with people who share your values, your vibe, and your heritage.
WHY DIHOLA WORKS
- Compatibility Intelligence: See exactly how well you match before you even start talking. Our detailed compatibility reports show shared interests, values, and relationship goals so you know you're investing time in the right connections.
- SmartSwipe: Know who's genuinely interested in you. See who's viewed your profile and focus on Latino and Latina singles who want to connect with you.
- Personalized Icebreakers: Start conversations that actually go somewhere. Skip the awkward "hey" and use our smart icebreakers to spark engaging conversations from the first message.
- Daily Fresh Matches: Get a curated selection of compatible profiles every day based on what matters to you.
- Real Profiles, Real People: Connect with verified Latino and Latina singles in your area who are looking for authentic connections, not just another match.
DATE ON YOUR TERMS
Whether you're ready to find tu media naranja or just exploring what's out there, DiHola gives you the freedom to date your way. Set your preferences, dive into compatibility insights, and connect with singles who are on the same page. No pressure, no games, just real connections with people who actually match your energy.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE DIHOLA
DiHola is designed to help you find meaningful connections faster by showing you people who are actually compatible, not just attractive. We believe the best relationships start with understanding, shared values, cultural pride, and that unexplainable spark.
Dating apps shouldn't feel like work. They should feel fun, exciting, and maybe even a little bit like home. That's the DiHola difference. Ready to meet someone who actually gets you? DiHola is free to download. Premium subscription packages available for enhanced features. Download now and start connecting with compatible Latino and Latina singles who are looking for something real.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of current period
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings after purchase
No cancellation of current subscription allowed during active subscription period
Any unused portion of free trial forfeited when subscription purchased
Privacy Policy: http://www.justsayallo.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: http://www.justsayallo.com/terms
Support: hola@dihola.com

bluejetty:00163749:ios.description:
E-Pal is the ultimate gaming social hub built just for gamers—real gamers, live companions, always online! Jump in to easily squad up and dive into epic sessions, voice chat like crazy, make a ton of solid gaming buddies, and unlock way more hype gaming vibes. Never battle alone!
■ ePal: Connect with Live Gaming Companions
Spending time with ePals feels like hanging out with old friends—welcoming, supportive, and pure fun! Over 300K+ pro ePals are online 24/7, ready to pull all-nighters with you. Whether you need a competitive duo to carry your rank, a patient coach to teach you the ropes, or just a chill companion to share the hype vibes, you'll always find the perfect gaming partner here.
■ Lobby: Voice Chat, Community & Minigames
Turn our Lobby into your ultimate virtual home base and hangout spot:
Voice Chat Rooms: Hop into voice chat like crazy! Talk strategy (comms), host a party, or just chill and unwind after a long day.
Arcade & Minigames: Play fun, casual minigames absolutely free to kill boredom and loneliness instantly.
Vibrant Community: Meet gamers from all around the world. Share your epic gaming clips, post pictures, and connect through your unique gaming personality.
■ Find Solid Teammates & LFG for 100+ Popular Games:
League of Legends LFG, Valorant LFG, Overwatch 2 LFG, Fortnite LFG, Apex Legends LFG, Mobile Legends: Bang Bang LFG, Call of Duty LFG, Counter-Strike 2 LFG, Minecraft LFG, Roblox LFG, Teamfight Tactics LFG, Dead by Daylight LFG, Destiny 2 LFG, and many more!
■ About Us
E-Pal was founded in 2020 by hardcore lone-wolf gamer Brian with a super simple idea: help fellow lonely gamers quickly find solid teammates.
In just a few years, over 3 million+ gamers have rushed into E-Pal to squad up, and 30K+ core gamers have turned our community into their home base. In the future, E-Pal aims to become gamers' top choice for community, companionship, and gaming sidekick. This sets us apart from generic platforms by prioritizing gamers' personalities as our shared language. That's it—simple as that.

You can subscribe to your favorite ePals as if you were subscribing to a streamer on a live streaming platform. The service is paid for using the platform's virtual currency, Buff, and you can choose whether to renew your subscription before it expires or change the auto-renewal status at any time during your subscription. No partial refunds.

bluejetty:00003357:android.description:
Use Post-it® Notes anywhere and anytime. Post-it® App brings the simplicity of Post-it® Notes to your smartphone, tablet and Chromebook. Whether you use Post-it® Notes for teamwork and collaboration, or for reminders and personal note taking, Post-it® App helps you keep the momentum going.
If you work from home or as a student in remote learning, use the Post-it® App to share your ideas with co-workers, structure your assignments and share them with your teacher, or create colorful calendars and share them with your friends.
Simply capture analog notes with your camera or create digital notes right on your device. Arrange, refine and organize ideas anyway you see fit. Collaborate and share notes with co-workers, teachers and friends, or export to your favorite apps and cloud services—including Miro, Trello, Dropbox, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, and more.
Post-it® App features:
• Connect and share ideas from anywhere with co-workers and friends, whether it be a workshop or you simply want to share notes with each other.
• Capture more than 200 Post-it® Notes at a time with your camera. All our popular note sizes are supported.
• Transcribe your notes automatically using Handwriting Recognition. Great for search and exports.
• Draw, erase, type and change the color of your notes using powerful editing tools.
• Organize your way—group your ideas by thought or simply organize on a grid.
• Share to your favorite formats and cloud services to continue working on your ideas digitally—supports Miro, Trello, Dropbox, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, and more.
• Use our Widget to put your most important notes directly on your home screen.
Learn more about Post-it® App at post-it.com/app
Terms of Service: https://www.post-it.com/3M/en_US/post-it/ideas/app/eula/

bluejetty:00092415:ios.summary:

◆ Powerlift Pro A.I. S
bluejetty:00092415:ios.description:
Optimize your strength training. Powerlift Pro combines sophisticated A.I. training programs, a Workout Tracker/Logger (with History), a variety of weight training tools, and more. It's the only lifting app you need.
◆ Powerlift Pro A.I. Strength Training Programs ◆
Powerlift Pro's A.I. coach creates personalized strength training programs using a combination of human input from Powerlifting Champions and outrageously advanced computer algorithms. Here's how it works:
◆ Custom Program Based On Your Input ◆
Every time you start a powerlifting or powerbuilding program you'll be taken through our A.I. questionnaire. We'll gather all the data we need to structure a perfect plan for you. From training days per week, to one-rep maxes, to your favorite powerlifting accessories, your overall lifting experience, and much more...our technology ensures that your program is perfect for YOU.
◆ Real-Time Workout Adjustments ◆
Before and during each workout our A.I. gathers data and optimizes your workout in real time. Not only is your program structured perfectly for you, it adjusts for you day-by-day as needed to optimize your results.
◆ Meet Day Prep & Max Testing ◆
If you are focusing on a meet or want to re-test your maxes, our A.I. takes this into account and adjusts your programs accordingly.
◆ Weak Point Optimization ◆
Considering your upper and lower body weak points, Powerlift Pro's A.I. adjusts your program to most effectively deal with these weak points and improve your overall strength.
◆ Beyond Powerlift Pro A.I. ◆
Going beyond our A.I. programming, the Powerlift Pro app has all the powerlifting tools you need to be a success in the gym or on meet day.
◆ Workout Tracker and Workout History ◆
Keep tabs on your workout history.
◆ Macros Tracker ◆
Our Simple Macros Tracker is a fantastic way to keep your Calories, Protein, Carbs, and Fat on track for the day. We can't stand complicated Macros trackers, so we designed ours so it's functional and yet so simple.
◆ Max Matrix ◆
The simplest way to track your current and target PR's. 
◆ Barbell Plate Calculator and Reverse Barbell Calculator ◆
Take the math and guesswork out of training. It works with any type of bar, LBS and KG plates, and any type of barbell collar. And conveniently choose between LBS or KG. We think it's the best-looking and most functional bar loader tool on the market.
◆ RPE | RIR Calculators ◆
Want to train using with Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE) and Reps In Reserve (RIR)? bluejetty:00016764:ios.description:
Welcome to Mido Lotto, Your Ultimate Lottery Companion
Forget about missing lottery draws or losing your tickets, and say hello to Mido Lotto - a revolutionary new way to play your favorite lottery games! Order official tickets for Powerball, Mega Millions, and your favorite state games directly from your phone.
Whether you're a novice lottery player or an experienced enthusiast, Mido Lotto's user-friendly app offers an array of features to enhance your lottery-playing experience.
With Mido Lotto, you can: 
- Manage your lottery tickets and get alerts for when you win
- Set your favorite numbers to Autoplay so you never miss out on a life-changing jackpot 
- Keep your account topped up with Autofund to order lottery tickets in seconds
- Customize notifications for your favorite games, draw cutoff times, and high jackpot amounts
- Enter giveaways, join promotions, and receive discounts exclusively for Mido Lotto customers
- Connect with friends, family, or other players with lottery pools and let our intuitive interface divvy up the prizes for you (CA only)
Secure Ticket Storage
No more worrying about lost or damaged tickets! Orders placed on Mido Lotto are fulfilled by licensed lottery retailers in the respective states where the orders are made. Your lottery tickets are digitally linked to your identity and Mido Lotto securely stores your physical tickets – keeping them safe and ensuring only you can claim your winnings. 
Trusted and Hassle-Free Payment Options
Venmo, PayPal, ACH, and hundreds of banks to choose from. Mido Lotto prioritizes the privacy and security of your personal information by partnering with industry-leading payment providers, giving you peace of mind as you play for those mega jackpots.
Effortless Wins
Whether it's a modest victory or a billion-dollar jackpot, rest assured that 100% of your winnings belong to you. Prizes up to $599 can be instantly credited to your Mido Wallet, allowing you to fuel your winning streak or withdraw for a well-deserved treat. When it comes to the life-changing jackpots, our dedicated Customer Success Team is ready to assist you every step of the way.
Ready to change the way you play the lottery?
Download Mido Lotto Now and Let the Winning Begin!
Questions? Head to support.midolotto.com for more information about Mido Lotto or send us an email at cs@midolotto.com. We would love to hear from you!
Rules and Terms
Mido Lotto is a real-money gambling app and complies with all state laws, gaming regulations, and security standards. You must be 18+ (21+ in Arizona) and within state boundaries to order. Mido Lotto is an independent entity and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Powerball, Mega Millions, or any state lottery and does not assert ownership over any intellectual property associated with any lottery. Please visit midolotto.com/terms-of-service for full terms and conditions.
At Mido Lotto, we want to foster an environment of fun and responsible play. We encourage you to only spend what you can afford. If you're wondering if you have a gambling problem and would like to talk to someone, The National Council on Problem Gambling provides a range of resources on their website as well as their free, confidential, 24/7, 365-day-a-year hotline. Call 1-800-GAMBLER(522-4700) or visit www.ncpgambling.org/

bluejetty:00134587:ios.summary: "Anwaa" app provides comprehensive weather updates and forecasts, and interactive weather maps. Users can personalize their experience by tracking weather in favorite cities or their current location, keeping our users informed about all we
bluejetty:00134587:ios.description:
"Anwaa" app provides comprehensive weather updates and forecasts, and interactive weather maps. Users can personalize their experience by tracking weather in favorite cities or their current location, keeping our users informed about all weather changes. Additionally, it offers the capability to notify users of weather warnings and their associated impacts across regions and governorates.
Our Services
- Current Weather Information and 10-Day Forecasts
This feature provides real-time weather updates and forecasts for the next ten days.
- Early Warning 
This feature notifies users of weather warnings issued by the National Center for Meteorology, including the accompanying impacts, tailored to regions and governorate.
- Current Location Weather Information and Forecasts
This service provides real-time weather updates and 10-day forecasts based on the user's current geographic location.
- Daily Weather Report for Saudi Arabia
This feature displays the daily weather report for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
- Interactive Weather Maps
• Early Warning Map: display of weather warnings across Saudi Arabia with a comprehensive map and list view.
• Weather Forecast Maps:
o Rain forecasts
o Accumulated precipitation forecasts
o Temperature forecasts
o Wind forecasts
o Cloud cover forecasts
o Humidity forecasts
• Weather Observation Maps:
o Weather radar
o Satellite images
o Automatic weather stations
o METARs
- Mashaer Weather (Hajj Season)
This feature provides weather updates for Makkah, Madinah, and the holy sites, including current conditions and forecasts for the coming days. It also displays prayer times and temperature predictions for each prayer time. This service is specifically tailored for pilgrims during the Hajj season, facilitating easy access to weather information via the National Center for Meteorology “Anwaa” app.
- Sharing Weather Information
The app allows users to share weather updates and alerts directly on social media platforms.
- Customizable Alerts for Notifications and Warnings
Users can customize the type of alerts they receive based on the warning level:
• Yellow Warning
• Orange Warning
• Red Warning
- App Language
Available in nine languages, allowing users to choose their preferred language.
- App Settings
Users can tailor the app to their preferences with the following options:
• Language selection
• Temperature unit selection
• Favorite cities selection
• Notification customization

Join 25 million creators making stop motion animation with ease.
Stop Motion Studio is the Apple-featured app for creating stunning stop motion films.
Enjoy powerful creative tools with no ads, no tracking, and no subscriptions.
Stop Motion Studio is the easiest and most powerful stop motion animation maker for iPhone and iPad. Create beautiful animated films with LEGO, clay, drawings, or everyday objects — no experience required.
Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned animator, Stop Motion Studio gives you everything you need to turn your ideas into motion.
Loved by Millions Worldwide
* Over 25 million creators and counting
* Rated 4.7 stars with more than 65,000 reviews
* Featured in Apple’s “Life on iPad” TV commercial
“Stop Motion Studio makes it easy to create your own stop-motion movies.” – The Washington Post
“Brings out the LEGO moviemaking geek in all of us.” – TechNewsWorld
Create and Edit with Precision
* Onion skinning and animation guides for perfect alignment
* Interactive timeline and frame-by-frame editing
* Copy, paste, cut, and insert frames with ease
* Rotoscoping: draw over videos for unique effects
* Built-in drawing tools, text cards, and speech bubbles
* Erase unwanted objects and add facial expressions or layers
* Merge frames to simulate motion blur or speed effects
Capture Every Frame
* Full manual camera controls: focus, exposure, ISO, and white balance

* Use your Apple Watch or another device as a remote camera

Share Your Masterpiece

* Start on iPhone and finish on Mac — your work stays in sync
Learn and Improve

* Built-in manual for quick guidance and inspiration
Yours to Create
No ads. No tracking. No subscriptions.
Your data stays private and your creativity stays yours.
Download Stop Motion Studio today.

bluejetty:00083559:ios.summary: Introducing Music Speed & Pitch Changer, a versatile mobile application designed for practicing musicians and casual users who need a comprehensive tool to adjust the tempo, pitch, and various audio effects of their favorite tracks. This ap
bluejetty:00083559:ios.description:
Introducing Music Speed & Pitch Changer, a versatile mobile application designed for practicing musicians and casual users who need a comprehensive tool to adjust the tempo, pitch, and various audio effects of their favorite tracks. This app serves as a pitch changer, slow downer, music transcriber, transposer and sound stretcher, all in one convenient package. You can also use the app to export modified audio files to various formats.
Main features:
‣‣ PITCH ADJUSTMENT
Determine the key of a track and make necessary adjustments to match a specific instrument's tuning or create a unique sound. It is possible to change the pitch without changing the tempo of the song.
‣‣ SLOW DOWN & SPEED UP
Change your track’s tempo - slow down music for easier learning or speed up songs for a faster pace, making the app versatile for various purposes. It is possible to change the speed without changing the pitch.
‣‣ CUE POINTS & LOOPS
Select different sections of the track by placing markers, and slow them down or speed them up individually. Thanks to this feature, you can easily select and loop the desired fragment for practice.
‣‣ MUSIC TRANSCRIBER
Upload audio files and change their parameters such as tempo and pitch to make it easier to learn or practice your favorite songs.
‣‣ MUSIC TRANSPOSER
Сhange the pitch of all the notes of a piece of music by a certain number of semitones up or down to adapt the piece of music to a particular instrument or voice, or to play a song in a different key.
‣‣ SIMPLE AUDIO UPLOAD
Upload any audio file to work with the sound. The app supports all popular formats, such as MP3 and more.
‣‣ SAVE & EXPORT 
Save the result in various formats. It is also possible to save both the entire track and the selected loop.
‣‣ EASY TO USE INTERFACE
The app's intuitive design makes it easy for musicians and casual users alike to manipulate and perfect their tracks. We have made a convenient playlist with projects so that they do not get lost, and so that you always have quick access to them.
Our app provides a comprehensive audio manipulation tool for users looking to enhance their musical experience, improve their skills, or simply enjoy their favorite tunes in a new way. Transform your mobile device into a powerful and user-friendly platform for perfecting your tracks and for practicing and learning musical compositions.
***
• Subscription's length is 1 month. It grants access to all features of the application.
• You can turn off the auto-renewal at any time. You can change your payment plan in the Settings of your iTunes and App Store account.
• The first time you have 3 days free trial. After that, your account will be automatically charged for the subscription if you will not stop it before the end of the free trial.
• Subscription automatically renews every month. Withdrawal of funds for each subsequent month occurs on the same date.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Important: Before subscribing, please read Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00071384:ios.summary:
EnglishReading helps you practice English reading comprehension through structured lesson packages, reading passages, multiple-choice questions, progress tracking, and mistake review.
Build your reading habit step by step.
MAIN FEATURES
bluejetty:00071384:ios.description:
EnglishReading helps you practice English reading comprehension through structured lesson packages, reading passages, multiple-choice questions, progress tracking, and mistake review.
Build your reading habit step by step.
MAIN FEATURES
Practice Reading by Lesson
Choose a package, open a lesson, read the passage, and answer comprehension questions. Each lesson is designed to help you read carefully and understand the main idea, details, vocabulary, and context.
Track Your Progress
See your learning progress directly from the home screen. EnglishReading shows your completed lessons, current progress, mistakes to review, streaks, and weekly learning activity.
Review Your Mistakes
Mistake Bank helps you quickly find questions you answered incorrectly, review your previous answer, and compare it with the correct answer. This makes it easier to focus on the areas that need more practice.
Instant Results
After finishing a lesson, view your score, correct answers, incorrect answers, and total questions. You can review the lesson again to understand your mistakes and improve over time.
Comfortable Reading Experience
Choose from Light, Pastel, and Night themes to make reading more comfortable in different environments.
Print and Review
Export or print lesson content for offline study and quick review whenever you need.
WHY USE ENGLISHREADING?
• Simple and focused reading practice
• Clear lesson packages
• Multiple-choice comprehension questions
• Mistake review for better learning
• Progress and weekly study tracking
• Clean UI for both iPhone and iPad
• Light, Pastel, and Night themes
• Useful for daily English reading practice
EnglishReading is designed for learners who want a simple, organized, and comfortable way to improve reading comprehension skills.

bluejetty:00165397:android.name: Fire Truck Simulator 2025
bluejetty:00165397:android.summary: Attention Fire Truck Games enthusiasts! Step into the role of a fearless firefighter and command a fleet of powerful fire trucks to protect the city from raging flames. Showcase your bravery and masterful skills in the most immersive fire t
bluejetty:00165397:android.description:
Attention Fire Truck Games enthusiasts! Step into the role of a fearless firefighter and command a fleet of powerful fire trucks to protect the city from raging flames. Showcase your bravery and masterful skills in the most immersive fire truck driving simulator.
Features of Fire Truck Games 2025:
🚒 Operate 5 cutting-edge, ultra-realistic fire trucks
🔥 Tackle adrenaline-pumping fire rescue missions
🏙️ Explore a vast, interactive open-world city
🚨 Experience genuine fire truck sirens, lights, and horns
🚦 Navigate through lifelike AI traffic and traffic signals
🎥 Switch between multiple cinematic camera angles
🕹️ Choose from smooth driving controls: steering wheel, buttons, or tilt
🎶 Enjoy immersive sound effects that enhance every firefighting moment
Every second counts in Fire Truck Games 2025. Your mission is to protect the city from roaring infernos. Prepare your fire truck, fill up the water tank, and be ready for emergencies. Precision is crucial to ensure the water tank is properly filled, preventing spills and maintaining the fire engine’s balance on the road. Drive cautiously, as a single mistake could turn a rescue mission into a dangerous situation.
Firefighting is one of the world’s most challenging and essential roles. From saving lives to safeguarding property, every second is crucial. In Fire Truck Games 2025, you’ll feel the intensity and excitement of being a real firefighter. Unlike typical car games, fire engine games require strategy, fast decision-making, and accuracy. Test your reflexes as you weave through traffic, avoid obstacles, and race against time to the fire scene.
How to Play Fire Truck Driving Simulator:
🚒 Receive your emergency alert.
🟡️ Check the fire’s location on the interactive city map.
🚦 Use sirens and lights to clear a path through traffic.
🚪 Reach the scene, connect the fire hose, and combat the flames.
💧 Manage your water supply carefully to ensure every drop counts.
🎉 Complete rescue missions to unlock new fire trucks and equipment.
Why Fire Engine Games Are Different:
Unlike regular car games, fire engine games challenge your skills beyond driving. Fires are unpredictable, and each scenario demands a new approach. From downtown infernos to vast forest fires, you’ll need quick thinking, fast reflexes, and strategic planning to succeed. Feel the adrenaline of saving lives and become a true firefighting hero.
Additional Highlights:
🚒 Choose from a variety of high-performance fire engines and fire trucks.
🌍 Journey through dynamic environments, from busy cities to quiet forests.
🛵️ Access aerial firefighting support with helicopters and planes.
💪 Upgrade your tools for faster response times and higher water capacity.
Fire Truck Games 2025 offers the most intense and realistic firefighting experience. With high-quality 3D visuals, lifelike sound effects, and interactive missions, you’ll feel like a real firefighter on the front lines. Face off against residential blazes, wildfires, and large-scale industrial fires in the most captivating fire truck simulator to date.
Play Fire Truck Games 2025 and Enjoy:
- Realistic fire truck driving mechanics
- Rescue missions that challenge your strategy and skills
- Lifelike AI traffic and precise controls
- Multiple cinematic camera perspectives for a complete firefighting experience
Website: https://clapgames.app
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/clapgamesreal/
If you’re passionate about Fire Truck Games 2025, don’t forget to rate and review. Your feedback drives us to deliver even more thrilling updates. Experience the pride of being a firefighter hero in the most realistic firefighting experience of 2025!

iWant – Home of Filipino Feels
iWant is the premier streaming app for all Filipinos and Filipinas—whether you’re in the Philippines or anywhere in the world. Enjoy the biggest collection of Tagalog movies, Pinoy teleseryes, original series, and live TV channels, all in one easy-to-use platform.

• 1,000+ titles including classic and current Filipino movies, teleseryes, and full series
• Exclusive iWant Originals – fresh, original content made for Filipinos
• Live TV and GMA shows – Access live channels and top-rated programs (availability varies by country and plan)
Stream Across All Devices
• Mobile, tablet, web, and Smart TVs – Seamless experience on Mobile phones and official TV apps
• Native TV App Support – Available on Apple TV, Fire TV, Roku, LG Smart TV, Samsung Smart TV, and more
• Subtitles in English and other languages – On select titles to reach global viewers
• Quick start – Launch the app and start watching instantly
• Smooth playback – High-quality streaming with minimal buffering
Made for Filipinos Everywhere
Whether you’re watching from Metro Manila, Cebu, Davao, or overseas in the U.S., Canada, Middle East, Europe, or Asia-Pacific, iWant brings Filipino stories, culture, and entertainment straight to your screen.
Why Choose iWant:
• Most comprehensive Filipino content platform
• Regularly updated with new episodes and trending titles
• Trusted by millions of Filipinos worldwide
• Compatible with all major Mobile and Smart TV devices
• Ad-free viewing with subscription – safe, secure, and legal

Privacy Policy: https://www.iwanttfc.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00017636:ios.description:
¡Nueva experiencia Banrural!
Nos emociona presentarte la última versión de nuestra aplicación, diseñada para ofrecerte una gestión financiera más intuitiva y segura. Con el nuevo aspecto de Banrural, administrar tus finanzas más fácil que nunca.
Con nuestra aplicación, podrás gestionar tus cuentas de ahorro y cuentas monetarias, así como tus tarjetas de crédito, préstamos y pagos de servicios de manera eficiente y segura desde tu dispositivo iOS.
Para acceder a todos estos beneficios, simplemente autentícate con tu USUARIO y CONTRASEÑA de Banrural Virtual. Garantizamos la seguridad de tus transacciones en línea y te recomendamos activar la autenticación con Face ID/Huella y Patrón para una protección adicional.
Si aún no tienes tus credenciales o eres nuevo en Banrural, no te preocupes, también puedes abrir una cuenta digital directamente desde la aplicación o gestionar la creación de accesos a tus canales digitales.
Los servicios que encontrarás en nuestra aplicación incluyen:
- Creación de cuentas digitales desde la App.
- Consulta de saldos de cuentas monetarias, ahorros, tarjetas de crédito y préstamos.
- Cobro de remesas.
- Pago de servicios básicos.
- Transferencias entre cuentas propias, cuentas de terceros, a otros bancos (ACH) y móviles.
- Pago de seguros, entidades Gubernamentales, préstamos y tarjetas de crédito.
- Bloqueo, desbloqueo y pre-declaración de cheques.
Recuerda que solo necesitas acceso a Banrural Virtual y un plan de datos en tu celular o acceso a red inalámbrica Wi-Fi para disfrutar de todos estos beneficios.
¡Descarga nuestra aplicación ahora y experimenta la comodidad de gestionar tus finanzas en cualquier momento y lugar!

Set against the epic backdrop of a space war, this idle game lets you endlessly grow your fleet.

Collect SS-tier warship and conquer planets for an exhilarating experience.

Easily mine resources with a single button operation, and raid other players’ ships to steal their resources! 
Use the mined and plundered resources to create even more powerful space warship!

Strengthen your weapons and enhance your ships using special equipment and minerals collected through unexplored planet expeditions. 
Enjoy the dazzling visuals that change with each weapon you equip!
▶ No More Passive Pets! Launch a Fleet of Drones!
Collect and grow dozens of drones that launch attacks with machine guns, missiles, lasers, and more as they fly in a circular pattern towards enemies. 
Start today, and by tomorrow, you’ll be a drone master!
▶ Endless Idle Growth and Upgrades
Enjoy simple and convenient yet exciting growth content! 
Experience the unique growth of an idle RPG with easy controls!
▶ Offline Rewards and Abundant Events
Grow endlessly with offline rewards! 
Feel the joy of rapid progression!

bluejetty:00040822:ios.description:
Moodfit helps you improve your mood, reduce stress, and build mental fitness. Track your emotions, practice CBT and breathwork, and build lasting habits.
Award-Winning Mental Health App
• Best Mental Health Apps of 2024 & 2025 – CNET
• Best Mood Tracker (2023) – Verywell Mind

• Featured in Forbes, Vogue, Men’s Health, PsychCentral, and more
Why Users Love Moodfit:
“Changed my life. I track my moods, sleep, hydration, exercise, and more. Highly recommend!” – slmjoy
“Helps me every day. You can customize your journey. 10/10.” – Eleanor Ivy
“Game changer. I feel more in control now.” – 1beggar
How Moodfit Helps You:
Moodfit offers a complete set of mental health tools in one app:
• Mood journal – track emotions and discover patterns
• CBT tools – challenge and change unhelpful thoughts
• Mindfulness & meditation – reduce stress and increase presence
• Breathwork – calm anxiety and regulate your nervous system
• Gratitude journal – train your brain to notice positives
• Nervous system - see how your nervous system is affecting your emotions
• Daily goals – build mental fitness habits that stick
• Insights – see how sleep, exercise, nutrition, and social interactions affect mood
• Medication & custom activity tracking – learn what works best for you
• Validated assessments – monitor depression (PHQ-9) and anxiety (GAD-7) over time
• Education & inspiration – practical content on rumination, procrastination, motivation, and more
Our Core Beliefs:
• Mental fitness is for everyone—not just those in crisis
• There’s no one-size-fits-all approach to emotional health
• The right tools plus tracking enable lasting change
Join us and build better mental health—one day at a time. Download Moodfit and start your journey toward feeling your best.

bluejetty:00077568:ios.summary: The #1 meal kit for eating well! Our meal plans cover options for every lifestyle including Mediterranean, Plant Based, GIG-certified Gluten Free, High Protein, Calorie Smart, Carb Smart, Functional Nutrition and Quick & Easy to help you lo
bluejetty:00077568:ios.description:
The #1 meal kit for eating well! Our meal plans cover options for every lifestyle including Mediterranean, Plant Based, GIG-certified Gluten Free, High Protein, Calorie Smart, Carb Smart, Functional Nutrition and Quick & Easy to help you look after your body. Download the app today and get your favorite recipes delivered directly to your door.
Green Chef is a certified organic meal kit company committed to doing things differently. We work with farmers to obtain organic, sustainably-sourced produce, and combine it with other premium ingredients to create many easy-to-master recipes that can be prepared in about 30 minutes—perfect for a lifestyle that doesn’t compromise on good food or green living!
What to Expect from Green Chef’s Meal Kits and Food Delivery
√ Weekly menus featuring organic, sustainably sourced produce
√ A choice of plans for 2, 4 or 6 people with 3 or 4 meals per week
√ Options for every lifestyle—Mediterranean, Plant Based, GIG-certified Gluten Free, High Protein, Calorie Smart, Carb Smart, Functional Nutrition and Quick & Easy
√ Handy recipe cards in the box and online access to our chef-crafted meals
√ No commitment — skip weeks, swap recipes, and cancel at any time
√ Meal kits delivered directly to your door on your chosen day
√ The only meal kit that offsets 100% of plastic in each box
Easy Meal Management with the Green Chef App
The Green Chef app makes managing your weekly meals simple. Just open the app on your smartphone and access your account to manage your scheduled delivery day, skip a week if you'll be out of town, choose your recipes, or change the number of meals or the number of people you are feeding—whether it’s just you or your entire family!
You can also change your meal kit subscription and choose between your preferences in just a few clicks to take the stress out of your weekly meal planning and cooking. Want to try Mediterannean and Vegan meals in a single week? It's easy with the Green Chef app.
Our Meal Preferences Include:
- Mediterranean: Recipes inspired by Mediterranean flavors with ample veggies and good-for-you fats
- Vegetarian: A plethora of well-balanced, meatless recipes with a focus on plant-based ingredients
- Vegan: Recipes with a variety of veggies, plant-based proteins, and good-for-you grains
- Gluten-Free:GIG-certified, Wwholesome recipes full of flavor and free of gluten and soy
- High Protein: Our high protein recipes are developed to provide at least 30 grams of protein—that’s 60% DV per serving! 
- Carb Smart: Low carb diet packed with 50% of your daily protein requirement 
- Calorie Smart: 650 calories or less per serving incorporating whole foods and essential nutrients 
- Functional nutrition: Gut friendly meals that fuel your mind
- Quick & Easy: Low lift, easy recipes ready in 20 minutes or less

Get a safe and reliable ride across multiple U.S. cities with the RideYellow app. Once you enter your destination, you’ll be provided with your trip price before you book, so you know exactly how much your trip will cost. 
Make payments fast and seamless by adding a credit card to the app. Or pay directly in the cab with either cash or by swiping a credit card.

• Request a ride for immediate pickup or schedule your ride for a later time.
• Use the “Ride Sync” button when hailing a cab at the airport etc. for easy payments.
• All RideYellow drivers pass strict government background checks and safety classes.
• Every taxi has comprehensive 24/7 insurance coverage. 
• Save 25% OFF all RideYellow app trips in Los Angeles County and other select areas! 
See if RideYellow is available in your local area at https://rideyellow.com/cities/
Sign up to become a driver at https://rideyellow.com/driver 
Have a question? Submit a help request at https://rideyellow.com/help/

bluejetty:00169961:ios.description:
Expand a small kingdom to a mighty Dominion! 
Play the Spiel des Jahres winner beloved by millions of boardgame hobbyists around the world. This is the officially licensed implementation. 
REIGNING DECKBUILDER
Discover the game that defined a genre, Dominion was first to popularize deck-building and remains a staple of tabletop. 
GROW YOUR KINGDOM
Collect as many Victory Points as you can by building a powerful deck. Your deck starts out a small sad set of Estates and Coppers, but you hope that by the end of the game it will be brimming with Gold, Provinces, and the inhabitants and structures of your kingdom.
BUILD YOUR ENGINE
Choose wisely among the 10 cards available in the tableau to create the strongest combos to dominate your opponent.
COLLECT ALL EXPANSIONS
Make your games more exciting with additional cards and rules from up to 15 expansions including the recent Plunder expansion! 
NEAR INFINITE VARIETY
Over one hundred thirty-two septillion possible Kingdom combinations, 500+ cards, 15 and counting expansions, and ongoing promo packs make Dominion one of the most extensive and replayable boardgames in the hobby. 
COMPETE WITH THE COMPUTER
Sharpen your skills with solitaire style solo play against a robust AI, with four levels of difficulty. Our innovative AI learns through self-play. Earn Achievements and win in Recommended Sets against each AI level. 
PLAY FRIENDS OR STRANGERS
Play with up to 6 players online through your device or pass and play among your friends. Join ranked or unranked matchmaking, with realtime and asynchronous modes. Set up a private table for a family game, challenge a stranger in the lobby, or invite a friend!
DAILY PUZZLE
A daily ritual to relax with over a cup of coffee. Try the Daily Dominion, a free puzzle level available to players around the world. Practice your strategy to keep up a winning streak and climb the leaderboard.
CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY
Play from any supported device, whenever you want, after verifying your email in-game. Join games with opponents on platforms other than your own. 
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
With an active Discord and online community, make new friends or challenge new people to a game. Export and share kingdoms and game summaries to compare strategies.
FREE TO PLAY
Download the game that started it all for free! The base set of Dominion is available at no charge. Try the rotation of expansion cards in the Daily at no cost once per day. Jump into a lobby game with expansions enabled to try before you buy. Only the host needs to own the expansions. 
INTRODUCTION TO TABLETOP
Learn the ropes in this easy to pick-up, hard to master title. Play one of the most highly regarded strategy tabletop games of all time through our simple tutorial. The core loop is easy to follow, but offers a wealth of strategy to explore.
• 1 - 6 player support
• Five-hundred plus cards
• Solo play against 4 AI difficulties
• Async & real-time multiplayer
• Ranked & unranked matchmaking
• Lobby & Private game tables
• Cross platform multiplayer
• Cross platform purchases
• Daily challenge
• Challenging AI that learns through self-play
• Recommended Sets
• Customize, save & share Kingdoms
• Achievements, Stats & Leaderboards
• Pass & Play mode
• Automated score-keeping & hints
• Smart-play options to streamline gameplay
• Jumbo mode for readability on phones
• Turbo mode to zoom through games quickly
• Tutorial & Rules
• 4 languages: English, Japanese, German, French
• 15+ expansions plus three promo packs

bluejetty:00132062:ios.description:
YOUR LOCAL WEATHER SERVICE
WillyWeather organizes the world's weather data into the most valuable local information. The app includes radar, satellite, detailed wind, rain, tide, swell and UV forecasts, as well as moon phases, and sunrise and sunset times.
Going beyond the average weather service, we process and fine-tune forecast data to the specific coordinates of thousands of locations including all suburbs, towns, beaches, rivers, parks, lakes and islands.
WEATHER DATA
• WEATHER - Six-day NOAA weather forecasts tailored to each location including min/max temperatures, and detailed weather descriptions.
• RADAR - Raw NOAA radar data, refined, processed and integrated with iOS maps.
• SATELLITE - National satellite view, displaying cloud cover for the entire US, integrated with iOS maps.
• TIDES - The most comprehensive tide times system in the USA, bringing together NOAA standard port data with offsets generated for specific locations by WillyWeather. Includes every beach in the US, and many river systems and inlets.
• WIND -The most accurate global wind forecast model gathered from NOAA, interpolated to the exact coordinates for each location, and vetted against real-time wind observations to deliver the best performing information.
• UV - Hourly UV index forecasts, including alerts outlining extreme conditions when there is risk of harm from unprotected sun exposure.
• MOON PHASES - Full moon and new moon phases, illumination and rise and set times. Deeply integrated with tidal data.
• RAINFALL - Intuitive visual indication of rainfall probability for the week ahead.
• SWELL - Swell height, period and direction for each beach and surf spot in the USA.
• SUNRISE SUNSET - Sunrise and sunset times with first light and last light.
• REAL TIME observational data - with trends for all locations including current temperature, feels-like temperature, rain today, rain last hour, humidity, pressure, wind speed, wind direction, wind gusts and dew point.
• NOAA WARNINGS - Easily accessible and specifically targeted to the locations affected.
FEATURES
• Interactive rainfall radar, using iOS maps: pan and zoom like you've always wanted through the national NOAA radar network, to see exactly where rain is falling around you, or your favorite locations. Our mapping features provide more control and detail than any other US weather resource.
• Stunning, interactive tide, swell, and wind forecast graphs which allow you to easily interpret the conditions at your favorite surf beach, secret fishing spot or upcoming hike - in real-time, and up to seven days in the future. We're particularly proud of our graphs, we pushed the boundaries to provide you with more context, and more detail for each weather type.
• A beautiful, simple and organized interface in which the weather data that is important to you is easy to find, consume, and interact with. Our goal was to present accurate and relevant weather information to you, as quickly, and easily as possible.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00039660:ios.description:
Find, Reserve & Charge
Book your charge. Own your time.
GO TO-U is the EV charging app for electric vehicle drivers who want a predictable, convenient, and stress-free charging experience.
Find EV charging stations, reserve a charging time slot, check charger availability, start and manage sessions, pay securely, and get support — all in one app.
GO TO-U sees you as the driver of the future: smart, responsible, proactive, and ready to move differently. We call drivers like you Uvers.
Unlike traditional EV charging apps, GO TO-U is built around smart planning:
Green Pin — Reserve your charging time in advance, even if the charger is currently occupied.
Blue Pin — Monitor charger availability in real time and see whether a charger is free or in use before you arrive.
Whether you're charging during your daily routine, planning a road trip, commuting, or simply looking for a reliable EV charger nearby, GO TO-U makes EV charging easier and more predictable.
GO TO-U connects you to charging networks and operators across multiple regions, helping you access a broad ecosystem of charging stations through a single app.
KEY FEATURES
Reserve your charging time — At Green Pin locations, reserve your EV charging slot in advance and arrive knowing your session is already planned.
Check charger availability — See whether a charger is free or occupied before you arrive.
Find EV chargers nearby or on your route — Discover charging stations by location, connector type, charging speed, and operator.
Plan smarter EV trips — Use route planning to find charging stops that fit your journey, vehicle, and battery level.
Start, monitor, and manage sessions — Track your charging session in real time and access your complete charging history.
Pay easily and securely — Use card payments and the GO TO-U Wallet where available.
Get support when you need it — Contact GO TO-U support to keep every charging session smooth and reliable.
Enjoy more than charging — At selected locations, discover partner services, rewards, and special offers while your car charges.
GO TO-U turns EV charging into a planned experience, not a guessing game.
I don't wait for chargers. Chargers wait for me.
Download GO TO-U and join the movement of Uvers driving the future of electric mobility.
Book your charge. Own your time.

bluejetty:00079878:ios.description:
Introducing Cute Color - Color by Number: a captivating blend of digital art games and exclusive paint by number puzzles. Our app features charming designs ranging from adorable animals to enchanting landscapes. Dive into a world of creativity and relaxation with Cute Color - Color by Number, the ultimate coloring experience for all ages and lifestyles.
Explore a diverse collection of artwork curated to inspire joy and creativity. Whether you seek a fun moment of self-expression or a therapeutic escape, Cute Color - Color by Number offers a wide range of coloring options to suit your mood and preferences. From casual coloring games to intricate art puzzles, our app is designed to cater to your artistic needs.
5 reasons to choose Cute Color - Color by Number:
- Effortless painting: Simply select a template and start coloring with ease. Enjoy a seamless and satisfying paint by number experience.
- Exclusive digital art: Dive into unique art pieces featuring beloved characters and themes from various genres, adding a touch of magic to your creations.
- Coloring for a cause: Join us in supporting charitable initiatives worldwide through our antistress coloring games that give back to communities and the environment.
- Diverse and inclusive art: Immerse yourself in a world of positivity and cultural diversity with artwork created by talented artists from around the globe.
- Relaxation and art therapy: Let your worries fade away as you engage in our calming art games, promoting self-expression and stress relief through creativity.
Subscription pricing and terms：
In Cute Color, we offer you the following two subscription options:
1. A weekly subscription costing $4.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per week.
2. A monthly subscription costing $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per month.
2. A yearly subscription costing $69.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game. In addition, you'll get unlimited hints and unlimited buckets, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.
Experience the calming benefits of coloring with Cute Color - Color by Number, your go-to app for relaxation and artistic fulfillment. Whether you're seeking a creative outlet or a moment of tranquility, our app is designed to accompany you on your journey towards inner peace and creativity.
We are dedicated to enhancing your coloring experience. Share your feedback with us at support@mint-games.org and be a part of our continuous improvement efforts.
Immerse yourself in a world of creativity and cuteness with Cute Color - Color by Number, where every stroke brings joy and every color tells a story. Start your coloring adventure today and let your imagination soar with Cute Color - Color by Number!

Welcome to the match-3 puzzle game made by BTS!
Play match-3 puzzles on [BTS Island: In the SEOM] and explore the island with the BTS members (RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V, Jung Kook). Listen to BTS songs while you play match-3 puzzles on this relaxing island.

- Anyone can enjoy this match-3 puzzle game! 
- From ARMY that loves BTS, to gamers who love puzzles, there are levels for everyone.
- Check out levels made personally by BTS! 
- New levels updated every week! Try your hand at new levels and climb the SeomBoard rankings.
- Check out the touching story of BTS’s growth.
- From Tropical Island to Winter Island, Desert Island, and Shadow Island, explore the islands BTS is on.
- Install cool decorations! Turn the desolate island into an island for BTS.
- Dress up BTS in 350 different Costumes.

- Pop cute obstacles like penguins, baby octopus, bungeoppangs, and strawberry candies to clear puzzles!
- Try your hand at more difficult obstacles like chameleons, pirate frogs, ring cases, Jin’s Wootteo!
- Play free events like Special Place, Treasure Map, Concert Mode, Kore Race, and Mud Race to get rewards!
- Create clubs and meet new friends at the Plaza! The game is more fun with friends.
- No ads. Enjoy everything for free.

bluejetty:00037366:ios.summary:
Bluesky Tracker – Track Followers, Unfollowers, Blocks & Analytics.

bluejetty:00037366:ios.description:
Bluesky Tracker – Track Followers, Unfollowers, Blocks & Analytics.
Manage your Bluesky network in real time! Track followers, unfollowers, blocks, mutes, likes, posts, and more - all in one easy-to-use app. Discover which Bluesky lists include your account, explore starter packs featuring your profile, and monitor your growth with 30-day visual charts or get daily, weekly, and monthly breakdowns of your Bluesky activity..
Bluesky Tracker is the ultimate tool for Bluesky users, influencers, and content creators who want to grow their audience, manage connections, and analyze their content on the decentralized Bluesky social network with powerful analytics and insights.
Key Features:
- Track Followers & Unfollowers: See who follows or unfollows you in real time.
- Lists & Starter Packs: See which moderation lists include your account with “Lists Blocked By” and discover curated starter packs featuring your account with “Starter Packs In”. This helps you understand visibility and reach across the Bluesky network. Also identify the moderation lists you are blocking or muting.
- Blocked & Muted Lists: View who has blocked and manage your own blocking and mute lists.
- Charts, 30-Day Visual Insights: Track the last 30 days with clear charts for your new followers, new followings, posts and likes given.
- Advanced Filters: Filter users in your Bluesky network based on keywords, follower count, follower to following ratio, activity level, timeline and engagement for better targeting and analysis.
- Reports: Get daily, weekly, and monthly breakdowns of your Bluesky activity and track follower growth, posts, and performance over time.
- Bulk Follow & Unfollow: Easily follow or unfollow users in bulk - great for cleaning up or growing your network efficiently.
- Bookmarks Search: Search throughout your saved posts.
- Likes Timeline: See posts liked by any user, including yourself, to explore interests and engagement patterns.
- Fix Followings: Remove deleted, suspended, or blocked accounts to correct the inaccurate following counts of Bluesky.
- Posts Tracking & Sorting: Browse any user's posts and sort by likes, reposts, replies, quotes, or date to highlight key content.
- Post Stats & Analytics: Access detailed post metrics for any user, including reach, replies, reposts, and likes over time.
- Profile Actions: Follow, unfollow, block, or unblock users directly from their profile. Add private labels for better organization.
- User History Tools: See past usernames, follow/unfollow history, and mutual connections.
- Track, Filter and Follow user's Followers or Followings: Expand your network by following another user’s audience with one tap.
User-Friendly, Secure and Private:
- User-Friendly Interface: Clean and easy interface to manage your Bluesky network. Navigate effortlessly and access key information at a glance.
- Privacy First: Your data is never stored or shared. Everything stays secure and on your device.
Whether you’re a casual user, content creator, or social media influencer, Tracker - Manager for Bluesky is your all-in-one companion for tracking, managing, and growing your Bluesky social network.
Download now and take control of your Bluesky network today!
(This app is not affiliated with Bluesky social.)
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174900:ios.name: iCatcher! Podcast App
bluejetty:00174900:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00174900:ios.description:
Download, listen, watch, and relish your favorite podcasts.
FEATURES
- Subscribe to your preferred podcasts within the app and manage them conveniently.
- Download episodes over WiFi or Cellular (available on devices with cellular capabilities).
- Support for password-protected feeds.
- Background refresh and download in the background.
- Sync subscriptions, episode playback positions, and playlists between your devices using iCloud.
- Universal App (compatible with iPhone and iPad).
- Search across all views to locate the podcast or episode you’re seeking.
- Customize playlists with filtering options based on podcasts, episodes, and more.
- Support for continuous playback (toggle it on the now playing screen just below the time elapsed).
- Portrait and landscape orientation supporter, with a configurable option in the settings.
- Unfollow podcasts and still keep them on your device. This feature is particularly useful for podcasts that don’t meet your expectations.
PLAYBACK
- Variable playback speed.
- Remembered playback speed per podcast.
- Support for podcasts with chapters and chapter images (MP3 and M4A formats).
- Utilize your headset controls, including Bluetooth car controls (when paired), to play/pause, jump forward or backward 30 seconds.
- Sleep timer.
- Beautifully rendered show notes.
- Onscreen controls for skipping ahead and skipping back.
- Gesture support on the now playing screen (when the podcast logo is visible) to facilitate hands-free use.
 - Double-tap to play/pause.
 - Swipe up to adjust playback speed.
 - Swipe left or right to rewind or fast-forward.
 - Home to the L gesture for the 2-minute Leo jump.
- Refer to Settings and Gestures for more information and customization options for rewind/fast-forward gestures.
- AirPlay support allows you to watch or listen to podcasts on your large screen.
- External display support for videos is available for devices that support an external display (use the Apple HDMI adapter).
- Enjoy your favorite podcasts with a familiar layout.
FIND NEW PODCASTS QUICKLY
- Search for your podcasts by title, keyword, or author.
- Browse the top podcasts categorized by different genres.
• Manually add podcasts by entering their URLs.
• Support for password-protected feeds.
• Option to download a single episode.
• Import podcast subscriptions for episodes already on your device from iTunes.
• Import your OPML file from iTunes or other iOS podcast app.
• Import media using the iTunes File Sharing feature.
• Add your existing audiobooks (non-password-protected ones) using the iTunes File Sharing feature.
• Add previously downloaded podcasts from your computer using the iTunes file sharing feature (see Settings and Import Media for details).
SHORTCUT ACTIONS
• Search your podcasts and episodes using shortcut actions.
• Easily create an export from other apps into iCatcher using the subscribe action.
• Control playback. 
• View podcast action including currently playing.
• Import media directly into the app (like audiobooks).
• Transfer your media to the watch via shortcut actions.
• Pull chapter images.
• Many more actions available.
MORE
• Completely customizable to suit your podcast preferences.
• Swipe across a podcast or episode to access additional options.
• Podcast settings allow you to set the days the podcast typically releases or the number of days between.
• Specify the number of episodes to download when new ones are available.
• Share podcast information via email with your friends.
CONTACT
Email: Tap the settings tab and select Send Questions or Feedback.
Twitter/X: @Joeisanerd.
PLEASE NOTE: The app doesn’t sync with iTunes. Like other podcast apps, it’s a standalone app designed for subscribing and downloading on the device.
* If a feed doesn’t work, please let me know so I can investigate it.
Requires iOS 18.5

bluejetty:00187634:ios.description:
• Hỗ trợ iPhone Duo.
• Dữ liệu được cập nhật thường xuyên, khoảng 2 phút/lần.
• Theo dõi giá vàng SJC, DOJI và nhiều loại vàng trong nước.
• Cập nhật giá vàng thế giới theo thời gian thực.
• Xem giá mua vào, bán ra và mức tăng giảm.
• Theo dõi biến động giá một cách nhanh chóng và trực quan.
TỶ GIÁ NGOẠI TỆ
Tra cứu tỷ giá ngoại tệ từ VCB, BIDV và theo dõi biến động của nhiều đồng tiền phổ biến.
Thông tin được trình bày rõ ràng, giúp bạn dễ dàng theo dõi sự thay đổi của tỷ giá ngay trên iPhone.
BIỂU ĐỒ GIÁ VÀNG TRỰC QUAN
Theo dõi lịch sử và xu hướng biến động của giá vàng qua biểu đồ với nhiều khoảng mốc:
• 1 tuần
• 1 tháng
• 3 tháng
• 1 năm
Biểu đồ giúp bạn dễ dàng quan sát lịch sử giá, mức tăng giảm và diễn biến của thị trường vàng theo từng giai đoạn.
GIÁ VÀNG THẾ GIỚI
Theo dõi giá vàng thế giới theo thời gian thực và nhanh chóng nắm bắt những thay đổi đáng chú ý của thị trường quốc tế.
Thông tin được hiển thị trực quan, thuận tiện khi theo dõi và so sánh với diễn biến giá vàng trong nước.
CHỈ BÁO SỨC MUA – LỰC BÁN
Ứng dụng cung cấp các chỉ báo trực quan về sức mua và lực bán của thị trường, giúp người dùng có thêm thông tin tham khảo khi theo dõi diễn biến và xu hướng giá vàng.
THEO DÕI QUỸ VÀNG SPDR
Theo dõi lượng vàng do SPDR Gold Trust nắm giữ và sự thay đổi lượng vàng theo thời gian.
Dữ liệu SPDR giúp bạn có thêm một nguồn thông tin để tham khảo khi quan sát diễn biến của thị trường vàng thế giới.
WIDGET GIÁ VÀNG
Thêm Widget Giá Vàng vào Màn hình chính để theo dõi nhanh thông tin giá mà không cần mở ứng dụng nhiều lần.
XEM DỮ LIỆU GẦN NHẤT KHI OFFLINE
Khi tạm thời không có kết nối Internet, bạn vẫn có thể xem lại dữ liệu giá vàng và tỷ giá ngoại tệ được ứng dụng lưu gần nhất trên thiết bị.
TIN TỨC THỊ TRƯỜNG
Theo dõi những thông tin đáng chú ý liên quan đến:
• Thị trường vàng trong nước
• Giá vàng thế giới
• Thị trường ngoại tệ
• Kinh tế và tài chính
Tin tức được tổng hợp từ các nguồn báo chí, giúp bạn thuận tiện cập nhật những diễn biến mới của thị trường ngay trong ứng dụng.
QUẢN LÝ VÍ VÀNG – TÍCH CHỈ
Đăng nhập để sử dụng tính năng quản lý ví vàng, tích chỉ và theo dõi lượng vàng của bạn thuận tiện hơn.
THỊ TRƯỜNG & CỘNG ĐỒNG
Tham gia cộng đồng những người cùng quan tâm đến vàng và thị trường tài chính.
GIAO DIỆN ĐƠN GIẢN, TRỰC QUAN
Giá Vàng được thiết kế theo hướng đơn giản, dễ sử dụng và tập trung vào những thông tin quan trọng.
Giá mua – bán, mức tăng giảm, tỷ giá và biểu đồ được bố trí rõ ràng, giúp bạn nhanh chóng tìm thấy thông tin cần thiết.
CÁC TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT
• Xem giá vàng hôm nay
• Cập nhật giá vàng SJC, DOJI và nhiều thương hiệu vàng
• Theo dõi giá vàng thế giới theo thời gian thực
• Xem tỷ giá ngoại tệ VCB, BIDV
• Theo dõi giá mua vào – bán ra và mức biến động
• Biểu đồ giá vàng 1 tuần, 1 tháng, 3 tháng và 1 năm
• Chỉ báo sức mua – lực bán
• Theo dõi lượng vàng SPDR Gold Trust nắm giữ
• Widget Giá Vàng trên Màn hình chính
• Lưu và xem lại dữ liệu gần nhất
• Tin tức vàng, ngoại tệ, kinh tế và tài chính
• Quản lý ví vàng, tích chỉ
Giá Vàng hướng đến việc trở thành công cụ tiện lợi để theo dõi giá vàng hôm nay, giá vàng SJC, DOJI, giá vàng thế giới và tỷ giá ngoại tệ trên iPhone.
Từ giá vàng trong nước, thị trường quốc tế, biểu đồ lịch sử đến SPDR, tỷ giá và tin tức tài chính – những thông tin quan trọng được tập trung trong một ứng dụng để bạn có thể theo dõi thị trường nhanh chóng và thuận tiện mỗi ngày.
