bluejetty:00083616:ios.description:
Dive into the fascinating world of Super Match Factory, the brand new puzzle game from the creators of Royal Mansion & Sneaker Star. Once you play, you will come for Super Match Factory every day!
Welcome to the captivating world of our triple match games! Mix and match it! A unique triple matching game that not only enhances your logic and sorting skills but also provides incredible joy in playing. Find mesmerizing 3D items, conquer levels, and accumulate stars and rewards to unlock even more exciting three match puzzle content!
Connect identical items, sort tiles, and clear the board in this mesmerizing match 3D game. Challenge your puzzle-solving skills as you keep sorting and matching objects until every item is cleared from the screen. It’s not just a puzzle; it’s a test of your wit and strategy.
Stuck on a level? Don't know what to do next? No worries — our super cool boosters will be your reliable allies, helping you overcome any challenges of triple match 3D matching game free and guiding you to victory. Shuffle, transform elements in the triple find factory games – the choice is yours.
Relax and Have Fun! Leave your worries behind and enjoy quality relaxation and fun. Immerse yourself in the soothing game atmosphere , enjoy your brain time and increase your zen!
Improve your memory, find the best sorting strategies, and enhance your logical thinking with each level of triple match 3D matching game free. Play every day to become a true expert in the world of match-three.
Play Anytime, Anywhere without WI-FI! Enjoy the game online or offline, and never worry about Wi-Fi. Whether you’re on a grand adventure or simply taking a break, Super Match Factory will always be there to entertain you. In-app purchases do require an active internet connection.
Become the Master of 3D Puzzles! Time is of the essence in this match 3d game! With each level equipped with a timer, you’ll need to think fast and act even faster to triumph!
Boosters to the Rescue! Stuck on a level? Fear not! Super Match Factory offers a range of powerful boosters to help you overcome tricky situations. Utilize these remarkable tools to advance through the game and unlock exciting items like fruits, candy, cake objects and much more!
Immerse yourself in the world of Super Match Factory, where thrilling 3D puzzles and hidden objects awaits your keen eye and sharp mind! D

bluejetty:00027187:ios.summary:

Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular, healthy, and e
bluejetty:00027187:ios.description:
Fasta is a simple, beautiful, and customizable fasting tracker app. Its elegant interface makes it super easy to track your ongoing fasts and also see your progress over time.
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular, healthy, and effective weight-loss method. Fasta will help you reach your weight goals and develop a healthy lifestyle.
Key features of the app:
• Customise fasting timer with 3 different shapes and 50+ beautiful color themes
• 15+ different fasting plans to choose from
• Create custom fasting plans
• Track your progress with Insights
• 100% private, all the data is stored in the iCloud account
• Understand what's happening inside your body while fasting
• Dark Mode support
• Apple Watch support
• Siri Shortcuts support
• Apple Health app integration helps keep your weight data in sync
• View your progress with widgets
Some of the popular fasting plans are:
• 16-hour fast, or the 16:8 Intermittent Fast, where you fast for 16 hours and have an 8-hour feeding window.
• Circadian Rhythm Fast, this 13-hour fast starts around sunset to align your eating window with your body’s clock. Fasta automatically calculates the daily sunset for you.
• 18-hour fast, or 18:6 for more advanced fasters
• Other popular fasts include OMAD (one meal a day), 20:4 fast, and custom fasts up to 7 days
Fasting plans available in the app:
• Beginner - 12:12, 13:11, 14:10, 15:9
• Intermediate - 16:8, 17:7, 18:6, 19:5
• Advanced - 20:4, 21:3, 22:2, 23:1
• Circadian Rhythm Plans: Straight, Reversed
• Alternate Day Plan - 36:12
• Custom Plans
Read more about our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy here:
https://miary.app/fasta/privacy_terms.html
We are always there for you!
- If you are facing any issues or have questions, please feel free to email us. Hope you enjoy using our app as much as we do! :)

Davis's Drug Guide for Nurses, Twentieth Edition, always puts safety first, emphasizing the medical information nurses need to know to administer medications competently and safely. • Over 5,000 drug monographs covering trade names and generics.
• Organized by generic drug names, with an index that includes generic and trade names, classifications, combination drugs, and herbals.
• Drug-drug, drug-food, drug-natural product interactions.
• Cross-referencing of drugs.
• Herbal content.
• Pedi, Geri, OB, and Lactation cautions.
• IV administration sections.
• REMS (Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies).
• Pharmacogenomic content.
• Canadian-specific content.
• Audio pronunciations for drug names.
• Appendices and much more!
APP FEATURES :

• Search gets you the content you need in a flash.
• Bookmarks return you to your most used content with ease.

bluejetty:00177578:ios.description:
This app should be installed on the child’s iOS device(s).
Keeping your kids safer online requires more than managing screen time. Norton Family helps you supervise and manage your kids’ online activities. 
• Helps you manage your child’s remote learning environment, so you can keep your child focused on schoolwork during the school day.
• It helps block unsuitable sites while your kids are surfing the Internet
• Let’s you see what websites they’re visiting
• Let’s you see what they’re searching for, and so much more…
And while Norton Family lets you set online time limits, it also helps you start open and ongoing conversations about how to build safe and smart online habits. As a parent, it’s important to have insight into what your kids are doing. Our helpful tools allow you to monitor kids’ online activities at a glance or be notified by email alerts, so you know when it’s time to talk. 
IMPORTANT NOTICE: To use the features of Norton Family on your family’s iOS devices, this Norton Family app should first be installed on your child’s iOS device. Parents can configure household policies, manage alerts and reports from family.norton.com. To do this on iOS devices, please download the Norton Family for Parents app.
Help your kids explore, learn, and enjoy their connected world more safely with the following features:
School Time: Remote learning requires the internet, so pausing the internet on your child’s device is not an option. Norton Family School Time is a feature to help parents manage their child’s remote learning environment, so you can keep your child focused on schoolwork and avoid other internet distractions during the school day.
Web Supervision: Let your kids explore the Web freely, with tools that help you block unsuitable websites while keeping you in the know about which sites they’re visiting.
Time Supervision: Stay on top of how much time your kids spend on their devices.
Search Supervision: See words, terms, and phrases your kids are searching for to gain insights into their interests and help protect them from inappropriate content.
Video Supervision*: See a list of the YouTube videos your kids watch on their PCs or iOS devices and even view a snippet of each video, so you know when you need to talk.
Instant Lock: Parents can help kids take a break by locking the device so they can re-focus, or join the family at dinner. Individual devices can be unlocked with a PIN. Parents and children can still contact each other while the device is in lock mode.
Email Alerts: Receive an email when your kids attempt to visit a blocked site so that you can start a conversation about appropriate content.
Access Request: Open the lines of communication by enabling your kids to send you a note from within Norton Family if they disagree with a blocked site or a house rule.
Monthly/Weekly Reports: Opt to receive detailed reports of what your kids are doing online, right in your email in-box.
Any questions? Send us an email nortonfamily.support@gendigital.com
*Video Supervision monitors videos that your kids view on YouTube.com. It does not monitor or track YouTube videos that have been embedded in other websites or blogs.
Mobile app must be downloaded separately.
An account is required to use the Norton Family app. To set up, review, manage and customize your House Rules and Settings for each child you’ve added, sign in to your account at my.norton.com using the credentials you created.

bluejetty:00139803:ios.description:
Command the ultimate floating auto-fortress in Battlecruisers, the visually striking RTS praised for its explosive gameplay, hand-drawn art, and delightfully addictive soundtrack. Also, nukes. 
Command your colossal Battlecruiser as you strategically build and deploy autonomous units: Turrets, Gunships, Artillery, AttackBoats, GatlingMortars, SiegeDestroyers, and SteamCopters. Your fleet self-operates, freeing you to focus purely on strategic decisions. Accelerate construction by deploying more BuilderDrones, racing your opponents to unleash devastating Ultraweapons and dominate quick, intense battles.
Embark on an award-winning single-player campaign as Charlie, an amusingly reckless utility-bot whose joyride aboard the UAC Presidentron’s prized Battlecruiser spirals into chaos. Survive increasingly sophisticated waves of AI warships, cunning mercenaries, and colossal adversaries determined to reclaim the stolen superweapon.
Dive into endless multiplayer mayhem, unlocking new weapons each year and customizing your fleet with cosmetic Bodykits, Exoskeleta, and hilarious Heckles—perfect for taunting friends and foes alike. Premium Mode offers ad-free gameplay and unlocks two turbocharged game modes. All in-app purchases are purely cosmetic; victory is solely dependent on your tactical genius.
Winner of international and indie game design awards every year 2021-2026, Battlecruisers boasts a 90%+ positive rating and has been deemed "prutty good eh" by the esteemed New Zealand Herald.

bluejetty:00065799:ios.summary:

Match your way through more than 10 000 levels of fun with new adventures
bluejetty:00065799:ios.description:
Best Fiends does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items.
Match your way through more than 10 000 levels of fun with new adventures at every turn! Solve challenging puzzles to advance ever closer to Mount Boom and discover the secrets that lie within. Experience match 3 games like never before: draw lines over matching items to create huge combos and unlock tons of fun rewards!
Collect over 50 cute characters, all with their own special powers! Evolve your characters as you progress through each challenge. Build a team of adorable creatures and make your way through fun puzzles as you discover the magical world of Minutia! Amazing storylines and fun adventures await you in the delightful, original BEST FIENDS game!
STORY:
The little creatures of Minutia lived in peace and harmony until the meteor smashed into Mount Boom, bringing with it a strange force that transformed the Slugs who lived there into an army of greedy, greenery-gobbling pests. They are taking over the world, munching a path through Minutia and sliming up everything they touch! Embark on a quest to solve the mystery of Mount Boom.
Be the HERO of the story!
BEST FIENDS FEATURES:
Match 3 Puzzle Adventure:
- Adventure through an engaging story filled with over 7000 levels of puzzle fun!
- Draw lines over matching items for longer combos in this unique take on match 3 games.
Collect Cute Characters:
- Over 50 characters to collect, from Brittle the nervous housefly to Karma the colorblind chameleon.
- Collect the adorable Fiends of Minutia and create a group of unique heroes.
- Band your little heroes together to solve puzzles!
- Level up, strengthen, and evolve each character to make a cute and unstoppable team of Fiends!
Blast Through Events:
- Collect rewards every time you open the game with Daily Events.
- Challenge your Facebook Friends, send and receive gifts, and earn massive rewards.
- Stay tuned for regular updates that bring new levels, characters, and surprises!
To get to Mount Boom, they’ll need to become… the BEST FIENDS!
VIP SUBSCRIPTION
Best Fiends now offers a monthly VIP subscription on top of the other great gameplay features. VIP players have Infinite Energy, Ad-Free Play (Spin the Fiend of Fortune and win - without ads) as well as Exclusive Discounts!
The VIP subscription is available on a monthly tier, which auto-renews. The monthly subscription is priced at $14.99 / month. The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of the purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off in at least 24-hours before the end of the current payment period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Best Fiends is intended for those 18 and older. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Best Fiends may also contain advertising. You may require an internet connection to play Best Fiends and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality, compatibility and interoperability of Best Fiends in the above description and additional app store information. 
By downloading this game, you agree to future game updates as released on your app store or social network. You may choose to update this game, but if you do not update, your game experience and functionalities may be reduced.
Terms of Service: https://www.playtika.com/terms-service/
Privacy Notice: https://www.playtika.com/privacy-notice/
Watch Best Fiends on YouTube youtube.com/bestfiends

• Interac e-Transfer 
• Bank Transfer (EFT) 
• Bill payments 
• Debit card payments

• Higher transfer limits up to $1 million. 
• Generate tax-ready receipts instantly. 
— Exceptional Customer Experience: 
• Friendly 24/7 multilingual support via chat, phone, and email. 
• Easy-to-use interface optimized for both iPhone and iPad. 
• Real-time transaction notifications and transfer tracking. 
• Simple, 3-step transfers designed for convenience and clarity. 
Additional Services:

• Instant activation to stay connected in 150+ countries. 
• Avoid expensive roaming fees and stay in touch anywhere you travel. 
— International Mobile Top-ups: 
• Instant mobile top-ups for loved ones globally. 
• Supports all major international carriers, ensuring your family stays connected effortlessly. 
Currency Exchange Service: 
• Exchange major currencies online, including USD⇄CAD . 
• Competitive rates without hidden commissions or fees. 
Advanced Features for Maximum Convenience: 
• Real-time currency rate alerts to help you save. 
• Built-in currency converter providing instant FX insights. 
• Personalized notifications for transaction statuses, ensuring peace of mind. 
Community & Trust: 
• Join over 200,000 satisfied Canadian users. 
• Thousands of verified 5-star reviews praising ease of use, reliability, and transparent fees. 
How It Works:

2. Choose your transfer destination, amount, and payment method. 
3. Complete a quick, one-time identity verification. 
4. Send money instantly with complete transparency and security.

bluejetty:00200176:ios.name: The Christmas List
bluejetty:00200176:ios.summary: The #1 Shopping App in the US – The Christmas List is an easy-to-use app to help you organize your Christmas lists and budget so you can spend less time buying presents for the ones you love and more time being present with the ones you lov
bluejetty:00200176:ios.description:
The #1 Shopping App in the US – The Christmas List is an easy-to-use app to help you organize your Christmas lists and budget so you can spend less time buying presents for the ones you love and more time being present with the ones you love!
_________________________________________
EASY PROGRESS TRACKING
Track gifts by to do, purchased, shipping, received, and wrapped. When editing a list you can change the status of multiple gifts at once (for example, when you are wrapping gifts you can change the status of those gifts from purchased to wrapped all at once).
EASY BUDGETING
Set a budget for a person or don’t – it’s up to you. The Christmas Lists tracks the budget for you. It’s so easy that The Christmas List has been recommended for managing holiday spending by
 • Good Housekeeping
 • The Motley Fool
 • mint.com
 • BankRate.com
 • CNBC
SHOPPING OVERVIEW
Simple, at-a-glance views of shopping progress including budget.
ADD GIFTS LIKE JOTTING A NOTE
Adding a list of gifts is as simple as typing (or even dictating) a note. Just place each gift name on a new line and The Christmas List transforms your note into a gift list. It’s like Christmas Magic!
IMPORT FROM YOUR CONTACTS
Get a jumpstart on your lists by importing select recipients from your existing contacts.
EASY SHARING
Easily share lists using AirDrop, email, iCloud Drive, or Messages. Use AirDrop to quickly share a single recipient or an entire group.
SHOPPING LISTS BY STORE
Once you select a store for a gift, The Christmas List remembers that store and automatically builds a shopping list for the store to help make sure you get everything you need when you are out and about.
MULTIPLE GIFT RECIPIENTS
Once you create a gift you can copy it to other recipients on your list without the need to retype the details.
POPULAR RETAILERS
The Christmas List comes with a list of popular retailers, but if you don’t see the one you are looking for you can easily add your own. You can even use emoji in the store name.
ADD PHOTOS
Add photos for gifts and people from your photo library, clipboard, or camera.
CHRISTMAS COUNTDOWN
See a countdown to the number of shopping days until Christmas right in the app.
PRINTING
Print lists directly from the app.
NO PEEKING
Optional password protection – set up a PIN or use Touch ID to keep out snoops.
EDIT MULTIPLE GIFTS AT ONCE
Changing the status of several gifts at once has always been possible on the lists by status (accessed via the Progress tab). Now the lists by person and the lists by store can do it too. Also new is the ability to change the store for multiple gifts at once. It’s never been easier to keep track of what’s wrapped, shipped, and left to do.
_________________________________________
PEOPLE ARE TALKING…
"The Christmas List is solidly better...with more options and an easier interface." 
 – The New York Times 
"...it’s happy-making" 
 – Yahoo! News 
"Some of The Christmas List’s best features are the little details that the app just gets right." 
 – Macworld 
"Hooray for productivity!" 
 – MSN Tech 
"It's a handy way to keep track of what you have bought…" 
 – LA Times 
"…everything you need" 
 – Mashable.com 
“…great for keeping a budget and tracking shopping progress”
 – Business Insider
_________________________________________
SEE A VIDEO DEMO AT www.limbua.com

Let the hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack and meticulously designed pixel art e
bluejetty:00028388:ios.description:
Unleash your fears in a fourth-wall-breaking platformer horror game that will leave you questioning allegiances... and reality itself.
SINISTER PIXEL ART WORLD
Let the hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack and meticulously designed pixel art engulf you in paranormal encounters, impossible glitches, psychological horror, and the nostalgia of classic side-scrolling games.
COZY COMPANIONS
Enjoy the guidance of A.I.D.E. and a very kind and morally right "Dev," who'll be there to assist players every step of the way. The companions also help give an eerie charm to the surreal experience of playing this unique game. Players also encounter eccentric characters, scary creatures, and unsettling corruptions along their journey.
CHALLENGING BUT FAIR
Experience terror as you navigate nightmarish yet fair platforming challenges with precision and dread. The old-school hard gameplay is reminiscent of classic games that are hard to put down, preparing the brain for the kind of scares that make most analog horror media effective.
FOURTH-WALL-BREAKING STORY
Dive into thrilling meta-horror that defies the boundaries of the creepypasta genre, blending fear and suspense into a truly surreal experience. In DERE Vengeance, the player is part of the story.
HAUNTING JOURNEY
Embrace the perfect blend of nightmare and adventure in this story-rich platformer that promises genuine scares and enjoyable gameplay. You can embark on DERE Vengeance without playing our other games, though not advisable, as this terrifying adventure stands on its own with a unique and intriguing experience.
Unravel the story of DERE Vengeance, the heart-pounding new entry in the critically acclaimed horror game saga DERE EXE and DERE EVIL EXE!

bluejetty:00185701:ios.summary: Partition between clues with walls to create islands with corresponding size! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clues in various places. The object is to create islands by partitioning between clues with walls so that the number of
bluejetty:00185701:ios.description:
Partition between clues with walls to create islands with corresponding size! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing clues in various places. The object is to create islands by partitioning between clues with walls so that the number of squares in each island is equal to the value of the clue, all walls form a continuous path and there are no wall areas of 2x2 or larger. Each island must contain one clue and be isolated from other islands horizontally and vertically.
Nurikabe are addictive island-forming puzzles which were invented in Japan. Using pure logic and requiring no math to solve, these fascinating puzzles offer endless fun and intellectual entertainment to puzzle fans of all skills and ages.
The game features a highlighting option to help see if a wall segment is about to become isolated, and an island size counter to view how many squares belong to an island.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Conceptis Nurikabe includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 90 free Nurikabe puzzles
• 30 extra-large puzzles bonus for iPad only
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Highlight wall segments
• Show island size counter
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Nurikabe have also become popular under other names such as Islands in the Stream and Cell Structure. Similar to Sudoku, Kakuro and Hashi, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.

For more fun, Conceptis Nurikabe includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.

PUZZLE FEATURES

• 90 free Nurikabe puzzles
• 30 extra-large puzzles bonus for iPad only
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills

GAMING FEATURES

• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Highlight wall segments
• Show island size counter
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud

ABOUT

Nurikabe have also become popular under other names such as Islands in the Stream and Cell Structure. Similar to Sudoku, Kakuro and Hashi, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

bluejetty:00186216:ios.description:
Build airplanes by snapping parts together, designing wing sections, and attaching engines. At any time, you can strap yourself into the cockpit and see how it flies with realistic physics. If you're not in the mood for building, over 250,000 airplanes are available to download for free.
BUILD AIRPLANES
You have the tools you'll need to bring any airplane to life. Snap parts together to build your airplane's body. Place engines to add thrust. Design and attach wings and then strap yourself into the cockpit and see how it flies. 
DOWNLOAD AIRPLANES
Over 250,000 airplanes are available to download for free from SimplePlanes.com. Find anything from old WW2 bombers to next-generation fighters to sci-fi spacecraft. You can upload your own airplanes and rise through the ranks from a bronze builder to a gold level builder.
DYNAMIC FLIGHT MODEL
Flight simulation at its finest. Every little change you make in the designer impacts how the airplane flies. Weight distribution, thrust, lift, and drag are all calculated continuously while flying. Parts can break off in spectacular fashion while flying due to over-stress or by hitting something. The fun won't stop there though. You can keep on flying even with a missing wing if you've got the skills.
SANDBOX MODE
Use all available parts to build airplanes with no restrictions. The sky is the limit. Literally.
CHALLENGES
Climb into the cockpit of one of your custom aircraft and see how it does in the challenges. Land on aircraft carriers, dodge surface-to-air missiles, race through courses, and so much more.
EDUCATIONAL
Tutorials will help players learn the basics of real airplane design and the considerations that need to be taken when airplanes are made.

bluejetty:00023877:ios.description:
Téléchargez l’application RMC sur mobile et tablette et écoutez gratuitement votre radio en direct et en podcasts. Ne manquez rien des derniers sujets d’actu, Suivez en live les débats et événements forts de l’actualité en France et à l’international (politique, société, économie, pouvoir d’achat...). 
RMC : la radio Foot et Sport en direct. Les dernières infos sportives et de toutes vos compétitions favorites : ligue 1, mercato, ligue des champions, rugby, top 14, tennis, Tour de France, F1. 
LE DIRECT RADIO 
L’intégralité de vos émissions Sport en accès gratuit directement sur l’application : 
L’After Foot avec Daniel Riolo et Gilbert Brisbois, le show de référence sur l’actualité foot : débat et news sur la ligue 1 et la Champion’s League, le tour des grands championnats (Premiere League, Bundesliga, Serie A) et des grands clubs (PSG, OM, Barcelone, Real Madrid etc…) 
Super Moscato Show : Vincent Moscato aborde l’actualité sportive du jour et anime le Kikadi et le Journal Moyen, épaulé de sa Dream Team composé de Pierre Dorian, Adrien Aigoin, Éric Di Meco, Maryse Ewanjé-Epée, Denis Charvet et Stephen Brun. 
Rothen s'enflamme, des débats enflammés avec la dream team d'anciens joueurs passionnés : Emmanuel Petit, Eric Di Meco, Lionel Charbonnier, Julien Cazarre etc…
Toutes vos émissions préférées d’actu et de débat en direct sont aussi disponibles gratuitement : 
Les Grandes Gueules, le talk-show avec débats animés et échanges musclés : pouvoir d’achat, énergie, prix de l’essence etc… 
Apolline Matin : le grand show de l’info matinal mêlant débats, réactions, et intervention d’experts 
Estelle Midi : votre nouveau talk-show d'opinion et de débats 
RMC GOLD
Découvrez RMC Gold, la radio digitale 100 % musicale de RMC, qui vous transporte au cœur des années 80 et 90 avec des hits incontournables. 
En streaming 24/24, RMC Gold vous offre une ambiance rétro réveillant la nostalgie de ces années dorées. 
Laissez-vous emporter par une sélection de titres inoubliables de ces décennies, soigneusement choisis pour raviver vos plus beaux souvenirs. 
Disco, funk, variété, pop et rock sont au rendez-vous dans une programmation musicale riche et variée, où chaque chanson est une madeleine de Proust. 
Et pour prolonger l'expérience RMC Gold, en soirée de 22h à minuit, la Libre Antenne de Max offre un espace de partage et de convivialité où vos histoires, vos anecdotes et vos souvenirs prennent vie… 
Écoutez RMC Gold dès maintenant et laissez la magie de vos tubes préférés rythmer votre quotidien.
LES SHOWS EN VIDÉOS ET PODCASTS 
Vous avez raté une émission ? Retrouvez-la en replay vidéo ou écoutez-la en podcast 
Profitez d’une expérience audio optimisée grâce au mini player qui vous suit lors de la navigation. 
Vous pouvez également programmer la fin de l'écoute de votre radio préférée avec le minuteur de veille. 
Grâce au slider présent sur la page d’accueil, retrouvez l’univers de chacune de vos émissions préférées avec l’intégralité des contenus articles, vidéos et podcasts. 
L’INFO EN TEMPS RÉEL 
Suivez les actualités et tout le sport avec nos articles et vidéos 
Intervenez en live avec le direct studio 
Soyez alerté en temps réel grâce aux notifications 
Consultez les articles de la rédaction enrichis en vidéos et live 
Analyses, scores, résultats live, soyez au cœur des événements sportifs 
Vos avis sont précieux pour l’évolution de l’application, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse email suivante pour nous faire vos retours : 
--> apps@rmcbfm.com

Ne manquez rien des derniers sujets d’actu, Suivez en live les débats et événements forts de l’actualité en France et à l’international (politique, société, économie, pouvoir d’achat...). 
 

RMC : la radio Foot et Sport en direct. Les dernières infos sportives et de toutes vos compétitions favorites : ligue 1, mercato, ligue des champions, rugby, top 14, tennis, Tour de France, F1. 
  

LE DIRECT RADIO 


L’intégralité de vos émissions Sport en accès gratuit directement sur l’application : 

L’After Foot avec Daniel Riolo et Gilbert Brisbois, le show de référence sur l’actualité foot : débat et news sur la ligue 1 et la Champion’s League, le tour des grands championnats (Premiere League, Bundesliga, Serie A) et des grands clubs (PSG, OM, Barcelone, Real Madrid etc…) 


Super Moscato Show : Vincent Moscato aborde l’actualité sportive du jour et anime le Kikadi et le Journal Moyen, épaulé de sa Dream Team composé de Pierre Dorian, Adrien Aigoin, Éric Di Meco, Maryse Ewanjé-Epée, Denis Charvet et Stephen Brun. 


Rothen s'enflamme, des débats enflammés avec la dream team d'anciens joueurs passionnés : Emmanuel Petit, Eric Di Meco, Lionel Charbonnier, Julien Cazarre etc…
 

Toutes vos émissions préférées d’actu et de débat en direct sont aussi disponibles gratuitement : 


Les Grandes Gueules, le talk-show avec débats animés et échanges musclés : pouvoir d’achat, énergie, prix de l’essence etc… 

Apolline Matin : le grand show de l’info matinal mêlant débats, réactions, et intervention d’experts 

Estelle Midi : votre nouveau talk-show d'opinion et de débats 


RMC GOLD


Découvrez RMC Gold, la radio digitale 100 % musicale de RMC, qui vous transporte au cœur des années 80 et 90 avec des hits incontournables. 


En streaming 24/24, RMC Gold vous offre une ambiance rétro réveillant la nostalgie de ces années dorées. 


Laissez-vous emporter par une sélection de titres inoubliables de ces décennies, soigneusement choisis pour raviver vos plus beaux souvenirs. 


Disco, funk, variété, pop et rock sont au rendez-vous dans une programmation musicale riche et variée, où chaque chanson est une madeleine de Proust. 


Et pour prolonger l'expérience RMC Gold, en soirée de 22h à minuit, la Libre Antenne de Max offre un espace de partage et de convivialité où vos histoires, vos anecdotes et vos souvenirs prennent vie… 


Écoutez RMC Gold dès maintenant et laissez la magie de vos tubes préférés rythmer votre quotidien.


LES SHOWS EN VIDÉOS ET PODCASTS 


Vous avez raté une émission ? Retrouvez-la en replay vidéo ou écoutez-la en podcast 

Profitez d’une expérience audio optimisée grâce au mini player qui vous suit lors de la navigation. 

Vous pouvez également programmer la fin de l'écoute de votre radio préférée avec le minuteur de veille.  

Grâce au slider présent sur la page d’accueil, retrouvez l’univers de chacune de vos émissions préférées avec l’intégralité des contenus articles, vidéos et podcasts. 
  

L’INFO EN TEMPS RÉEL 


Suivez les actualités et tout le sport avec nos articles et vidéos 

Intervenez en live avec le direct studio 

Soyez alerté en temps réel grâce aux notifications 

Consultez les articles de la rédaction enrichis en vidéos et live 

Analyses, scores, résultats live, soyez au cœur des événements sportifs 



Vos avis sont précieux pour l’évolution de l’application, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse email suivante pour nous faire vos retours : 

--> apps@rmcbfm.com

Agora você compra sua passagem direto pelo aplicativo Viaje Guanabara!
ATENÇÃO: os dados do seu login e senha permanecem os mesmos, acesse sua conta e garanta sua viagem direto do seu celular.
Pelo aplicativo Viaje Guanabara:
- Você escaneia seu e-ticket para agilizar o embarque
- Tira todas as suas dúvidas sobre viajar de ônibus com a Guanabara
- Suas informações ficam salvas para futuras viagens com a Guanabara
Com a Guanabara você viaja de ônibus para mais de 2.000 destinos, de Norte a Sul do país. Além das melhores viagens do Brasil, a Guanabara tem o compromisso com a segurança, a inovação na tecnologia, a responsabilidade ambiental e claro, a satisfação dos viajantes do início ao fim. Com uma frota de mais de 400 ônibus, o conforto e a qualidade estão garantidos, com carregador USB, conexão wi-fi e ar-condicionado. Tudo pra você ter a melhor experiência até o seu destino. 
Com uma ampla variedade de passagens para os principais destinos do Brasil, a Viaje Guanabara conecta cidades por todo o país com conforto, segurança e economia. São diversas rotas e horários flexíveis, além de opções de ônibus leito, executivo e semi-leito, tudo pensado para oferecer a melhor experiência de viagem.
Aqui, você encontra as melhores opções de transporte rodoviário. Comprar sua passagem de ônibus nunca foi tão fácil: rápido e sem complicação pelo aplicativo Viaje Guanabara.
A Guanabara é considerada a melhor empresa de ônibus do país e não para de crescer.
Agora, as empresas Real Expresso, Rápido Federal, UTIL, Viação Sampaio, Brisa e Guanabara fazem parte de uma só família. Essa união marca o início de uma nova fase, pautada pela integração e pela excelência operacional do maior grupo de transporte rodoviário do país.
Vem pro app Viaje Guanabara e embarque na sua próxima viagem!

bluejetty:00070891:ios.description:
It has been decades since the Human Union first initiated the Mars Colonization Program. After generations of endeavor, humans have made themselves a new home on this red globe, living in harmony with its native inhabitants, the insectoid species known as the Swarm.
However, the peace was soon broken due to some known reasons for the Swarm's mutation. The human race on Mars has faced dire challenges from these primitive creatures. The once friendly neighbors become hostile enemies.
Sustaining the human race and protecting the lives on Mars is the top priority. And, finding out why Swarm turned so aggressive all of a sudden can get to the root of the problem.
General, set your foot on Mars and build your Base to protect our people! It is a road paved with thorns, a road less traveled. But use a little strategy and unite with your allies; you can be the great keeper of the human civilization on this inner planet!
[Features]
* Explore the unknown areas on Mars, attack Swarms, and rescue the survivors. When your Exploration Progress reaches 100%, you can fully expand your Base and elevate your power! But be careful when exploring outside, for you may bump into giant alien sandworms and spiders!
* Unite with your allies in an Alliance and grow big together. Here you can enjoy the adventure with players from all around the world. All the Alliance Members can fight together and grow together through thick and thin. Sticks in a bundle are unbreakable!
* Captain is the leader of the army, your trustworthy right-hand man. Developing your Captain’s Skills and crafting the Equipment for your Captain will grant you various boosts.
* Recruit Heroes in the Space Capsule and build yourself an elite squad! These Heroes from various backgrounds all have a common understanding of what we are up against. They will be the helping hands in carrying out various missions!
* Each step on Mars requires thorough planning. Make wise plans when constructing various buildings and conducting technological research. Remember to manufacture the best Mecha Warriors and dispatch them with a clear purpose. A brilliant General always sees the way to victory.
[Notes]
* This game includes random-item purchases.
* Network connection is required.
* Privacy Policy: http://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/
* Terms of Use: http://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00150486:ios.summary: mycentralbank.mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life eas
bluejetty:00150486:ios.description:
mycentralbank.mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with mycentralbank.mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the mycentralbank.mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Central Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

CityTransit is your all-in-one transit companion for getting around major US cities and beyond.
Whether you’re commuting in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Washington DC, and more, or traveling internationally, CityTransit h
bluejetty:00087223:ios.description:
CityTransit is your all-in-one transit companion for getting around major US cities and beyond.
Whether you’re commuting in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Washington DC, and more, or traveling internationally, CityTransit helps you move with confidence using real-time arrivals, live vehicle tracking, and smart trip tools.
KEY FEATURES
Real-Time Transit Tracking
Track buses, trains, subways, and streetcars live on the map.
Fast Nearby Departures
See nearby stops and upcoming departures instantly so you can make quick decisions on the go.
Powerful Trip Planner
Plan A-to-B trips with clear route options, transfer details, and map-based directions.
Live Trip Tracking + Live Activities
Track active trips with live progress and ETA updates on Dynamic Island and Lock Screen.
Arrival Alarms
Set “time to go” alarms for specific arrivals so you get notified before your vehicle reaches your stop.
Service Alerts
Get in-app transit service alerts for delays, disruptions, and route changes.
Favorites for Stops and Routes
Save both your most-used stops and your go-to routes for faster access every day.
Route and Schedule Details
Browse route paths, directions, and stop-level info in one place.
Transit Maps
Open transit map PDFs in-app, with caching for faster repeat access.
Easy City Setup
Use location-based setup or choose your city manually to quickly configure local agencies.
CityTransit supports many major transit systems, including agencies like MTA, CTA, LA Metro, MBTA, WMATA, SEPTA, NJ Transit, BART, TTC, and many more.
Supported cities include:
New York City, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Washington DC, Boston, Philadelphia, Seattle, Miami, Atlanta, Portland, Denver, Baltimore, San Diego, Minneapolis, Houston, Phoenix, Dallas, Las Vegas, Toronto, Calgary, Montreal, Quebec City, Vancouver, London, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Canberra, Auckland, Wellington, and many more worldwide.
See full supported regions:
https://thecitytransit.com/regions
Data note:
Transit data is provided via publicly available agency feeds. Feature availability can vary by city and transit provider.
Keep in touch:
support@thecitytransit.com
https://thecitytransit.com

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00038482:ios.description:
Stay on top of your plan or prepaid service with My Vodafone. View and pay bills, recharge your prepaid service, check your usage and update your account settings. Choose from multiple payment options on eligible purchases such as credit/debit card, voucher, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Alipay.
Check your usage
See how much of your included data and international call minutes you have left. 
Manage your plan
Pay your bill, change plans, manage direct debit, or view recent bills. You can also purchase add-ons.
Manage your prepaid service
Recharge your prepaid service and view your recharge history.
Manage your nbn™ service
Pay your bill, manage direct debit, or view recent bills. You can also check your installation appointment, activation date or track delivery of your modem.
The features of the app are subject to change. The app is free but download charges apply for downloading from the App Store. BetterMe: Mental Health—an all-in-one app for your mental well-being, offering meditations, courses, and other tools.
Mindfulness is key to a balanced life, and BetterMe offers simple, practical relaxation methods for everyone, whether you're just starting out or already a pro. Dive into guided practices and start discovering your inner peace today—let's embrace the good vibes together!
Teaming up with mental health experts, we have used effective tools and strategies from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) to help you tune in to the world surrounding you.
Incorporate mindfulness into your daily routine through guided meditations, stress-relief practices, breathwork, sleep meditations, and hundreds of mental health exercises. When your mind is clear, you concentrate better, feel inspired, and get more life energy.
Just a few minutes can really boost your well-being. Opt for quick breathing practices to set the intention for the day or longer meditations to soothe your nerves.
Start your journey with BetterMe as you reduce stress, discover self-love, and enhance your mental well-being.
BetterMe Mental Health features:
• Step-by-step plan
Get your daily tasks for morning, afternoon, and evening. Each one consists of a breathing exercise or guided meditation and takes no more than 5 minutes.
• Breathing exercises
Access a collection of 3-minute breathing sessions to shake off worry, stress, and anger. Practice anytime and anywhere—whether you're walking, taking the bus, or waiting in line.
• Meditations
Explore hundreds of guided meditations to boost mindfulness, recharge your energy, and fully embrace the present moment.
• Sleep stories and calming sounds
Relax with soothing stories and mellow sounds to enhance your sleep quality and unwind after a long day.
• Mix and match relaxation sounds
Snow Steps, Beach Waves, Birds, Cat Purr, Fire, Forest, Rain, and more—create an ideal atmosphere that aligns with your emotions.
Turn on our sleep timer to wrap up your evening on the perfect note.
• Interactive Mental Assistant
Start a chat with your go-to advisor for emotional support and guidance.
Download Mental Health app now and embark on your journey to a more peaceful, balanced life.
We offer flexible subscription plans, so you can choose what suits you best. Please note that subscriptions automatically renew within 24 hours before the end of the free trial or the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your Apple ID settings. If a free trial is available, any unused portion will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
BetterMe: Mental Health provides general guidance on relaxation and mindfulness. It is not designed or intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any health conditions. The insights from the app are not a substitute for professional medical care and might not be suitable for everyone. Before adopting any advice or activities described above, always consult a healthcare professional. Use this app at your own discretion.

Greysheet: Coin & Currency Pricing
Trusted by dealers, investors, and collectors worldwide, Greysheet is the industry standard for pricing and catalog data in numismatics. Our FREE app delivers professional-level pricing and research tools
bluejetty:00161146:ios.description:
Greysheet: Coin & Currency Pricing
Trusted by dealers, investors, and collectors worldwide, Greysheet is the industry standard for pricing and catalog data in numismatics. Our FREE app delivers professional-level pricing and research tools for anyone serious about coins and paper money. A paid companion subscription is required to access pricing in the app.
For over 50 years, Greysheet has been the undisputed authority on U.S. and world coin and currency pricing. With hourly price updates, you can rely on the most accurate wholesale and retail pricing available—across all grades, mints, and varieties.
Greysheet continues to expand its coverage to meet the evolving needs of the numismatic community, offering transparent, market-driven pricing backed by real auction data.
Backed by Whitman Brands
Greysheet is published by Whitman Brands, the world’s leading numismatic publisher and the parent company behind trusted resources including Greysheet, Greensheet, Red Book, Bank Note Book, Friedberg, and more. When you use Greysheet, you’re using the same data professionals rely on every day.
What You Get
1+ million wholesale and retail prices
2.5+ million auction records from major auction houses
8+ million high-resolution images
Coverage across U.S. coins, world coins, and paper money
App Features
Complete listings with all relevant mint marks, grades, and designations
Wholesale & retail pricing for:
U.S. coins (Greysheet & CPG)
World coins (Greysheet & CPG)
U.S. paper money (Greensheet & CPG)
World bank notes (The Banknote Book)
Auction prices realized
Gold, silver, and platinum spot prices
Industry news
Events directory
Dealer directory
U.S. Coin Series Covered 
===================
Colonial & Post-Colonial Coinage, Half Cents, Large Cents, Flying Eagle Cents, Indian Cents, Lincoln Cents, 2-Cent & 3-Cent Pieces, Shield Nickels, Liberty “V” Nickels, Buffalo Nickels, Jefferson Nickels, Half Dimes, Dimes, Quarters, Half Dollars, Dollars, Gold Coins ($1–$20), Classic & Modern Commemoratives, Proof & Mint Sets, Hawaiian Coins & Tokens, American Silver Eagles, and more.
(Full coverage includes all major types, varieties, grades, and mint marks.)
U.S. Currency Covered 
===================
Colonial & Continental Currency, Demand Notes, Legal Tender Notes, Treasury Notes, National Bank Notes, Federal Reserve Notes & Bank Notes, Gold & Silver Certificates, Fractional Currency, WWII Emergency Issues, and all major small- and large-size U.S. paper money types.
World Bank Notes Covered 
===================
Over 310 countries covered with exhaustive detail for each issuer and bank note.
World Coins Covered 
===================
We are growing our coverage of world coins with an early emphasis on Canada, Mexico, UK, Australia, and modern issues.
Subscriptions
===================
Greysheet pricing is available through auto-renewable subscriptions billed to your Apple ID. Plans renew monthly or annually unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.greysheet.com/terms-of-use
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.greysheet.com/privacy-policy

Reference the official 1986 version of Luther’s Small Catechism wherever you are. This beautifully designed app makes reading and navigating the Small Catechism easy and convenient.

About Luther’s Small Catechism 
Brief, clear summaries of God’s Word allow individuals and families alike to use Luther’s Small Catechism as a powerful tool and prayer book. Though the catechism was written by Martin Luther in 1529, its question and answer format provides Christians with a timeless and easy-to-use guidebook that is applicable to all the various callings we have in life. 
The Small Catechism explores the Six Chief Parts of Christian Doctrine: the Ten Commandments, the Apostles’ Creed, the Lord’s Prayer, the Sacrament of Holy Baptism, Confession, and the Sacrament of the Altar. It also includes daily prayers, a table of duties for Christians, and a guide for Christians to use as they prepare to receive Holy Communion.

bluejetty:00148452:ios.description:
كورسي هو تطبيق تعليمي تفاعلي يحتوي على دروس خصوصية للمناهج العراقية من الثالث متوسط وللسادس الاعدادي.
دروس كورسي مشروحة من قبل افضل الاساتذة العراقيين المدربين على احسن وسائل التعليم الفنلندية الحديثة والمتطورة بحيث الدروس مشروحة بطريقة سهلة وسريعة ولا تاخذ منك وقت طويل ويكون التطبيق هو الحل الامثل من تدرس بليلة الامتحان وماتعرف منين تبدي. اقوى درس عند كورسي هو ١٠ دقائق والنجاح مضمون

١- محاضراته السريعة والملخصة
٢- مشروحة بطريقة علمية وادوات تقنية حديثة
٣- الاساتذة الاكفاء وطريقة تدريبهم
٤- شكل التطبيقات وخصائصه الشبابية الي تسوي واهس
٥- الملخصات, الفيديوهات, الاختبارات موجودة كلها بمكان واحد

The translation officer of Yimiao Frog is more flexible and practical, providing efficient and high-quality services, which is more convenient than bringing a translator with you.

bluejetty:00073531:ios.name: Universal Remote TV Control
bluejetty:00073531:ios.summary:
A TV remote always going missing? Or you just can’t stand the very sight of this old-school device anymore? Then you are in the right place—using a remote control app on your phone will save you all these headaches.
Universal Remote TV Con
bluejetty:00073531:ios.description:
A TV remote always going missing? Or you just can’t stand the very sight of this old-school device anymore? Then you are in the right place—using a remote control app on your phone will save you all these headaches.
Universal Remote TV Control brings watching TV to a new level!
It’s a handy no-frills application that lets you control a web-connected TV set from your iPhone. The app copies the functionality of the handheld remote and allows you to rule over everything: channels list, volume, menu, info, tools, and other controls (Play/Pause/Stop, etc.). It works with the most popular brands—Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic, Vizio, TCL, Toshiba, Xfinity, Insignia, Hisense, Element etc.—and supports TV models of different years of production and screen size. The only thing required is to connect your iPhone and your TV device to the same Wifi network—and your touchscreen will turn into a navigation pane with all the functions of the usual remote.
FEATURES: 
• Quick and simple to use: the app serves as the physical remote and is always at hand 
• Automatic customization: makes things a bit more user-friendly to set up
• Haptic feedback: gives this awesome vibration and sense of realism
• Nice responsive touchpad: for the aesthetically pleasing look, feel, and touch
• Keyboard input: makes TV searching a no-brainer
• Works through WIFI: the app automatically detects any TVs on your network for you to control everything smartly with your phone
Universal Remote TV Control is a full-featured mobile version of a physical TV remote that makes your life much easier. No need to get up from the couch and go for the remote or firestick or to buy a new one in case you lost it. Sync the app with your device to browse your favorite shows, movies, and programs easily with a phone. Make the most out of technology for your better smarter life!
Disclaimer:
Universal Remote TV Control is NOT the official application of Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic, Vizio, TCL, Toshiba, Xfinity, insignia, Hisense, Roku, Fire TV, Element and it is NOT affiliated with or endorsed by these or any other companies.
For complete access to all Universal Remote TV Control features, you will need to subscribe to Premium.
For Smart TVs / Devices, the only setting required is to connect your phone as well as your Smart TV / Device to the same Wifi network.
For IR(Infared) TVs, your phone must have a built-in Infrared (IR) feature for the app to work as a remote control.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal depends on your subscription plan. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in the user’s Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Privacy Policy: https://remotetv.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://remotetv.app/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00159807:ios.name: Game of Evolution: Merge Life
bluejetty:00159807:ios.summary: Evolve! Start evolving right now, and you won't be able to stop! Don't be shy - evolve over breakfast, on the way to work, in a traffic jam, or on public transportation. Evolve during your lunch break, over dinner, and before bed. Evolve wh
bluejetty:00159807:ios.description:
Evolve! Start evolving right now, and you won't be able to stop! Don't be shy - evolve over breakfast, on the way to work, in a traffic jam, or on public transportation. Evolve during your lunch break, over dinner, and before bed. Evolve wherever you want! Evolution is so much fun! It's "the greatest show on Earth". And now it's right in your pocket!
"Evolution: Clicker" is an idle game, or in other words they are called "clickers" or "games that play by themselves". How does this happen? For example, in the game "2048" you have numbers: you merge and move from 2 to 2048. Similar mechanics are in the Game of Evolution. You click and evolve from amoeba to human.
Start with the simplest organisms, then climb higher and higher up the tree of evolution: the evolution of species —> evolution of animals —> human evolution. Try to go through the evolution of the simplest species, be smart on the evolution of animals and be sure to fix the result of human evolution. Do not forget the main thing-to click!
The application is all for real: in the game you go through the evolution of the Proterozoic era to the modern world. Develop humanity and develop yourself. Click — go through the levels, earn coins and evolve. Click — get rewards for tasks, buy characters and evolve. You can accelerate evolution, but never stop! Evolution must continue!
And if you think you're almost done evolving, keep in mind that evolution never stops. It's an endless process of transformation where something new and exciting is always just about to appear. So keep on tapping, and new forms of life will fill the world of Evolution.
Child, teenager, adult - our idle game will appeal to everyone! Because it is colorful, interesting and very exciting! The incredible, addictive, amazing world of Evolution is waiting for everyone. You can't just stop evolving. Don't believe it? Try it for yourself!

bluejetty:00022127:ios.name: 贝乐虎识字-小学早教启蒙识字游戏
bluejetty:00022127:ios.summary:
【贝乐虎识字】汇聚1500个常用启蒙汉字、500个精讲汉字、700节内容，以“字词句练”简单四步科学设定认知节奏，循序渐进，寓培于乐，培养儿童的识字兴趣和阅读习惯。
【关于贝乐虎】
贝乐虎是中国儿童内容领域的创新者，凭借多年在儿童启蒙内容上的深耕，成为国民级品牌。我们的核心理念是“快乐陪伴、寓教于乐”，致力于为0-8岁的宝宝们打造互动、多元的高品质儿童内容。贝乐虎是孩子们成长路上的欢笑伙伴，为激发创造力、启发智慧而不懈努力。和贝乐虎一起，让每个孩子都能在欢笑中茁壮成长。
bluejetty:00022127:ios.description:
【贝乐虎识字】汇聚1500个常用启蒙汉字、500个精讲汉字、700节内容，以“字词句练”简单四步科学设定认知节奏，循序渐进，寓培于乐，培养儿童的识字兴趣和阅读习惯。
【关于贝乐虎】
贝乐虎是中国儿童内容领域的创新者，凭借多年在儿童启蒙内容上的深耕，成为国民级品牌。我们的核心理念是“快乐陪伴、寓教于乐”，致力于为0-8岁的宝宝们打造互动、多元的高品质儿童内容。贝乐虎是孩子们成长路上的欢笑伙伴，为激发创造力、启发智慧而不懈努力。和贝乐虎一起，让每个孩子都能在欢笑中茁壮成长。
【产品特色】
《贝乐虎识字》注重通过象形、图形、组词、造句、诗句等多方位、立体地让孩子认识汉字，贴合孩子的认知发展规律，采用多元的方式帮助孩子了解汉字的起源、领略文字之美。
【内容介绍】
500个精讲汉字、450+诗词成语、450+诗词名句、100+识字动画。
四大环节+单元巩固，科学识字：
1、字：象形字或小篆演绎汉字，并配图唤醒图像记忆能力。
2、词：常用词义的解释与常用成语，增加词汇理解能力。
3、句：精选诗歌词句，并配以贝乐虎演绎的情景动画。
4、练：改编经典童话故事，巩固所认识的汉字。
5、本节收获：总结本节内容，让家长看到孩子的成长。
产品还包括配套写字练习本、经典动画等功能丰富内容，培养儿童兴趣、用归纳总结记忆法让孩子在操作中感受汉字文化。
【产品理念】
《贝乐虎识字》充分利用儿童的生活经验，注重识字方法，力求识用结合，运用多种形象直观的方式，创设丰富多彩的情境，符合科学的识字认知观念，并以创新的互动形式寓培于乐。

►Banknote Market Price
You will understand the value of your banknote and make informed decisions about purchases, sales, or trades.

►Explore Collections

bluejetty:00070163:ios.description:
Apple Music for Artists is the official app that empowers you with insights to help build your audience and reach new fans. With it, you can track how your music performs across Apple Music and Shazam and you can use it to create custom promotional assets for any of your content to share on social platforms. Find out how fans react to songs and albums and where you’re getting the most plays. See your new Milestones and all-time bests at a glance, including your most-played songs, videos, and Shazam Count. Now, whenever you achieve something special like having a song featured in a playlist, you can celebrate with fans by sharing Milestones directly on social media.  
Features:
- Discover where your fans are around the world. 
- View the number of people listening to your music in real time. 
- Get a minute-by-minute look at listener numbers over the last 48 hours. 
- Choose from Custom templates, layouts, and background colors for your promotional assets. 
- Share your assets on social channels to engage fans and attract new ones. 
- Share Milestones like new playlist adds or all-time bests on social media. 
- See the impact of Apple Music playlists on your music. 
- Track your Shazam Count and see where your songs are heating up. 
- Track what stations from around the world are playing your music. 
- Keep your Apple Music profile fresh by adding or updating your artist image.
- Give your team access to your analytics.

Welcome to Panthia World, a magical merge adventure where every discovery helps restore a lost fairy homeland.
Match and merge magical items, trigger satisfying combo chains, collect wonderful treasures, and bring Elora’s enchanted world back to life. From mysterious ruins to beautiful fairy gardens, every merge opens the door to a new surprise.
GAMEPLAY FEATURES
== MERGE, COMBINE & DISCOVER ==
• Merge hundreds of items into powerful new creations.
• Organize your board and trigger exciting combo chains.
• Watch simple objects evolve into extraordinary magical wonders.
• Unlock new discoveries as you progress through every merge chain.
== RESTORE YOUR FAIRY HOMELAND ==
• Complete merge challenges to earn Stars and rebuild your home island.
• Restore fairy houses, enchanted gardens, ancient ruins, and breathtaking landscapes.
• Clear the magical fog and unlock new areas across Elora’s homeland.
• Design and decorate your own magical paradise.
== COLLECT REWARDS & RARE TREASURES ==
• Earn Gems, Coins, Energy, chests, and helpful boosts throughout your adventure.
• Discover rare treasures, mysterious artifacts, and hidden surprises.
• Complete challenges and events to unlock themed skins and magical decorations.
• Collect more than 500 magical items across a variety of merge chains.
== EXPLORE THE WORLD OF PANTHIA ==
• Journey through enchanting regions filled with puzzles and mysteries.
• Meet charming companions and uncover the story of the magical continent.
• Reveal forgotten lands and awaken spectacular magical wonders.
• Enjoy new events, adventures, and discoveries along the way.
== RELAX AND PLAY YOUR WAY ==
• Enjoy smooth and satisfying merge gameplay.
• Use rewarding resources and boosts to keep your adventure moving.
• Merge, collect, decorate, and explore at your own pace.
• Build the magical world you have always imagined.
Download Panthia World today and begin an enchanting merge adventure filled with discovery, creativity, and magical surprises!
Follow Panthia on Facebook for exclusive offers and bonuses:
https://www.facebook.com/PanthiaMagicMergeGame

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!! 
With Etips Travel Guides you have a full city guide in your iPad. 
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standed. 
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc... 
Etips Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region. 
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Parliament Square, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, St. James Park, Queen Victoria Memorial, Buckingham Palace, Green Park, Picadilly Circus, Royal Academy of Arts, National Gallery, Trafalgar Square, Tower of London, Tower Bridge, St Paul’s Cathedral, Royal Courts of Justice, British Museum, Soho, Oxford Street, among others. 
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.

bluejetty:00044252:ios.summary: Frost War is an immersive, ice-themed SLG that brings realistic 4X tactical warfare to your mobile device. In a vast, frozen landscape, you will establish your base, manage scarce resources, and lead a formidable dinosaur army into epic isl
bluejetty:00044252:ios.description:
Frost War is an immersive, ice-themed SLG that brings realistic 4X tactical warfare to your mobile device. In a vast, frozen landscape, you will establish your base, manage scarce resources, and lead a formidable dinosaur army into epic island battles. With cutting-edge graphics and a detailed, realistic art style, every decision you make on the battlefield shapes your destiny. The ultimate goal? Seize the central shrine and secure your legacy.
Key Features:
• Realistic Ice Environment: Experience a meticulously rendered frozen world where extreme weather and icy terrains add an extra layer of challenge to your strategic operations.
• Dinosaur Armies: Command diverse prehistoric warriors, each with unique skills and strengths, and unleash them in fierce, real-time battles across dynamic island territories.
• Island Conquest & Alliances: Form alliances with other players and engage in both cooperative and competitive multiplayer battles. Strategically conquer island regions and fight for dominance over the central altar—the ultimate symbol of power.
• Season-Based Gameplay: Adapt to ever-changing challenges with a unique set of rules each season. Special seasonal events and gameplay twists keep the war fresh and demand that you continually refine your tactics.
• Multi-language Support: Designed to captivate a global audience, Frost War offers full multi-language support to ensure a seamless experience across diverse regions.
• Multi-Player Focus: Dive into dynamic multiplayer action with real-time alliances and wars, where strategic teamwork and rivalry drive every battle.
• 4X Tactical Strategy: Embrace the classic 4X principles – Explore, Expand, Exploit, and Exterminate – as you build your base, gather resources, and develop powerful dinosaur units.
Command your legions, forge unbreakable alliances on the frozen islands. The cold never bothered the brave—prepare to dominate the battlefield and etch your legacy in the annals of war. Download Frost War today and lead your dinosaur army to victory in a world where strategy, survival, and seasonal challenges collide.

bluejetty:00126397:ios.description:
Focus Keeper is the ultimate focus timer and Pomodoro timer designed to help you boost productivity and fight against procrastination. Whether you're a student preparing for an exam, managing ADHD, or simply trying to stay focused, this app is here to make your time management easier. By leveraging the original Pomodoro method, Focus Keeper helps you break down your tasks into manageable intervals and balance work with breaks, so you can stay on track without burning out.
With a built-in study tracker, customizable settings, and an intuitive design, Focus Keeper is ideal for those who need a reliable exam timer or just want to track their progress efficiently.
Focus Keeper: Pomodoro Timer, Exam Timer, ADHD
Pomodoro – Stay true to the original technique with 25-minute sessions followed by short breaks to keep your mind sharp.
Customizable Focus Timer – Adjust the length of your sessions, short breaks, and long breaks to suit your workflow.
Exam Timer & Study Timer – Ideal for students and professionals, the product acts as a perfect exam timer to help you easily manage study sessions.
ADHD Friendly – Tailored for those with ADHD, the app’s structured technique helps improve concentration and task completion.
Time Tracker – Track your productivity over time with insightful charts and fight against ADHD and procrastination.
Simple Interface – With a clean and intuitive design, it's easy to set up your focus timer and start working on your tasks immediately.
How Its Works?
Set Your Focus Timer & Study Timer– Choose a task and set the clock for 25 minutes.
Work Until the Rings – Stay focused on your task until the Pomodoro rings.
Take a Short Break – Enjoy a 5-minute break after each session to refresh your mind.
Long Breaks – After completing 4 focus sessions, take a longer break of 20-30 minutes to recharge.
The app automatically starts the next session, so you can stay productive without interruptions.
Who Can Benefit?
Whether you're a student needing a reliable study timer for exams, a professional managing multiple tasks, or someone who struggles with ADHD, the concentration app is the perfect tool. The app provides a structured routine, making it easier to avoid distractions and procrastination. Its built-in time tracker and customizable settings ensure that you can stay productive in any environment, from the office to the study room.
Why ?
Unlike other apps, Focus Keeper offers an original Pomodoro experience while giving you full control over how you manage your focus sessions. Whether you're using it as an exam timer, a study timer, or to manage ADHD, its versatile features and easy-to-use interface make it stand out. Track your productivity over time, customize your features, and use it as a stopwatch for specific tasks – all while avoiding procrastination and staying on task.

bluejetty:00066089:ios.description:
The original Launchpad — Make & Remix Music.
Enter an inspiring world of music creation and remixing on your iPhone & iPad.
8 free soundpacks included. Hundreds more available, updated weekly.
Launchpad is the original number-one app for making and remixing electronic music. Instantly combine beats, basslines, melodies, vocals and FX loops into new creations. Layer DJ-style effects to chop and change your sound. Record your performance and share it with others. 
There’s never been a better time to make music.
// MAKE & REMIX MUSIC
Instantly create and remix music. Use the world-famous Launchpad grid to trigger loops and sounds from a huge professional library. Launchpad is always locked to the beat, so you’ll never go out of time.
// EASY TO USE DJ-STYLE FX
Free, easy-to-use DJ-style FX turn every remix into a creative performance. Advanced options on iPad further enhance your remixes. The pro DJ-style effects include filter, gater, stutter, stopper, flanger and delay.
// INSPIRING SOUNDPACKS, UPDATED WEEKLY
Launchpad comes with 8 remix soundpacks to get you started. Hundreds more are available in the store, with new ones added every week.
// PRO FEATURES COLLECTION
For the advanced or adventurous, the Pro Features Collection for iPad add-on lets you import your own sounds, use the extended FX features and sync easily to other apps and external hardware. 
Connect the world famous Launchpad hardware to your iPad for the ultimate sonic experience. At any time, capture your performance and share it easily.
Features
• Make music instantly — Play a multi-colour grid of amazing sounds
• Be a DJ — Mix soundpacks together endlessly
• 8 free soundpacks — Nearly 400 sounds included. Discover hundreds more in the store.
• Weekly releases — Professional remix soundpacks released every week
• DJ-style performance FX — Make your mixes unique with powerful DJ effects
• Share your music — Soundcloud, YouTube, Facebook, Dropbox, Audiocopy and more
• Create your own remixes — Craft your own remix by combining sounds from your library
• Reuse soundpacks — Launchpad soundpacks appear automatically in Blocs Wave
• Play in key — Set the key of your session and browse all clips in that key
Advanced Features
• Real-time tempo — Change tempo at any time, with real-time audio stretching
• Blocs Wave export — Easily send your Blocs Wave projects to Launchpad
• Audio Import* — Supports Dropbox, AudioShare, AudioCopy and Airdrop
• Advanced performance FX* — Enhanced Stutter, Autofilter, Gater, Delay, Stopper & Flanger 
• Launchpad hardware — Integrates with Novation’s Launch hardware (iPad only)
• Ableton Link — Jam in sync with your other apps, devices or Ableton Live
• MIDI sync output* — Connect Launchpad to external hardware synths and drum machines* (iPad only)
• Audiobus Support — Use any Audiobus-compatible apps to extend your music-making setup
• Bluetooth — Supports Bluetooth speakers and headphones
*In-App Purchase
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014161:ios.description:
A simple, no-frills bible concordance - easy to use, fast and no wireless connection needed! Designed to be quick and easy to use without all the complexity of more feature rich offerings. Easily jump to any verse in the bible and search for any combination of words. Cross-references to related verses are easy to find, just touch the verses with an asterisk (*).
Includes the Matthew Henry Concise Commentary - gain valuable insight and a concise overview of each chapter of the bible with just a simple touch.
Also includes Gospel Harmony - a handy index to 185 events, teachings, miracles and parables found in the four gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. The events are organized in sequential order and you can easily search for any term in the list. The list shows you the event description, category (miracle, parable, etc.) and the bible references for that event which you can quickly jump to simply by touching the bible reference. 
Supports Dark Mode as well as Dynamic Type so the font size changes to match the Dynamic Type settings on your device. 
The bible texts are stored on your device, no need for a wireless connection.
Contains two versions of text, the King James Version (KJV) and the World English Bible (WEB). The World English Bible is a public domain Modern English update of the American Standard Version of 1901 and can be found at http://ebible.org/web/

Welcome to the crazy world of Ramen chef. The restaurant world awaits a hot new chef to cook world-class cuisines all in a cooking fever! Discover new Japanese Ramen favors and recipes in this addictive fun time management kitchen game. Download Ramen Craze and start cooking now!
FEATURES
============
COOK AND SERVE RAMEN!
• Cook up fun anytime, anywhere!
• Over 100 ramen ingredients to choose from! Chashu, Naruto, Grilled Eel, BBQ pork, and Mussel – the recipes grow with each city!
• Roll up and complete your customer’s ramen orders! The better your cooking is, the more delighted the customers will be. Collect tons of tips for excellent service and make those profits!
• Cook a wide variety of Japanese cuisine items like Zabu Soba, Okonomiyaki, and Yakitori!
• Reliving the cooking dash in your own Japanese ramen kitchens on your mobile phones!
BECOME THE SUPER STAR CHEF!
• Try new Japanese Ramen noodle recipes from Sapporo, Hokkaido to Tokyo, Kyushu! Unlock the Hollywood level to get achingly hip Ramen cooking recipes!
• Love Sushi Diner? You will like Ramen Craze too!
• Dash through over 300 levels from Asia to America world cities!
• Scramble to feed customers from all over the world! Light up your ramen kitchens in a cooking fever!
• Have hours of exciting time-management food maker fun!
WIFI NOT REQUIRED!
• Play Ramen Craze – Fun Cooking Food Maker Game offline on your iOS devices after initial content download!
• Internet / 4G / Wifi connection not needed after content download! Have fun playing on a plane or underground!
• Download restaurant content and start cooking right away!
• Feverish offline or online time-management game play!
TEST AND REFINE YOUR COOKING SKILLS!
• Start out with a single ramen restaurant and expand your cooking empire!
• Simple time management and fun cooking game with lots of upgrades!
• New exciting boss levels to challenge your kitchen skills!
• Get ready to cook delicious and tasty Japanese cuisine!
FREE TO PLAY KITCHEN COOKING GAME!
• Earn achievements to get free gems and earn coins with each level beat for free!
• Beat simple early levels and gear up to become the superstar chef!
• Expand your restaurant empire for free by earning 3 star each level! Unlock Korea and China levels with special local recipes!
• Are you ready for an epic kitchen scramble? Install and start playing and get into the craziness of time management cooking game!
Download Ramen Craze – Fun Cooking Game now and enjoy this incredible cooking simulation game! 
Like Japanese cooking game? Try out sushi diner – Fun cooking game from us! Also available for free!
Have fun cooking and don’t forget to share your delicious meals with your friends on Facebook!

bluejetty:00171786:ios.description:
Yoga for BJJ: Elevate Your Jiu-Jitsu with Yoga
Transform your Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu game with Yoga for BJJ, the resource designed specifically for jiu-jitsu practitioners who want more flexibility, mobility and recovery. A complete library of yoga and mobility programs that help you move better on the mat and prevent injuries.
Founded by Champions, Trusted by Practitioners Worldwide
Yoga for BJJ was founded by Sebastian Brosche, a former IBJJF Worlds double gold medalist and UAEJJF World Champion. Now a black belt and owner of a yoga studio in Norway, Sebastian has channeled his expertise into a tool that addresses the unique needs of BJJ athletes. The app also features Rosi Sexton, a professional osteopath and former MMA champion, who leads the Rehab Program for injury recovery and prevention, plus classes from Stine Brosche, 2-time IBJJF European medalist Adam Ellis and IBJJF Champion Sarah Draht.
Start Your Journey to Better Performance
Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, begin with the Beginner programs to build a strong foundation, then progress through dozens of structured programs that guide you step by step toward better mobility and flexibility. Selected sessions are free.
On the Go, on the Big Screen
Log in with your yogaforbjj.net account to access your entire library. Save favorites, build playlists and pick up any program where you left off. Send a session to your TV with AirPlay, or use the app on Apple TV. Same account on every device.

Membership is managed at yogaforbjj.net. The app is for members and does not sell subscriptions.
